choose which battles to complete and is better suited for sync-sessions.

options.label: Chapter Clear Percentage
options.description:
LAYERED MODE ONLY.

Controls how much of the current chapter must be completed before the first
layer of the next chapter can be unlocked.

options.label: Receptions Require Books
options.description:
BATTLE GRAPH MODE ONLY.

If 'true', every reception will require books to send invitation.

options.label: Floors Require Books
options.description:
BATTLE GRAPH MODE ONLY.

If 'true', Abnormality Suppressions and Realizations will require books.

options.label: Book Requirement Density
options.description:
BATTLE GRAPH MODE ONLY.

Controls how many nodes on the map will share the same book requirement.

At 100, every locked battle node receives its own book requirement.
Lower values make nearby nodes share the same requirements. At 1, nearly
the entire graph may be unlocked by one book.

options.label: Balance Book Requirements
options.description:
BATTLE GRAPH MODE ONLY.

If true, receptions/suppressions/realizations will require books from around their chapters.
Otherwise, random books will be selected.

options.label: Enemies Turn Into Checks
options.description:
If 'true', you send one item from the reception for each defeated enemy.
(Completing the reception will still send remaining items)
(This option simply allows for chipping at the enemies to send items without completing the reception to potentially escape BK)

options.label: Shortcut Connections
options.description:
If true, some battles in the same chapter may connect across multiple graph layers.
If false, connections only lead to the immediately following layer.

options.label: Randomize Black Silence Page Location
options.description:
If 'true', Black Silence Page item's location will be random.
If 'false', Black Silence Page will be unlocked after completing Reception of Oliver

options.label: Shuffle Abnormalities
options.description: If 'true', Abnormalities will be shuffled between the Floors.

options.label: Shuffle Realizations
options.description: If 'true', Realizations will be shuffled between the Floors.

options.label: Shuffle Ensemble Floors
options.description: If true, floors for each reception of Reverberation Ensemble will be shuffled.

options.label: Shuffle Abnormality Pages
options.description:
Select the way Abnormality Pages are shuffled.

None - Abno Pages are not shuffled and are placed exactly like in the vanilla game.
InFloor - Pages are shuffled in their floors individually.
Sets - Pages are shuffled between floors in abnormality sets
       (For example 3 of Scorched Girl's pages are gonna end up in the same page group after randomization).
Pages - Pages are shuffled between floors individually.

options.label: Randomize Abnormality Pages
options.description:
Select the way Abnormality Pages are randomized.

None - Abno Pages retain their vanilla Emotion State, Level and Rate.
Guarantee - Every stat is randomized, but it is guaranteed that there will be at least: 4 Positive Pages, 4 Negative Pages, 3 Pages of each Emotion Level per floor.
Unbound - Every stat is randomized, without restrictions.

options.label: Guarantee Exodia Abnormality Sets
Shuffle EGO Pages
options.description: Select if EGO Pages should be shuffled between floors.

options.label: Randomize Key/Combat Pages
options.description:
!!!NOT IMPLEMENTED!!! TODO

Select the way Key/Combat Pages are randomized.

None - Key/Combat Pages are not randomized.
Basic - Game Randomizes: Combat Pages' Dices and effects; Key Pages' HP, Break, Vulnerabilities.
More - Above and: Combat Pages' Names and CG, Key Pages' Passives.
Havoc - Above and: Combat Pages' VFX and SFX, Key Pages' visuals.

options.label: Randomize Book Contents
options.description:
Select the way every vanilla book's contents will be randomized.

BookChapter - Book contents will be balanced around the chapter of the book.
StageChapter - Book contents will be balanced around the chapter of the reception/suppression/realization they're required in.
Chaotic - Book contents are fully random.

options.label: Filler Page%
options.description:
!!!NOT IMPLEMENTED!!! TODO

Select the amount of pages (in %) from burning Filler Items that will turn into Filler Pages.
Filler Pages are one-time instant use Pages that grant different buffs to your units or debuffs to enemy units
(Example: Instant use +5 Strength). Filler Pages are only considered used if you win the reception.

!!! Sum of this and "Traps%" must not exceed 100!

options.label: Combat Page Exclusiveness Removal
options.description:
!!!NOT IMPLEMENTED!!! TODO

Select if "Combat Page Exclusiveness Removal" item should be added to the pool.

I think option names are self explanatory?

options.label: Passive Attribution Point Items
options.description:
Select the amount of "Passive Attribution Points" Items you'll be able to acquire in total.
You always start with 2 Items (Unless configured otherwise) and get 2 Passive Attribution Points for each Item.
Base amount is 15 Items, meaning up to 34 Passive Attribution Points in-game.

Do note that adding more of those Items leads to having less free space in the Item Pool,
potentially lowering the amount of other filler items you'll be able to get.

options.label: Starting Passive Attribution Point Items
options.description: Select the amount of "Passive Attribution Points" Items you are starting with.

options.label: Passive Limits Break Items
options.description:
Select the amount of "Passive Limits Break" Items you'll be able to acquire in total.
You always start with 2 Items (Unless configured otherwise) and get 1 Passive slot for each Item.
These Items determine how much Passives you'll be able to put on a single Key Page (Not including passives tied to the page itself)
Base amount is 10 Items, meaning up to 12 Passives attributed in-game.

Do note that adding more of those Items leads to having less free space in the Item Pool,
potentially lowering the amount of other filler items you'll be able to get.

options.label: Starting Passive Limits Break Items
options.description: Select the amount of "Passive Limits Break" Items you are starting with.

options.label: Emotion Limits Break Items
options.description:
Select the amount of "Emotion Limits Break" Items you'll be able to acquire in total.
You always start with 0 Items (Unless configured otherwise) and your max Emotion Level increases by 1 for each Item.
These Items determine the Maximum Emotion Level your librarians can get during receptions.
Levels past 5 (Vanilla max) give additional buffs like +1 Max Light, Abno and EGO pages & occasionally a Speed Die.
That also means that you won't be getting Abno and EGO Pages even if you have them unless your Max Emotion Level is at least 1 and 3 respectively.
Base amount is 15 Items, meaning up to 15 Max Emotion Level in-game.

Emotion level effects are changed a bit in this mod:
1. You get an abno page at every team emotion level like in vanilla game, but instead of getting only certain level abno pages
    at certain team emotion levels, the pool of pages contains every page which level is less than or equal to the current
    team emotion level (So you start getting level 3 pages at team emotion level 3 and can get them every level after that)
2. The amount of Max Light gotten is adjusted: you get 1 Max Light every level 1-5,
    then you get 1 Max Light for every second level for levels 5-15 (so at levels 7, 9, 11, 13, 15),
    then you get 1 Max Light for every third level for levels 15-30 (so at levels 18, 21, 24, 27, 30);
3. You get an additional Speed Die every 4th level (so at levels 4, 8, 12, etc.)
4. There is no additional page draw after the one at level 5.
5. You CAN stack up to 15 abno pages on a single unit.

options.label: Starting Emotion Limits Break Items
options.description: Select the amount of "Emotion Limits Break" Items you are starting with.

options.label: Traps%
options.description:
!!!NOT IMPLEMENTED!!! TODO

Select the amount of pages (in %) from burning Filler Items that will turn into Traps.
Traps are different effects that put you in a disadvantage and their
severeness depends on the "Traps Impact Level" option.

!!! Sum of this and "Filler Page%" must not exceed 100!

options.label: Traps Severeness
options.description:
!!!NOT IMPLEMENTED!!! TODO

Select the severeness level of trap effects.

Weak - Traps activate as soon as possible (first available Scene), once. Effects are mostly minor inconveniences.
Mediocre - Traps can activate at the beginning of any Scene from the moment you get them, once. Effects can ruin your plans and be a nuisance for you;
Dangerous - Traps can activate at any time from the moment you get them (at any point of any scene). They also get tied to the exact Scene and Reception they activated at,
        making it so they are repeated if you restart the reception (by losing or restarting), until you beat that reception.
        This level has the most impactful and inconvenient effects ready to mess up your run.

options.label: Deathlink
options.description:
!!!NOT IMPLEMENTED!!! TODO

If 'true', a deathlink is sent on a condition specified in "Outgoing Deathlink" Option.
"Incoming Deathlink" option specifies what happens when you receive a deathlink.

options.label: Outgoing Deathlink
options.description:
!!!NOT IMPLEMENTED!!! TODO

Select what must happen for a deathlink to be sent.

UnitDeath - When in a battle and ANY librarian dies, deathlink is sent.
TeamWipe - When in a battle and ALL librarians on the floor die, deathlink is sent.
StageLoss - When a battle is lost, deathlink is sent.

options.label: Incoming Deathlink
options.description:
!!!NOT IMPLEMENTED!!! TODO

Select what will happen after receiving a deathlink.

UnitDeath - After receiving a deathlink while in battle, a random librarian dies.
TeamWipe - After receiving a deathlink while in battle, all librarians on the floor die.
StageLoss - After receiving a deathlink while in battle, lose the current battle.

options.label: Last Chapter
options.description:
What is the most advanced chapter to include in the multiworld?
The first chapter is Glades
The second chapter is Oasis

options.label: Story Amount
options.description:
How many stories in the latest indicated chapter are in the multiworld?
Maximum for Glades: 6 (5 released)
Maximum for Oasis: 4 (2 released)

options.label: Stat Bonus Percentage
options.description: Percentage of remaining item pool to fill with stat bonus items (0-100%)

options.label: Locations Per Weather
options.description: The total number of locations per type of weather. (There are 3 weather types)

options.label: Start Distance
options.description:
The distance to the closest BK at the start.
Each 'New Location' upgrade opens a location halfway between your house and the current closest location.

options.label: Speed Per Upgrade
options.description:
The amount of speed gained for each shoe upgrade.
Snow boots give half this speed in the snow.

options.label: Extra Filler Rate
options.description:
This percent of shoe/boot upgrades will attempt to be turned into filler.
The number of upgrades will not be reduced below the amount logically required.

options.label: Death Link
options.description:
If enabled, when another player with DeathLink enabled dies, you will die as well.
BK Simulator does not *send* DeathLinks, only receives them.

options.label: Knowledge Difficulty
options.description:
How much understanding of the games mechanics is expected to figure out the solution to a given medal/gift/etc.
Vanilla: *Only* allow cards and strats the basegame shows you.
Casual: Expects the bare minimum, only tricks that are taught with in-game tutorials to beat the vanilla game.
Standard: Incorporates hidden but usually intended or otherwise easy to intuit tech/ideas.
Expert: Further includes some more advanced tech that is often only relevant to speedrunners.
Master: Encompasses everything else from level-specific tech to extremely niche game quirks or nuances.

options.label: Execution Difficulty
options.description:
How hard it is to actually execute a given solution to a given medal/gift/etc, assuming all knowledge.
Vanilla: *Only* allow cards and strats the basegame shows you.
Casual: Can be done by a brand-new player with minimal hassle.
Standard: Consistently doable by a player who has all aces, especially players with dev medals.
Expert: Doable by a player who has all dev medals and is competent with advanced tech.
Master: Unreasonably difficult solutions that are inconsistent/overly precise to the vast majority of players.

options.label: Medal Selection
options.description:
Which medals to have as checks.
Format as a comma-separated list of medal names: ["Bronze", "Ace"].
Medals available are: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Ace, and Dev. Case-insensitive.

options.label: Gifts
options.description: Whether or not to make gifts checks.

options.label: Sidequests
options.description: Whether or not to make sidequest completions checks.

options.label: Mission Unlock Method
options.description:
How missions are unlocked to progress through the game.
Ranks: Fills the pool with Neon Ranks, each mission requiring a number of ranks to unlock. See Rank Requirement.
Missions: 1 Mission Unlock item is added to the pool per mission, each obtained unlocking the next locked mission.
Levels: Each level is an item that must be collected

options.label: Total Neon Ranks
options.description:
How many total Neon Ranks to add to the pool.
Only applies when Mission Unlock Method is set to Ranks.

options.label: Ranks Required Percentage
options.description:
Percentage of existing Neon Ranks required to open the last mission.
The rest of the mission requirements will scale accordingly.
Only applies when Mission Unlock Method is set to Ranks.

options.label: Mission Count
options.description:
The amount of Missions for the game to have when ranks or mission unlock method is chosen.
Spreads levels as evenly as it can, then spreads across the later half with the remainder.

options.label: Level Selection Variance
options.description:
The amount of "variance" in % to have in the random level selection for the ranks/mission unlock methods.
A lower value means, as the levels are selected, you will, on average, need more and more cards.
A higher value means much more randomness in the selection.

options.label: Starting Level Count
options.description:
The amount of Levels for you to start with for Levels unlock method.
This also influences how many fist-only levels are added early into the level pool for other unlock methods.

options.label: Goal
options.description:
What the goal to complete should be.
3bosses - Beat The Clocktower, The Third Temple, and Absolution with the highest medal selected.
TrueEnding - Gather all memories and write Green into the Book of Life. (WILL FAIL TO GEN)

options.label: Filler Weights
options.description:
How often different types of filler should appear.
"Generic" means to pick from a list of filler that don't do anything.
Only filler items (+ Generic) can be listed here.

options.label: Death Link Amnesty
options.description: How many deaths it takes to send a DeathLink.

options.label: Level Reset Death Link Amnesty
options.description:
How many **level resets** it takes to send a DeathLink.
Setting to 0 disables sending them on resets.

options.label: Traps
options.description:
Whether negative effects on the Neon White world are added to the item pool.
=== DOES NOT DO ANYTHING ATM ===

options.label: Book of Life Shenanigans
options.description:
Whether to include things like clips and far off Book of Life usages in the logic.
=== DOES NOT DO ANYTHING ATM ===

options.label: Randomize Region Passes
options.description:
Allow randomization of the Wildlands/Dead Dunes/Yusnaan region passes.
Expect to need to be more efficient with your routing and side quest management.
If left disabled, region passes will be given in the starter Ark chests.

options.label: Ultimate Lair
options.description: Include the Ultimate Lair dungeon checks for progression.

options.label: Super Bosses
options.description: Allow superboss related checks to be included in progression.

options.label: Canvas of Prayers
options.description: Allow Canvas of Prayers related checks to be included in progression.

options.label: Grindy Soul Seeds/Unappraised
options.description: Allow 20+ Soul Seeds and 10+ Unappraised items checks to be included in progression.

options.label: Shuffle Teleport
options.description: Allow Teleport to be shuffled into the item pool.

options.label: Shuffle Escape
options.description: Allow Escape to be shuffled into the item pool.

options.label: Shuffle Chronostasis
options.description: Allow Chronostasis to be shuffled into the item pool.

options.label: Shuffle Curaga
options.description: Allow Curaga to be shuffled into the item pool.

options.label: Shuffle Arise
options.description: Allow Arise to be shuffled into the item pool.

options.label: Shuffle Esunada
options.description: Allow Esunada to be shuffled into the item pool.

options.label: Shuffle Quake
options.description: Allow Quake to be shuffled into the item pool.

options.label: Shuffle Decoy
options.description: Allow Decoy to be shuffled into the item pool.

options.label: Shuffle Army of One
options.description: Allow Army of One to be shuffled into the item pool.

options.label: Allow DLC Items
options.description: Allow DLC items to be shuffled into the item pool.

options.label: Fully Remote Items
options.description:
Have Archipelago handle excluded locations instead of filling them locally.

Initial equipment always stays local.

options.label: Enemy Material Multiplier
options.description: Multiplier for enemy drop materials received from AP locations.

options.label: Shuffle Main Party
options.description: Shuffle the 6 main party members around.

options.label: Difficulty Progressive Scaling
options.description:
In addition to the progression scaling, also scale the progression based on the number of party members, 
the second license board has been unlocked, and progressive access to slightly easier regions to unlock more difficult areas.

options.label: Treasures
options.description: Allows treasures to contain progression and useful items.

options.label: Chops
options.description:
Allows pinewood chops and sandalwood chop checks to contain progression and useful items.
Note: The Bahamut Unlock Goal for collecting pinewood chops will still
require the player to collect the 28 chops for the Writ of Transit.

options.label: Black Orbs
options.description: Allows Pharos floor 1 and Subterra black orb checks to contain progression and useful items.

options.label: Trophy Rare Games
options.description:
Allows trophy rare game checks to contain progression and useful items.
Includes: Rare Game drops and Number of Rare Game Killed checks.

options.label: Hunt Rewards and Drops
options.description: Allows Hunt rewards and drops to contain progression and useful items.

options.label: Clan Hall Rewards
options.description: Allows Clan Hall rewards to contain progression and useful items.

options.label: Allow Seitengrat
options.description: Allow Seitengrat to appear in the item pool and bazaars.

options.label: Bahamut Unlock Goal
options.description:
Determines where the Writ of Transit is placed to unlock travel to the Bahamut to beat the game.
Defeat Cid 2: Climb the Pharos and defeat Cid 2 (Requires 2 magicites and 1 story sword).
Collect Pinewood Chops: Collect 28 pinewood chops from the multiworld and turn in for the Sandalwood Chop check.
Collect Espers: Collect all 13 espers and turn in for the Clan Hall Control 13 Espers check.
Defeat Shadowseer: Defeat the Shadowseer in the Pharos and turn in for the Hunt 44: Shadowseer check.
Defeat Yiazmat: Defeat Yiazmat in Ridorana and turn in for the Hunt 45: Yiazmat check.
Defeat Omega: Defeat Omega Mark XII in the Great Crystal and turn in for the Clan Boss: Omega Mark XII check.
Random Location: The Writ of Transit can be anywhere in the multiworld.

options.label: Accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.label: Game Mode
options.description: Choose Classic or Steel Soul. Steel Soul changes some checks and ends the save on death.

options.label: Goal
options.description:
Act 1-3 require beating the chosen act, Cursed Ending is self
explanatory, Flea Hunt is getting the set amount of fleas and Spelling Bee
is getting every unique letter in the chosen phrase with Alphabet Rando on.

options.label: Flea Hunt Count
options.description: Number of distinct AP Fleas received for Flea Hunt victory.

options.label: Starting Location
options.description:
Use the vanilla opening or experimental Bone Bottom start.

With Ledge Grab randomization, Vanilla uses Bone Bottom instead.

options.label: Entrance Randomization (Beta)
options.description: EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE. Couple room exits with matching directions.

options.label: Entrance Randomization Scope (Beta)
options.description:
Choose the coupled entrance pool. Full shuffles all supported connections.
Interiors shuffles door/interior pairs. Within Areas shuffles connections
inside each area and leaves area boundaries unchanged.

options.label: Starting Crest
options.description:
Choose Hornet's starting Crest when Crests are randomized.

random selects one of the seven Crests.

options.label: Force Naked
options.description:
Start cloakless without a Crest until you find one. Overrides Starting Crest.
Experimental. Requires Crest Randomization set to anywhere.

options.label: Early Dash
options.description: Place Dash early when Skills are randomized.

options.label: Silk and Soul Points
options.description:
Wish points required for Silk and Soul for the Act 3 goal. Other goals
keep the vanilla 17-point requirement. Mandatory wishes and story
requirements remain unchanged. Nuu's wish does not count in logic.
Values above 23 are treated as 23, or 22 in Steel Soul.

options.label: Ledge Grab Rando
options.description: Randomizes Hornet's ability to grab ledges.

options.label: Directional Ledge Grab Rando
options.description: Split Ledge Grab into Left and Right items. Automatically enables Ledge Grab Rando.

options.label: Swim Rando
options.description: Randomizes Hornet's ability to swim.

options.label: Directional Cling Grip
options.description: Split Cling Grip into Left and Right wall-clinging items with Skills set to anywhere.

options.label: Directional Swift Step
options.description:
Split Swift Step into Left and Right items with Skills set to anywhere.
Each item grants dash and sprint only in its direction. With Split Dash And Sprint enabled,
three Progressive Swift Steps grant sprint in both directions first,
then one dash direction chosen by the seed, then the other direction.

options.label: Directional Clawline
options.description: Split Clawline into Left and Right items with Skills set to anywhere.

options.label: Split Dash And Sprint
options.description:
With Skills set to anywhere, the first Progressive Swift Step grants sprint
and the second grants dash. With Directional Swift Step enabled, three
Progressive Swift Steps grant sprint, one dash direction chosen by the seed
then the other dash direction.

options.label: Trail's End Requirement
options.description: Choose whether Trail's End uses 14 Shakra map-stock purchases or received maps.

options.label: Enemy Pogo Skip Logic
options.description:
Use enemy pogo tricks to gain height or cross gaps beyond ordinary traversal.

Normal enemy pogos remain available with this option set to None.

Higher settings also allow easier tricks.

options.label: Proficient Combat
options.description:
Choose the preferred combat requirements settings.

Off: use the normal combat requirements.
Goated: lower Needle, DPS and Crafting Kit requirements by one tier and Mask Shard requirements by four fragments.
Hell: bypass combat requirements including combat movement.

options.label: Damage Boost Logic
options.description:
Take a hit to cross an obstacle using knockback or invulnerability.
None disables these routes. Higher settings also allow easier boosts.

options.label: Platforming Capability
options.description:
Normal uses ordinary platforming routes. Proficient Movement allows
precise inputs and advanced uses of movement abilities.
Elite Ball Knowledge also includes routes marked for that setting.

options.label: Flea Brew Jump Logic
options.description:
Use Flea Brew's extra jump height to reach ledges and cross gaps.

Its speed boost for the Weavenest Cindril secret room remains in logic
with this option disabled.

Requires Flea Brew and a crest with a usable red tool slot.

options.label: Red Tool Stall Logic
options.description:
Use Flea Brew, Flintslate, Plasmium Phial or Voltvessels in midair
to briefly delay your fall and extend a jump.

None disables these techniques. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

options.label: Drill Crystal Pogo Logic
options.description:
Take damage to create a Memory Crystal, then use Delver's Drill
to gain height from it. Both tools must fit on the same owned crest.

None disables this technique. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

options.label: Crest Pogo Skip Logic
options.description:
Use crest-specific pogo techniques to gain height or extend jumps.
Covers pogo skips for every crest.

None disables these techniques. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

options.label: Needle Strike Logic
options.description:
Use Needle Strike stalls and crest-specific charged attacks
to delay your fall, extend jumps or gain height.

None disables these techniques. 

Higher settings also allow easier uses.

options.label: Sharpdart Logic
options.description:
Use Sharpdart to cross gaps and extend jumps.

When disabled, traversal never requires Sharpdart.

options.label: Scuttlebrace Logic
options.description:
Use Scuttlebrace dodges to extend jumps and reach ledges.

None disables this technique. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

options.label: Heal Stall Logic
options.description:
Start binding in midair to briefly delay your fall and extend a jump.

None disables this technique. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

options.label: Hazard Respawn Logic
options.description:
Deliberately touch a hazard to return to a useful respawn point,
allowing shortcuts across gaps or obstacles.

None disables this technique. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

options.label: Start With Maps
options.description: Start with every eligible map.

options.label: Start Fully Mapped
options.description:
Start with the full world map drawn, regardless of map ownership.
This does not grant map items. Use Start With Maps to receive them.

options.label: Automatic Compass
options.description: Always show Hornet on maps without granting or equipping Compass.

options.label: Location Map Markers
options.description: Show enabled, unchecked Archipelago checks on the in-game map.

options.label: Randomized Bell Markers
options.description: Move the five Grand Gate Bell markers to their randomized local checks.

options.label: Randomized Melody Markers
options.description: Move Threefold Melody markers to their randomized local checks.

options.label: Vog Area Hints
options.description:
Number of area reports Vog can sell. Reports count remaining progression
items for any player without revealing their names and update as you complete checks.

options.label: Bellway Access
options.description: Choose whether Bell Beast must be defeated before using Bellways.

options.label: Enemy Rosary Multiplier
options.description: Multiply Rosaries dropped by defeated enemies only.

options.label: Enemy Shell Shard Multiplier
options.description: Multiply Shell Shards dropped by defeated enemies only.

options.label: Normal Shop Prices
options.description: Randomize prices for ShopItem purchases other than maps and pins.

options.label: Bellway Prices
options.description: Randomize prices charged by Bellway toll machines.

options.label: Ventrica Prices
options.description: Randomize prices charged by Ventrica toll machines.

options.label: Bench Prices
options.description: Randomize bench unlock tolls and Underworks bench fees.

options.label: Miscellaneous Prices
options.description: Randomize Pilgrim's Rest admission and pin gallery entry fees.

options.label: Map Prices
options.description: Randomize prices for Shakra's area maps and Citadel map machines.

options.label: Pin Prices
options.description: Randomize prices for Shakra's permanent map pins.

options.label: Upgrade Prices
options.description: Randomize the two paid Needle-upgrade service prices.

options.label: Donation Prices
options.description: Randomize Rosary and Shell Shard Wish donation requirements.

options.label: Vog Hint Prices
options.description: Randomize the price of Vog's area reports.

options.label: Faster Dialogue
options.description: Speed up ordinary NPC dialogue without skipping conversations.

options.label: Faster Silkheart Animation
options.description:
Collect boss Silkhearts on contact. 

False keeps the vanilla pickup animation but skips the dream sequence.

options.label: Quill Randomization
options.description:
Keep Quill at Shakra's shop or mix it into the global item pool.

Independent of Skill Randomization. Start Fully Mapped removes the need for Quill.

options.label: Compass Randomization
options.description:
Keep Compass at Shakra's shop or mix it into the global item pool.

Independent of Tool Randomization. Automatic Compass supplies the position marker without the tool.

options.label: Skill Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 8 traversal skills in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Tool Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes tools other than Compass in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Silk Skill Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 6 Silk Skills in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Silk Soar Begone
options.description:
Removes Silk Soar from runs without Act 3 areas. When Act 3 areas are included,
Silk Soar stays at its vanilla shrine, even with skill randomization enabled.

options.label: Crest Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 7 Crests in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Eva Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes Eva's two Hunter evolutions, two Vesticrests and Sylphsong.

vanilla: Eva gives her normal rewards
anywhere: mixes her rewards into the global item pool

options.label: Soul Randomization
options.description: Randomizes Maiden Soul, Hermit Soul and Seeker Soul for Act 2, Cursed and Act 3 goals.

options.label: Old Heart Randomization
options.description: Randomizes Pollen Heart, Hunter's Heart, Encrusted Heart and Conjoined Heart for the Act 3 goal.

options.label: Everbloom Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes Everbloom for Act 3 goals. 
The final Abyss route still requires the three-heart ritual and Red Memory to be completed.

options.label: Memento Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes Mementos available for your goal. 
Hunter's Memento stays vanilla. Hearts follow Old Heart Randomization.

options.label: Twisted Bud Randomization
options.description: Randomizes Twisted Bud.

options.label: Flea Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 30 Fleas in the game, including Kratt, Vog and the Huge Flea.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Crest Slot Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 20 Crest Slots in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

If needed, filler rewards become extra Memory Lockets so every randomized
slot has enough Lockets available. Native pickups stay unchanged.

options.label: Mask Shard Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 20 Mask Shards in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Spool Fragment Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 18 Spool Fragments in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Silk Heart Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 3 Silk Hearts in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Silk Heart Logic
options.description:
Places logical routes for abilities that require silk behind the
acquisition of at least one Silk Heart. These include Needolin,
Clawline and Silk Soar.

Turning this option off may cause more frequent soft locks as you
may get stuck in a location where you can't get more silk.

options.label: Bellway Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 10 Bellways in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Ventrica Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 6 Ventricas in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Map Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 28 Maps in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Needle Upgrade Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes Plinney's four Needle upgrades.

vanilla: leaves them at Plinney
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Pale Oil Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the three Pale Oils in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Melody Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 5 Melodies in the game: 
the three required to finish Act 2, 
Beastling Call and Elegy of the Deep.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Pin Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 4 map-pin types in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Relic Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 21 Relics in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Crafting Kit Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 4 Crafting Kits in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Major Key Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes Key of Indolent, Key of Heretic, Key of Apostate, White Key,
Surgeon's Key, Architect's Key and Craw Summons.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Simple Key Randomization
options.description:
Randomize four destination-specific keys without fungible spending.

anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool
shuffle: mixes them up between one another

options.label: Diving Bell Key Randomization
options.description:
Adds a Diving Bell Key to the item pool. Repairing the Diving Bell requires
this key as well as accepting the shaman's The Dark Below quest.

options.label: Memory Locket Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 20 Memory Lockets in the game.

If Crest Slots are randomized, using a Memory Locket will not unlock the
slot for use, but whatever took its place in that slot remains its AP check.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Craftmetal Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 8 Craftmetals in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Mossberry Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 7 Mossberries in the game. 

Three are required for the Moss Druid's quest, 
while giving her the remaining four earns another check.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Pollip Heart Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 6 finite Pollip Hearts in the game. 

They are required for Greyroot's quest in Shellwood.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Silkeater Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 9 Silkeaters in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Tool Pouch Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 4 Tool Pouch upgrades in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Lore Tablet Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 38 Lore Tablets in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Frayed Rosary String Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 19 Frayed Rosary Strings in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Rosary String Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 4 Rosary Strings in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Rosary Necklace Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes Rosary Necklaces, including wish rewards.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Heavy Rosary Necklace Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes Heavy Rosary Necklaces, including wish rewards and Loddie's second pin challenge.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Pale Rosary Necklace Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 2 Pale Rosary Necklaces in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Shard Bundle Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 12 Shard Bundles in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Beast Shard Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 7 Beast Shard upgrades in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Pristine Core Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 2 Pristine Cores in the game.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Rosary Cache Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 200 Rosary Caches in the game.

These are the Rosaries usually seen strung up and out in the open while exploring.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Shell Shard Cache Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the 153 Shell Shard Caches in the game.

These are the Shards found in fossils that must be hit several times.

vanilla: leaves them where they normally are
anywhere: mixes them into the global item pool

options.label: Boss Souls (Beta)
options.description:
Randomize Boss Souls into the item pool.
Bosses do not spawn and their respective arenas are not available until their "soul" has been collected. Bosses that have a gauntlet attached to them are the sole requirement for the gauntlet's spawn.
Example: Groal's Soul makes his boss fight available and the Bilehaven gauntlet available as well.

options.label: NPC Souls (Beta)
options.description:
Randomize NPC Souls into the item pool.
NPCs do not spawn until their respective soul has been collected.

options.label: Enemy Souls (Beta)
options.description:
Randomize Enemy Souls into the item pool.
Enemies do not spawn and their respective gauntlets are not available until their "soul" has been collected. Bosses and boss gauntlets are affected by the boss souls option. Killing an enemy for the first time grants a check.

options.label: Boss Sanity
options.description:
Adds boss checks and replaces their filler with boss credit items.
Receiving a credit grants that boss's story unlocks.
Items dropped by bosses follow their own randomization settings.

Fight difficulty and arena exits stay with the boss you face.
Act transitions still require their original fights.

vanilla: keeps the usual boss progression without extra checks
anywhere: boss credits can appear anywhere in the multiworld

options.label: Journal Randomization
options.description:
Randomizes the Hunter's Journal and boss journal entries.
Entries that need multiple kills have separate completion checks and items.

vanilla: keeps the usual journal
anywhere: mixes journal items into the multiworld

options.label: Bell Shrine Sanity
options.description: Randomizes the 5 Judge Bell Shrines.

options.label: Wish-Sanity
options.description:
Adds completion checks for wishes without a separately randomized item reward.
Items earned from bosses and wishes follow their own randomization settings.

vanilla: no additional wish completion checks
anywhere: fills wish completion checks from the global item pool

options.label: Shuffle Wish Offers
options.description:
EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE, should be fine but please don't bring to syncs

Shuffles supported wishes between boards and NPCs independently of Wish-Sanity.
Each wish keeps its tasks and story effects. Linked NPC follow-ups stay with
their original NPCs.

options.label: Wish Offer Plando
options.description:
Fix which wish an offer gives. Requires Shuffle Wish Offers.
Use wish names, with the original offer on the left and the wanted wish on the right.
Example: {"Wish: Berry Picking": "Wish: Final Audience"}
The remaining offers are shuffled. Assignments that block progression are rejected.

options.label: Individual Relic Turn-ins
options.description:
Make Scrounge's 15 relic and Cardinius's 6 cylinder deposits 
individual AP checks instead of paying Rosaries.

options.label: Death Link
options.description: Share deaths with other death link enabled players.

options.label: Death Link Cocoon
options.description:
Choose how received DeathLinks affect your death cocoon and Rosaries.

vanilla: Received DeathLinks replace an existing cocoon and move your
carried Rosaries into the new cocoon.
cocoonless: Received DeathLinks leave your carried Rosaries and any
existing cocoon untouched.
cocoon: The first received DeathLink can create a normal cocoon. Later
received DeathLinks leave that cocoon and your carried Rosaries untouched.

Your own deaths always use the normal game behavior.
This option has no effect when Death Link is disabled.

options.label: Silk Link
options.description: Share only the base Spool's current Silk with other enabled Silksong players.

options.label: Rosary Link
options.description: Share loose Rosary gains and costs with other enabled Silksong players.

options.label: Shell Shard Link
options.description: Share base-pouch Shell Shard gains and costs with enabled Silksong players.

options.label: Knockback Link
options.description:
Share hit and Stagger Trap knockback with other enabled players.

Incoming impacts use their direction at normal Stagger Trap strength.

options.label: Alphabet Mode
options.description:
Add Letter A through Letter Z to the item pool and hide unowned letters in game text.

Text filtering only runs while the game language is English.
This needs at least 26 randomized filler rewards.

options.label: Trap Disguises
options.description:
Disguise traps as major items in shops, wishes and crest slots.

Shop and wish icons are mirrored. Shop and crest-slot names contain small typos.

options.label: Trap Percentage
options.description:
Percent of eligible filler items in the random pool replaced by traps.

If every trap weight is zero, no traps are added.

options.label: Stagger Trap Weight
options.description:
Relative frequency of Stagger Traps, zero disables them.

When staggered, Hornet receives knockback but takes no damage.

options.label: Rosary Spill Trap Weight
options.description: Relative frequency of Rosary Spill Traps, zero disables them.

options.label: Darkness Trap Weight
options.description:
Relative frequency of Darkness Traps, zero disables them.

The screen is darkened to a small area of light around Hornet for 20 seconds.

options.label: Cursed Crest Trap Weight
options.description:
Relative frequency of Cursed Crest Traps, zero disables them.

Hornet is inflicted with the Cursed Crest for 90 seconds, as if she had done
the Rite of Rebirth quest with Greyroot.

options.label: Muckmaggot Status Trap Weight
options.description:
Relative frequency of Muckmaggot Status Traps, zero disables them.

Hornet is afflicted with Muckmaggots as if she fell into Bilewater. Binding
or using a bench removes them.

options.label: Naked Trap Weight
options.description:
Relative frequency of 90-second Naked Traps, zero disables them.

Hornet is left naked as if she were in the Slab escape sequence for 90 seconds.

options.label: Literacy Trap Weight
options.description:
Relative frequency of Literacy Traps, zero disables them.

Interrupts with a randomly selected passage of pre-written text.
Advance each dialogue box to regain control while the action continues around you.

options.label: Shader Trap Weight
options.description:
Relative frequency of Shader Traps, zero disables them.

Applies a shader to the game camera with the potential shaders:
Oil Painting, Grayscale

options.label: Room Draft Sanity
options.description:
Room Draft Sanity puts every single room (sans a single one chosen at random) into the item pool.
Rooms can not be drafted until they are received from the item pool.

options.label: Number of Starting Rooms
options.description: This is the number of starting rooms the player begins with in their inventory, randomly pulled from those that can be drafted from the Entrance Hall. This only applies when room draft sanity is on. Will not choose any that are already in the starting inventory. Closet is always added in addition due to technical limitations.

options.label: Common Locked Trunks
options.description: This is the number of common locked trunks per room that need to be opened for archipelago items. Example: Bedroom and Den trunks.

options.label: Rare Locked Trunks
options.description: This is the number of rare locked trunks per room that need to be opened for archipelago items. Exmple: Drawing Room trunk.

options.label: Complex Locked Trunks
options.description: This is the number of complex locked trunks per room that need to be opened for archipelago items. Example: Entrance Hall trunks from The Twins constellation or Laboratory experiments.

options.label: Item Logic Mode
options.description:
This option controls which possible item spawns are considered for an item being obtainable.
Room upgrades are currently not considered at all.

- **default:** Only common, simple spawn locations are considered.
- **rare:** All simple spawn locations are considered, including ones that require high luck.
- **complex:** All common spawn locations are considered, including ones that require multiple rooms/items. Also includes trunk contents.
- **rare_complex:** Everything is considered except for ||Spiral of Stars||, ||Advanced Experiments||, ||Trading Post||, ||Freight Mail||, and extra complex ||Trunk locations||.
- **extreme:** Everything is considered.

options.label: Enable Obscure Locations
options.description:
This option controls whether the extremely obscure locations will be created, and if they will be excluded (forced to only contian filler).
||Does it never end?||
Currently affects: Allowance Token - Outer Entrance Hall Vase

- **disable**: Disables them entirely
- **exclude**: Creates the locations, then sets them to excluded
- **enable**: Creates the locations

options.label: Standard Item Sanity
options.description:
This option enables standard item sanity checks.
That is, standard items can not be picked up or used until they are unlocked.

options.label: Dev: Workshop Sanity
options.description:
Not Implemented - Dev Use Only.
This option enables workshop item sanity checks.
That is, workshop crafted items can not be crafted until they are unlocked.

options.label: Upgrade Disk Sanity
options.description:
This option enables upgrade disk sanity checks.
That is, upgrade disk items can not be picked up until they are unlocked.

options.label: Key Sanity
options.description:
This option enables key sanity checks.
That is, special keys can not be picked up until they are unlocked.

options.label: Special Shop Sanity
options.description:
This option enables sanity checks for The Armory and Showroom.
That is, special shop items can not be purchased until they are unlocked.

options.label: Trophy Sanity
options.description:
This option enables checks for trophies.
Trophy sanity requires at least complex item logic.

options.label: Trap Percentage
options.description: This is the percentage that a given fill item will be a trap instead of an item.

options.label: Death Link Type
options.description:
Sets the circumstances under which a death-link is sent out.

- **none:** Death Link is disabled.
- **eod:** A Death Link is sent whenever the day ends.
- **bedroom:** A Death Link is sent whenever the player ends outside a bedroom.
- **steps:** A Death Link is sent whenever the player runs out of steps.

options.label: Death Link grace
options.description:
Death Link Grace is the number of times that the player may trigger the death link circumstance
before the death link will actually be sent.

- When 0, a death link will be triggered upon every matching circumstance.

- When 1, the death link will be deferred once before being triggered.
AKA death link will trigger every other time.

options.label: Death Link Protection
options.description: Death Link Protection is the number of times a death link will be blocked before the player will actually die from a death link.

options.label: Death Link Monk Exception
options.description: Death Link will be ignored if the "Blessing Of The Monk" is currently active.

options.label: Goal
options.description:
This selection determines what goal the player needs to aim for.

- **antechamber:** Reach the antechamber once
- **room46:** Reach room 46 once
- **sanctum:** Open a select number of sanctum keys - NOT IMPLEMENTED.
- **ascend:** Ascend the throne - NOT IMPLEMENTED.
- **blueprints:** Find the Blue Prints - NOT IMPLEMENTED.

options.label: Goal: Sanctums Solved
options.description: GoalSanctumSolves is the number of sanctum keys to find, and sanctum doors to open for the goal to be achieved.

options.label: Dev: Development Testing
options.description: Dev: Toggle to turn on locations and items that are not implemented yet

options.label: Required Dungeon Count
options.description:
Determines the number of dungeons required to beat the seed.
Beating Sky Keep is **NOT** required.
Lanayru Mining Facility is beaten when exiting to the Temple of Time at the end of the dungeon.
The other dungeons are only beaten when the Goddess Crest at the end is struck with a Skyward Strike.

options.label: Triforce Required
options.description: If enabled, the three Triforces will be required to open the door to Hylia's Realm at the end of the game.

options.label: Triforce Shuffle
options.description:
Choose where Triforces will appear in the game.
**Vanilla**: Triforces are placed in their vanilla locations in Sky Keep.
**Sky Keep**: Triforces are shuffled only within Sky Keep.
**Anywhere**: Triforces are shuffled with all other valid locations in the game.

options.label: Gate of Time Sword Requirement
options.description: Determines the sword needed to open the Gate of Time.

options.label: Gate of Time Dungeon Requirements
options.description:
Enables dungeon requirements for opening the Gate of Time.
**Required**: beating the required dungeons is necessary to open the Gate of Time.
**Unrequired**: the Gate of Time can be opened without beating the required dungeons.

options.label: Imp 2 Skip
options.description: If enabled, the requirement to defeat Imprisoned 2 at the end of the game is skipped.

options.label: Skip Horde
options.description: If enabled, the requirement to defeat The Horde at the end of the game is skipped.

options.label: Skip Ghirahim 3
options.description: If enabled, the requirement to defeat Ghirahim 3 at the end of the game is skipped.

options.label: Skip Demise
options.description: If enabled, the requirement to defeat Demise at the end of the game is skipped.

options.label: Gate of Time Starting State
options.description:
Determines whether the Gate of Time starts raised or lowered.
**Lowered**: the Goddess's Harp is needed to raise the Gate of Time.
**Raised**: the Gate of Time is raised from the start of the game.

options.label: Open Thunderhead
options.description:
Determines how the Thunderhead is unlocked.
**Ballad**: the Thunderhead opens when the Ballad of the Goddess song is found.
**Open**: the Thunderhead is open from the start of the game.

options.label: Open Earth Temple
options.description: If enabled, the Earth Temple door (requiring 5 key pieces to unlock) is opened at the start of the game.

options.label: Open Lanayru Mining Facility
options.description:
Determines the conditions for opening the Lanayru Mining Facility dungeon.
**Nodes**: requires activating the 3 nodes (vanilla).
**Main Node**: requires only the main generator to be activated.
**Open**: the Lanayru Mining Facility is open at the start of the game.

options.label: Open Lake Floria
options.description:
Choose how to access Lake Floria.
**Vanilla**: logically requires you to talk to Yerbal and draw on the Floria Gates to enter Lake Floria.
**Talk to Yerbal**: logically requires you to talk to Yerbal to enter Lake Floria.
**Open**: the Floria Gates are opened from the start of the game.

options.label: Progression in Goddess Chests
options.description:
If enabled, Goddess Chests can contain progression items.
If not enabled, all Goddess Chests will contain junk (filler) items.

options.label: Progression in Minigames
options.description:
If enabled, Minigames can contain progression items.
If not enabled, all Minigames will contain junk (filler) items.

options.label: Progression in Gratitude Crystal Quests
options.description:
If enabled, Crystal Quests can contain progression items.
If not enabled, all Crystals Quests will contain junk (filler) items.

options.label: Progression in Scrapper Quests
options.description:
If enabled, Scrapper Quests can contain progression items.
If not enabled, all Scrapper Quests will contain junk (filler) items.

options.label: Progression in Batreaux's Rewards
options.description:
Controls the maximum Batreaux's reward that can contain progression items.
Progression locations will begin with Batreaux's first rewards. Any locations
after this number will contain junk (filler) items.
0 means no rewards may contain progression, 7 means all rewards may contain progression.

NOTE: Batreaux's chest falls under the third reward, and the seventh reward falls under the sixth reward,
since they are given at the same time.

options.label: Empty Unrequired Dungeons
options.description:
If enabled, only the required dungeons will contain progression items.
If not enabled, all dungeons and Sky Keep can potentially contain progression items.

options.label: Map Mode
options.description:
Determines the placement of maps.
**Start With**: start with all maps.
**Vanilla**: maps appear in their vanilla locations.
**Own Dungeon - Restricted**: dungeon maps cannot appear on boss heart containers or the ending checks of dungeons.
**Own Dungeon - Unrestricted**: dungeon maps appear anywhere within their own dungeon.
**Anywhere**: maps can appear outside of dungeons in any world.

options.label: Small Key Mode
options.description:
Determines the placement of small keys.
**Vanilla**: keys will be in their vanilla locations (The Skyview Digging Spot will not contain a key).
**Own Dungeon**: keys will be within their own dungeons in your own world.
**Anywhere**: keys can appear outside of dungeons in any world.

options.label: Lanayru Caves Small Key
options.description:
Determines the placement of the Lanayru Caves small key.
**Start With**: start with the key in your inventory.
**Caves**: places the key within the caves.
**Lanayru**: places the key in the Lanayru surface region. The key will only be in an accessible area of Lanayru.
**Anywhere**: key can appear outside of lanayru in any world.

options.label: Boss Key Mode
options.description:
Determines the placement of boss keys.
**Vanilla**: boss keys appear in their vanilla locations.
**Own Dungeon**: boss keys appear within their own dungeon in your own world.
**Anywhere**: boss keys can appear outside of dungeons in any world.

options.label: FS Last Room Lava Flow
options.description:
If enabled, the lava in the last room of Fire Sanctuary will be flowing by default (without needing to
blow up the underground boulder).

options.label: Shuffle Trial Objects
options.description:
Shuffles obtainable items in Silent Realms (within the same Silent Realm).
**None**: trial objects appear in their vanilla locations.
**Simple**: only shuffles tears and light fruits.
**Advanced**: also shuffles dusk relics.
**Full**: also shuffles stamina fruits.

options.label: Treasuresanity in Silent Realms
options.description:
Randomizes treasures in Silent Realms to items. Items other than relics will glow in Silent Realms
(Yellow in Faron, Blue in Eldin, Green in Lanayru, and Red on Skyloft)

options.label: Trial Treasure Amount
options.description: How many treasures per Silent Realm you want to randomize.

options.label: Randomize Entrances
options.description:
Shuffles entrances with one another.
**None**: entrances are vanilla.
**Required Dungeons Only**: only required dungeon entrances are shuffled with each other.
**Dungeons Only**: all dungeon entrances are shuffled with each other.
**All Entrances**: all shuffle-able entrances are shuffled with each other, with some limitations.

options.label: Randomize Silent Realms
options.description: If enabled, the Silent Realm that a Trial Gate entrance leads to is shuffled.

options.label: Random Starting Spawn
options.description:
Determines where you will spawn you start the game.
**Vanilla**: You will spawn in Link's bedroom.
**Bird Statues**: You will spawn at a random Bird Statue or Link's bedroom.
**Any Surface Region**: You will spawn at any valid surface entrance or Link's bedroom.
**Any**: You will spawn at any valid entrance.
**TIP**: You can ask Fi to warp you back to the starting point.

options.label: Random Starting Statues
options.description:
If enabled, the starting statue for each surface region will be randomized. All overworld statues
except Inside the Volcano and Inside Fire Sanctuary may be chosen.

options.label: Shopsanity
options.description:
Determines if shops are randomized. When enabled, shop items and locations will be shuffled like normal items,
and the shop locations will get a randomized item. When disabled, shops will always contain their vanilla items,
however those items may still be required for progression. **Currently shuffled shops**: Beedle's Airshop

options.label: Rupoor Mode
options.description:
Adds or replaces junk items with Rupoors.
**Off**: no Rupoors are added as junk items.
**Added**: adds 15 rupoors as junk items.
**Rupoor Mayhem**: replaces half of the junk items with Rupoors.
**Rupoor Insanity**: replaces all junk items with Rupoors.
Note, Rupoors may also be added if there are not enough junk items for the game to randomize.

options.label: Rupeesanity
options.description:
Shuffles freestanding rupees. When unshuffled, all freestanding rupees will remain vanilla.
Note, it is not possible to shuffle some freestanding rupees yet (e.g. the rupees on the Lumpy Pumpkin
chandelier).

options.label: Tadtonesanity
options.description:
If enabled, 17 "Group of Tadtones" items will be shuffled throughout the world and each of the tadtone
groups in Flooded Faron Woods will give an item when collected. Get all 17 "Group of Tadtones" items to
complete the music scroll and receive an item from the Water Dragon in Flooded Faron Woods."

options.label: Place Scrap Shop Upgrades
options.description:
If enabled, the extra progressive items upgradeable in the Scrap Shop in vanilla will be shuffled.
Includes: Quick Beetle, Tough Beetle, Iron Bow, Sacred Bow, Big Bug Net and Scattershot.
Note, there are no random items obtainable by talking to Gondo at the Scrap Shop.

options.label: Force Sword Dungeon Reward
options.description:
Determines if swords should be rewarded for beating required dungeons.
**None**: swords are shuffled anywhere.
**Heart Container**: end of required dungeon heart containers are swords.
**Final Check**: the final check of required dungeons are swords.
Note, if there aren't enough swords to place, some required dungeons will not force a sword at the end.

options.label: Shuffle Batreaux Counts
options.description:
Determines the amount of crystals Batreaux will require for each of his rewards.
**Vanilla**: The normal required crystal counts (5, 10, 30, 40, 50, 70, 80).
**Half**: Half of the normal required crystal counts (2, 5, 15, 20, 25, 35, 40).
**Shuffled**: Completely random required crystal counts (min 1, max 80).
**Shuffled - High**: Higher random required crystal counts (min 30, max 80).
**Shuffled - Low**: Lower random required crystal counts (min 1, max 50).

options.label: Randomize Boss Key Puzzles
options.description: If enabled, the starting position of the boss keys will be randomized.

options.label: Random Puzzles
options.description:
Randomizes the Isle of Songs puzzle, the Ancient Cistern/Sandship directional door puzzles,
and the Lanayru Mining Facility switches puzzle.

options.label: Peatrice Conversations
options.description: How many times you need to talk to Peatrice before she calls you "darling" and you can start Peater's quest.

options.label: Demise Count
options.description:
Determines how many demises appear in the final fight of the game.
**WARNING**: Enabling more than one makes the fight very difficult.
**DOUBLE WARNING**: Enabling more than 3 demises produces a lot of lag and can make the game unplayable.

options.label: BiT Patches
options.description:
Changes how the Back in Time (BiT) glitch works.
**Disable BiT**: Makes it impossible to activate BiT.
**Vanilla**: Keeps the vanilla game behaviour where BiT is possible but Eldin BiT (and others) will still crash.
**Fix BiT Crashes**: Does not load some arcs to make all areas accessible in BiT.
**WARNING**: All 3 files must be filled BEFORE activating BiT otherwise this will not work.

options.label: Fill Dowsing on White Sword
options.description: If enabled, obtaining the Goddess White Sword will unlock rupee, crystal, treasure and goddess cube dowsing.

options.label: Full Wallet Upgrades
options.description:
If enabled, wallets you find throughout the game will already be filled with Rupees.
E.g. Finding the Giant Wallet will add 4000 Rupees to your Rupee counter.

options.label: Ammo Availability
options.description:
Determines the number of locations where ammo refills can be found.
**Scarce**: Ammo will only be available from chance-based drops and Rupin's Gear shop.
**Vanilla**: Ammo will appear when breaking pots and barrels in the same way as the vanilla game.
**Useful**: Ammo pots will be added in key places near checks requiring a specific ammo to reduce back-tracking.
**Plentiful**: Ammo pots will be added next to all Bird Statues.

options.label: Upgraded Skyward Strike
options.description:
If enabled, the Skyward Strike will be fully upgraded for all swords (excluding Practice Sword).
This increases the reach and the charge speed of the Skyward Strike.

options.label: Faster Air Meter Drain
options.description: If enabled, the air meter depletes twice as fast when under water.

options.label: Heart Drops
options.description:
If enabled, heart flowers will spawn and hearts may drop from defeated enemies, broken pots, broken barrels,
cut grass, and digging spots.

options.label: Damage Multiplier
options.description:
Determines the overall damage multiplier.
**Normal Mode** (default) damage is x1.
**Hero Hode** (new game +) damage is x2.
At x12 or higher, the hot cave in Eldin Volcano logically requires Fireshield Earrings to traverse."

options.label: Starting Sword
options.description:
Select which sword to start with.
The remaining upgrades will be shuffled into the item pool.

options.label: Starting Tablet Count
options.description:
The number of tablets to start with.
Tablets are selected randomly and the remainder are randomized as progress items.

options.label: Starting Gratitude Crystal Packs
options.description: How many gratitude crystal packs to start with.

options.label: Starting Empty Bottles
options.description:
Determines how many empty bottles start in your pouch.
**WARNING**: If you start with more pouch items than pouch slots, the extra items will become usable after
finding additional pouches.

options.label: Starting Heart Containers
options.description: Determines how many heart containers to start with.

options.label: Starting Heart Pieces
options.description: Determines how many heart pieces to start with.

options.label: Starting Tadtone Count
options.description: How many groups of Tadtones to start with.

options.label: Random Starting Item
options.description:
Gives you a random progression item at the start of the game in addition to any starting items.
This includes: Bow, Beetle, Slingshot, Digging Mitts, Pouch, Bomb Bag, Clawshots, Whip, Gust Bellows,
Water Dragon's Scale, Fireshield Earrings, Goddess's Harp and Spiral Charge.

options.label: Start with Hylian Shield
options.description:
If enabled, you will start with the Hylian Shield in your pouch.
**WARNING**: If you start with more pouch items than pouch slots, the extra items will become usable after
finding additional pouches.
Hylian Shield will always be placed in the first pouch slot.

options.label: Start with Full Wallet
options.description:
If enabled, you will start with a full wallet.
This changes based on the number of starting wallets and extra wallets.

options.label: Start with Max Bugs
options.description: If enabled, you will start with 99 of each type of bug.

options.label: Start with Max Treasures
options.description: If enabled, you will start with 99 of each type of treasure.

options.label: Archipelago Hint Distribution
options.description:
Determines what hints are placed throughout the world.
**Standard**: The standard hint distribution.
**Junk**: 0 Fi hints, and only junk hints on gossip stones.

Note that this distribution is different from the original randomizer's hint distribution option.
Archipelago hints in game are placed differently than the original randomizer's hints.

options.label: Song Hints
options.description:
Determines how hints appear on songs.
**None**: Silent Realm rewards will be hinted on Gossip Stones.
**Basic**: the song text indicates if beating the trial rewards a progress item.
**Advanced**: the song text indicates if beating the trial rewards a SotS, junk or potientially required item.
**Direct**: the song text states the reward for beating the trial directly.

options.label: Chest Dowsing
options.description:
Determines the main quest (top) dowsing option.
**Vanilla**: dowsing points to Trial Gates and the Sandship
    (after obtaining the necessary song or Sea Chart first).
**All Chests**: dowsing points to all chests (regardless of their contents).
**Progress Items**: dowsing only points to chests containing progress items
    (Goddess Chests must be activated by their respective Goddess Cube before being dowsable)).

options.label: Allow Dowsing in Dungeons
options.description:
If enabled, dowsing will be re-enabled in dungeons and other dungeon-like areas like the Great Tree and
Waterfall Cave.

options.label: Past Impa Stone of Trials Hint
options.description:
If enabled, Impa in Hylia's Temple to give a hint to the location of the Stone of Trials.
Does not appear if the Stone of Trials is a starting item.

options.label: Separate Cube SotS
options.description:
If enabled, when a SotS hint points to a Goddess Chest, the hint will change to indicate this and display
which of the cube progress regions is SotS.

If the precise hints option is enabled, it will display the exact Goddess chest and cube.

options.label: Precise Item Hints
options.description:
If enabled, item hints will indicate the exact location within a region that is being hinted.
If disabled, only the region will be hinted.
This applies to item hints ONLY.

options.label: Precise Hints
options.description:
If enabled, hints will indicate the exact location within a region that is being hinted.
If disabled, only the region will be hinted.
This applies to item hints, SotS hints, path hints, and entrance hints.

options.label: Explicit Hints
options.description:
If enabled, Fi hints and gossip stones hint text will be as explicit as possible.
For a more immersive game, keep this off.

options.label: Breath Link
options.description: When you run out of stamina, everyone with breath link enabled does. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.label: Progression Balancing
options.description:
Algorithm for moving progression items into earlier spheres to make the gameplay experience a bit smoother.
The higher the value, the more frontloaded the world is.

options.label: Game Version
options.description: Items and checks not available on the chosen version will not be included.

options.label: Game Difficulty
options.description:
Set the ingame difficulty for all missions:
- Casual: Unlimited saves, All Mission Story guides available, No surveillance cameras, Less enforcers, Forgiving combat, More items are legal to carry, NPCs are less attentive to sounds.
- Professional: Unlimited saves, All Mission Story guides available, Surveillance cameras active, Cameras alert guards if illegal activity is spotted, Combat is challenging but fair.
- Master: One save per mission, No Mission Story guides available, Extra surveillance cameras, Extra enforcers, Ruthless and demanding combat, Bloody eliminations ruin disguises, NPCs are more attentive to sounds.

options.label: Enable Itemsanity
options.description: Add a check for each unique item that can be picked up

options.label: Split Itemsanity
options.description: Split the checks from itemsanity by map ("Itempickup - Crowbar" becomes "Itempickup - ICA Facility - Crowbar", "Itempickup - Paris - Crowbar", "Itempickup - Sapienza - Crowbar" etc.)

options.label: Enable Disguisesanity
options.description: Add a check for each unique disguise that can be found in each level

options.label: Max Itemsanity and Disguisesanity checks per Level
options.description:
The maximum number of Itemsanity and Disguisesanity checks enabled in each level.
If set to 0, no maximum is enforced.

options.label: Enable Target Checks
options.description: Add a check for each Target to be eliminated

options.label: Remove Goal Level checks
options.description:
When goal is set to level_completion or contract_collection_level_completion, excludes or removes all sanity-checks in the Goal-Level
- Keep: Keep all checks without modification.
- Exclude: Adds the checks to the list of excluded checks, preventing progression items to be placed there.
- Remove: Completely removes the checks.

options.label: Random Complications
options.description: Should random Complications be assigned to each Level. For each level, a random number of complications between min_number_of_complications and max_number_of_complications is chosen (Note: Carpathian Mountains will always remain vanilla.)

options.label: Min Number of Complications
options.description: The minimum number of Complications to be assigned to a Level if Random Complications is active

options.label: Max Number of Complications
options.description: The maximum number of Complications to be assigned to a Level if Random Complications is active

options.label: Included Hitman 1 Levels
options.description:
Include Locations from the following Hitman 1 Levels in the Location Pool
valid options: ica_facility, paris, sapienza, marrakesh, bangkok, colorado, hokkaido

options.label: Included Hitman 2 Levels
options.description:
Include Locations from the following Hitman 2 Levels in the Location Pool
valid options: hawkes_bay, miami, santa_fortuna, mumbai, whittleton_creek, isle_of_sgail

options.label: Included Hitman 2 DLC Levels
options.description:
Include Locations from the following Hitman 2 Expansion Levels in the Location Pool
valid options: new_york, haven_island

options.label: Included Hitman 3 Levels
options.description:
Include Locations from the following Hitman 3 Levels in the Location Pool
valid options: dubai, dartmoor, berlin, chongqing, mendoza, carpathian_mountains, ambrose_island

options.label: Excluded Items
options.description:
List of Items to not be shuffled the multiworld. 
Selected Items cannot be obtained ingame. 
Also accepts Itemgroups (ex.: "Agency Pickup - Any", "Starting Location - Any")

options.label: Excluded Starting Items
options.description:
List of Items to not be shuffled into the multiworld. 
Selected Items will always be unlocked ingame. 
Also accepts Itemgroups (ex.: "Agency Pickup - Any", "Starting Location - Any")
If an item is in both excluded_items and excluded_starting_items, excluded_starting_items takes priority.

options.label: Prioritized Filler Items
options.description:
List of Items to always be shuffled into the multiworld.
Selected Items will be included before any other non-progression Item, ensuring they are not left out if there are more items than checks.
Also accepts Itemgroups (ex.: "Agency Pickup - Any", "Starting Location - Any")

options.label: Enable Item Packages
options.description:
Adds multiple Item Packages one for each type of item (Pistol, Poison, Explosive etc.). 
When starting a mission with a package equipped, all unlocked 
and concealable items of that type will be added to 47's pocket. 

The "in_inventory" option adds the packages directly to your starting inventory.
The "in_itempool" options adds the packages to the itempool and shuffles them to any check in the multiworld.

options.label: Include Sniper Assassin Weapons
options.description:
Include the Snipers from the Sniper Assassin gamemode in the itempool, making them usable in normal missions.
Only available on game version HITMAN 3

options.label: Starting Level
options.description: Which level is unlocked from the start. If the selected level is not included in the "included_x_locations"options, it will be added to it.

options.label: Goal
options.description:
The goal condition for your Archipelago run.
-level_completion: requires beating a specific level with a specific rating 
-contract_collection: shuffles a number of "Contract Piece" items into the item pool and requires the collection of them to instantly goal
-contract_collection_level_completion: requires beating a specific level with a specific rating, after collecting a certain number of Contract Pieces from the item pool to unlock that level
-number_of_completions: forces Contract Pieces to only be placed on beating each level with a specific rating and requires the collection of a number of them to instantly goal

options.label: Goal Level Rating
options.description:
When goal is set to contract_collection_level_completion or level_completion, which rating the goal level needs to be completed with to win.
When goal is set to number_of_completions, which rating each level needs to be completed with to gain a Contract Piece.

options.label: Goal Level
options.description: When goal is set to level_completion or contract_collection_level_completion, which level is the goal. If the selected level is not included in the "included_x_locations" options, it will be added to it.

options.label: Goal Amount
options.description: When the goal is set to number_of_completions, how many levels must be beaten with the selected rating to award the goal.

options.label: Required Contract Pieces
options.description: When the goal is set to contract_collection or contract_collection_level_completion, how many contract pieces are shuffled into the item pool and are required to be collected to award the goal.

options.label: Number of Additional Contract Pieces
options.description: When the goal is set to contract_collection or contract_collection_level_completion, how many additional contract pieces are added in the item pool.

options.label: Levels with completion checks
options.description:
Add a check for beating each of the listed levels, regardless of Rating
valid options: all, ica_facility, paris, sapienza, marrakesh, bangkok, colorado, hokkaido, hawkes_bay, miami, santa_fortuna, mumbai, whittleton_creek, isle_of_sgail, new_york, haven_island, dubai, dartmoor, berlin, chongqing, mendoza, carpathian_mountains, ambrose_island

options.label: Levels with Silent Assassin checks
options.description:
Add a check for beating each of the listed levels with a Silent Assassin Rating
valid options: all, ica_facility, paris, sapienza, marrakesh, bangkok, colorado, hokkaido, hawkes_bay, miami, santa_fortuna, mumbai, whittleton_creek, isle_of_sgail, new_york, haven_island, dubai, dartmoor, berlin, chongqing, mendoza, carpathian_mountains, ambrose_island

options.label: Levels with Suit Only checks
options.description:
Add a check for beating each of the listed levels without using disguises
valid options: all, ica_facility, paris, sapienza, marrakesh, bangkok, colorado, hokkaido, hawkes_bay, miami, santa_fortuna, mumbai, whittleton_creek, isle_of_sgail, new_york, haven_island, dubai, dartmoor, berlin, chongqing, mendoza, carpathian_mountains, ambrose_island

options.label: Location Modifiers
options.description:
Modifies Various aspects about location generation. You can add as many modifiers as you want.

- **Lock task lines** - Makes task lines require an item to be unlocked. Task lines #1-3 are always unlocked.
- **Lock operator lines** - Makes operator lines require an item to be unlocked.
- **Lock operator levels tab** - Makes the operator levels tab require an item to be unlocked.

options.label: Blueprint Shapes
options.description:
Choose which set of shapes rewards the player with blueprint points.

If tetragonal shapes are chosen, **Regular**, **Hard**, and **Insane** use the corresponding scenario's set.
If hexagonal shapes are chosen, all of those three options use the hexagonal scenario's set.
**Randomized** generates a random set of 3 to 5 different blueprint shapes.

You can also put in a list of custom blueprint shapes. See this game's option guides for more information.

options.label: Item Pool Modifiers
options.description:
Modifies what items your world puts into the item pool. You can add as many modifiers as you want.
