to clear the game

options.label: Boss Crystals
options.description: If enabled it will place 6 of the Dheim crystals on the act 2 bosses

options.label: Crystal Count
options.description:
Number of Dheim Crystals required to access Death Heim, 
if Pool Crystal is disabled this value should not exceed 6

options.label: Max Crystals
options.description:
Total Number of Dheim Crystals in the Pool
Does nothing if you don't have Dheim Crystals as part of your goal

options.label: Population Goal Count
options.description:
Total Population needed to reach the population goal,
Does nothing if you don't have population goal set

options.label: Halve Construction Wait Time
options.description:
Reduces the amount of time it takes for construction phases to begin
enable if you want a slightly faster game

options.label: Level Count
options.description:
Amount of Level Up items added into the pool. 
This is seperate from the Level Up locations that are checks.
a lower number may result in a slower and harder run

options.label: Random Level Requirement
options.description: Randomizes the level requirement to enter each first act of an action stage.

options.label: Max Level Requirement
options.description:
Maximum required level to access a non death heim action stage
does nothing if you don't have Random Level Requirement enabled
This value should not exceed Level Count option

options.label: Flame Sword
options.description:
Adds a flame sword that is normally only in Aitos Act 1 as a permanent upgrade into the item pool
This does tend to make the game easier.

options.label: Arrow Count
options.description: Adds permanent arrow upgrades into the pool which increase the damage of your arrows

options.label: Include Traps
options.description: Includes Traps (Only one made so far) Into the Filler item pool

options.label: Catraiser
options.description: Meow!

options.label: Randomize Music
options.description: Randomized the Music that plays on each map

options.label: Randomize Colors
options.description: Randomized Color Pallettes for many things in the game

options.label: Randomize Enemies
options.description: Randomized Enemies within an action stage

options.label: Randomize Orb Drops
options.description: Randomized Items Dropped From Orbs

options.label: Randomize Lairs
options.description: Randomized Monster Lairs

options.label: Closed Forest
options.description:
On - Kokiri Sword & Deku Shield are required to access the Deku Tree, and completing the Deku Tree is required to access the Lost Woods Bridge Exit.
Deku Only - Kokiri boy no longer blocks the path to the Bridge but Mido still requires the Kokiri Sword and Deku Shield to access the tree.
Off - Mido no longer blocks the path to the Deku Tree. Kokiri boy no longer blocks the path out of the forest.

options.label: Kakariko Gate
options.description:
Closed - The gate will remain closed until Zelda's Letter is shown to the guard.
Open - The gate is always open. The Happy Mask Shop will open immediately after obtaining Zelda's Letter.

options.label: Door of Time
options.description:
Closed - The Ocarina of Time, the Song of Time and all three Spiritual Stones are required to open the Door of Time.
Song only - Play the Song of Time in front of the Door of Time to open it.
Open - The Door of Time is permanently open with no requirements.

options.label: Zora's Domain
options.description:
Closed - King Zora obstructs the way to Zora's Fountain. Ruto's Letter must be shown as child Link in order to move him in both time periods.
Closed as child - Ruto's Letter is only required to move King Zora as child Link. Zora's Fountain starts open as adult.
Open - King Zora has already mweeped out of the way in both time periods. Ruto's Letter is removed from the item pool.

options.label: Sleeping Waterfall
options.description:
Closed:
Sleeping Waterfall obstructs the entrance to Zora's Domain. Zelda's Lullaby must be played in order to open it.

Open: 
Sleeping Waterfall is always open. Link may always enter Zora's Domain and Zelda's Lullaby is not required to enter Zora's Domain.

options.label: Jabu-Jabu
options.description:
Closed - A fish is required to open Jabu-Jabu's mouth.
Open - Jabu-Jabu's mouth opens without the need for a fish.

options.label: Lock Overworld Doors
options.description: Adds locks to all wooden overworld doors, requiring specific small keys to open them.

options.label: Fortress Carpenters
options.description:
Sets the state of the carpenters captured by Gerudo in Gerudo Fortress, and with it the number of guards that spawn.
Normal - All 4 carpenters are required to be saved.
Fast - Only the bottom left carpenter requires rescuing.
Free - The bridge is repaired from the start, and Nabooru cannot spawn.
Only Normal is compatible with the Gerudo Fortress Key Ring.

options.label: Rainbow Bridge
options.description:
Alters the requirements to open the bridge to Ganon's Castle.
Vanilla - Obtain the Shadow Medallion, Spirit Medallion and Light Arrows.
Always open - No requirements.
Stones - Obtain the specified amount of Spiritual Stones.
Medallions - Obtain the specified amount of medallions.
Dungeon rewards - Obtain the specified total sum of Spiritual Stones or medallions.
Dungeons - Complete the specified amount of dungeons. Dungeons are considered complete after stepping in to the blue warp after the boss.
Tokens - Obtain the specified amount of Gold Skulltula Tokens.
Greg - Find Greg the Green Rupee.

options.label: Rainbow Bridge Stones Required
options.description:
If Rainbow Bridge is set to Stones, this is how many Spiritual Stones are required to open it.
If the Greg Modifier is not set to Reward, the max will be 3.

options.label: Rainbow Bridge Medallions Required
options.description:
If Rainbow Bridge is set to Medallions, this is how many medallions are required to open it.
If the Greg Modifier is not set to Reward, the max will be 6.

options.label: Rainbow Bridge Dungeon Rewards Required
options.description:
If Rainbow Bridge is set to Dungeon Rewards, this is how many dungeon rewards are required to open it.
If the Greg Modifier is not set to Reward, the max will be 9.

options.label: Rainbow Bridge Dungeons Required
options.description:
If Rainbow Bridge is set to Dungeons, this is how many completed dungeons are required to open it.
If the Greg Modifier is not set to Reward, the max will be 8.

options.label: Rainbow Bridge Skull Tokens Required
options.description: If Rainbow Bridge is set to Tokens, this is how many Gold Skulltula Tokens are required to open it.

options.label: Rainbow Bridge Greg Modifier
options.description:
If Rainbow Bridge is enabled, Greg will count toward the bridge requirement goal.
Off - Greg won't count toward the bridge requirement.
Reward - Greg will count toward the bridge requirement and be considered in the logic.
Wildcard - Greg will count toward the bridge requirement but will not be considered in the logic.

options.label: Ganon's Trials
options.description:
Sets the number of Ganon's Trials required to dispel the barrier.
Skip - No trials are required and the barrier is already dispelled.
Set Number - Select a number of trials that will be required. The required trials will be chosen randomly.

options.label: Ganon's Trials Count
options.description: Sets how many of Ganon's Trials are required to dispel the barrier.

options.label: Triforce Hunt
options.description:
Pieces of the Triforce of Courage have been scattered across the world. Find them all to finish the game! 
If this option is enabled, Ganon's Boss Key will not be shuffled and the Light Arrow Cutscene (LACS) will revert to its vanilla behavior.
When the required amount of pieces has been found, the game will save and credits will roll.
Afterward, you can load back into the game to receive Ganon's Boss Key if you desire to beat Ganon.

options.label: Triforce Hunt Pieces Total
options.description: Specify an exact number of Triforce Pieces to add to the item pool. If the item pool is out of space, no more Triforce Pieces will be added.

options.label: Triforce Hunt Pieces Required Percentage
options.description: The percentage of Triforce Pieces that will be required to complete the game.

options.label: Shuffle Songs
options.description:
Shuffles songs into the item pool.
Off - Songs will appear at their vanilla locations.
Song Locations - Songs will only appear at locations that normally teach songs.
Dungeon rewards - Songs appear after beating a major dungeon boss.
    The 4 remaining songs are located at:
    - Zelda's Lullaby location
    - Ice Cavern's Serenade of Water location
    - Bottom of the Well Lens of Truth location
    - Gerudo Training Ground Ice Arrows Location
Anywhere - Songs can appear at any location.

options.label: Shuffle Tokens
options.description:
Shuffles Gold Skulltula Tokens into the item pool. This means Gold Skulltulas can contain other items as well.
Off - GS tokens will not be shuffled.
Dungeons - Only shuffle GS tokens that are within dungeons.
Overworld - Only shuffle GS tokens that are outside of dungeons.
All Tokens - Shuffle all 100 GS tokens.

options.label: Night Skulltulas Expect Sun's Song
options.description: All Gold Skulltulas that require nighttime to appear will only be expected to be collected after getting Sun's Song.

options.label: Shuffle Kokiri Sword
options.description:
Shuffles the Kokiri Sword into the item pool.
This will require the use of Deku Sticks until the Kokiri Sword is found.

options.label: Shuffle Master Sword
options.description:
Shuffles the Master Sword into the item pool.
If you haven't found the Master Sword before facing Ganon, you won't receive it during the fight.

options.label: Shuffle Child's Wallet
options.description:
Enabling this shuffles the Child's Wallet into the item pool.
You will not be able to carry any rupees until you find a wallet.

options.label: Shuffle Ocarinas
options.description:
Enabling this shuffles the Fairy Ocarina and the Ocarina of Time into the item pool.
This will require finding an Ocarina before being able to play songs.

options.label: Shuffle Ocarina Buttons
options.description:
Enabling this shuffles the Ocarina buttons into the item pool.
This will require finding the buttons before being able to use them in songs.

options.label: Shuffle Swim
options.description:
Shuffles the ability to Swim into the item pool.
The ability to swim has to be found as an item (you can still go underwater if you use the Iron Boots).
If you enter a water entrance without swim you will be respawned on land to prevent infinite death loops.
If you void out in Water Temple you will immediately be kicked out to prevent a softlock.

options.label: Shuffle Weird Egg
options.description:
Shuffles the Weird Egg from Malon into the item pool. Enabling Skip Child Zelda disables this feature.
The Weird Egg is required to unlock several events:
  - Zelda's Lullaby from Impa
  - Saria's Song in Sacred Forest Meadow
  - Epona's Song and chicken minigame at Lon Lon Ranch
  - Zelda's Letter for Kakariko gate (if Kakariko Gate is set to Closed)
  - Happy Mask Shop side quest

options.label: Shuffle Gerudo Membership Card
options.description:
Shuffles the Gerudo Membership Card into the item pool.
The Gerudo Membership Card is required to enter the Gerudo Training Ground, opening the gate to Haunted Wasteland and the Horseback Archery minigame.

options.label: Shuffle Fishing Pole
options.description: Shuffles the fishing pole into the item pool. The fishing pole is required to play the fishing pond minigame.

options.label: Shuffle Deku Stick Bag
options.description: Shuffles the Deku Stick bag into the item pool. The Deku Stick bag is required to hold Deku Sticks.

options.label: Shuffle Deku Nut Bag
options.description: Shuffles the Deku Nut bag into the item pool. The Deku Nut bag is required to hold Deku Nuts.

options.label: Shuffle Freestanding Items
options.description:
Freestanding rupees & hearts are shuffled to random items. Freestanding heart pieces and small keys are already shuffled by default.
Off - Freestanding rupees & hearts will not be shuffled.
Dungeons - Only freestanding rupees & hearts that are within dungeons will be shuffled.
Overworld - Only freestanding rupees & hearts that are outside of dungeons will be shuffled.
All - Shuffle all freestanding rupees & hearts.

options.label: Shuffle Shops
options.description: Shuffle shop items amongst the different shops.

options.label: Shuffle Shops Item Amount
options.description: If Shuffle Shops is on, set how many shop items in each shop will be replaced by an entirely random item with a random price.

options.label: Shuffle Shops Minimum Price
options.description:
If Shuffle Shops is on, set the minimum price of randomized shop items. Final price will be rounded down to multiples of 5.
Shuffled vanilla shop items will keep their vanilla price regardless of what's chosen here.

options.label: Shuffle Shops Maximum Price
options.description:
If Shuffle Shops is on, set the maximum price of randomized shop items. Final price will be rounded down to multiples of 5.
If this is set below the minimum, this option will be set to whatever the minimum is set to.
Shuffled vanilla shop items will keep their vanilla price regardless of what's chosen here.

options.label: Shuffle Fish
options.description:
Shuffles various fish in the game. The Hylian Loach is not included.
Off - Fish will not be shuffled. No changes will be made to fish behavior.
Pond - Only the fishing pond's fish will be shuffled. Catching a fish in the fishing pond will grant a reward, and there are 15 fish for each age.
Overworld - Only fish in generic grottos and Zora's domain will be shuffled. These fish will need a bottle in order to scoop them up.
All - All fish will be shuffled.

options.label: Shuffle Scrubs
options.description:
Shuffles Deku Scrub merchants in the game.
Off - Scrubs will not be shuffled. The 3 Scrubs that give one-time items in the vanilla game (POH, Deku Nut capacity, and Deku Stick capacity) will not spawn.
One-Time Only - Only the 3 Scrubs that give one-time items in the vanilla game are shuffled.
All - All Scrubs are shuffled.

options.label: Shuffle Scrubs Minimum Price
options.description: If Shuffle Scrubs is on, set their minimum price. Final price will be rounded down to multiples of 5.

options.label: Shuffle Scrubs Maximum Price
options.description:
If Shuffle Scrubs is on, set their maximum price. Final price will be rounded down to multiples of 5.
If this is set below the minimum, this option will be set to whatever the minimum is set to.

options.label: Shuffle Beehives
options.description: Shuffle all beehives.

options.label: Shuffle Cows
options.description: Randomize what cows will give when playing Epona's Song for them for the first time.

options.label: Shuffle Pots
options.description:
Pots will drop a randomized item the first time they're broken and collected. This does not include the flying pots.
With this option enabled, Ganon's boss key door is moved further up the stairs to allow access to the pots before obtaining Ganon's Boss Key.
Off - Pots will not be shuffled.
Dungeons - Only shuffle pots that are within dungeons.
Overworld - Only shuffle pots that are outside of dungeons.
All Pots - Shuffle all pots.

options.label: Shuffle Crates
options.description:
Large and small crates will drop a randomized item the first time they're broken and collected.
Off - Crates will not be shuffled.
Dungeons - Only shuffle crates that are within dungeons.
Overworld - Only shuffle crates that are outside of dungeons.
All Crates - Shuffle all crates.

options.label: Shuffle Trees
options.description:
Trees will contain randomized items which are dropped the first time the player rolls into one.
Trees will have a special appearance when carrying randomized items.

Some trees are dependent on Link's age, such as some trees in Hyrule Field.
Two trees at Hyrule Castle are only shuffled with No Logic.

options.label: Shuffle Merchants
options.description:
This setting governs if the Bean Salesman, Medigoron, Granny and the Carpet Salesman sell a random item.
Beans Merchant Only - Only the Bean Salesman will have a check, and a pack of Magic Beans will be added to the item pool.
All But Beans - Medigoron, Granny and the Carpet Salesman will have checks.
All - Apply both effects.

options.label: Shuffle Merchants Minimum Price
options.description: If Shuffle Merchants is on, set their minimum price. Final price will be rounded down to multiples of 5.

options.label: Shuffle Merchants Maximum Price
options.description:
If Shuffle Merchants is on, set their maximum price. Final price will be rounded down to multiples of 5.
If this is set below the minimum, this option will be set to whatever the minimum is set to.

options.label: Shuffle Frog Song Rupees
options.description: Shuffle the purple rupee rewards from the frogs in Zora's River. If this is turned off, only the Song of Storms and Frog Minigame rewards are shuffled.

options.label: Shuffle Adult Trade Items
options.description: Adds all adult trade quest items to the pool. If this is turned off, only the Claim Check is in the pool.

options.label: Shuffle Boss Souls
options.description:
Shuffles 8 boss souls (one for each blue warp dungeon). A boss will not appear until you collect its respective soul.
On + Ganon will also hide Ganon and Ganondorf behind a boss soul.

options.label: Shuffle Fairies in Fountains
options.description:
Shuffle fairies in fountain locations.
This includes the sets of fairies found in Ganon's Castle and Desert Colossus.

options.label: Shuffle Gossip Stone Fairies
options.description: Shuffle fairies from Gossip Stone locations.

options.label: Shuffle Bean Fairies
options.description: Shuffle fairies from Magic Bean locations.

options.label: Shuffle Fairy Spots
options.description:
Shuffle fairy spots. These are spots where a big fairy is revealed by a song.

This excludes Gossip Stones and Magic Bean locations.

options.label: Shuffle Grass
options.description:
Grass/Bushes will drop a randomized item the first time they're cut and collected.
Off - Grass/Bushes will not be shuffled.
Dungeons - Only shuffle grass/bushes that are within dungeons.
Overworld - Only shuffle grass/bushes that are outside of dungeons.
All Grass/Bushes - Shuffle all grass/bushes.

options.label: Shuffle Dungeon Rewards
options.description:
Shuffles the location of Spiritual Stones and medallions.
Off - Spiritual Stones and medallions will be given in their vanilla location from their respective boss.
End of Dungeons - Spiritual Stones and medallions will be given as rewards for beating major dungeons. Link will always start with one stone or medallion.
Any Dungeon - Spiritual Stones and medallions can only appear inside any dungeon.
Overworld - Spiritual Stones and medallions can only appear outside of dungeons.
Anywhere - Spiritual Stones and medallions can appear anywhere.

options.label: Maps and Compasses
options.description:
Start with - You will start with Maps & Compasses from all dungeons.
Vanilla - Maps & Compasses will appear in their vanilla locations.
Own Dungeon - Maps & Compasses can only appear in their respective dungeon.
Any Dungeon - Maps & Compasses can only appear inside any dungeon.
Overworld - Maps & Compasses can only appear outside of dungeons.
Anywhere - Maps & Compasses can appear anywhere in the world.

options.label: Ganon's Castle Boss Key
options.description:
Vanilla - Ganon's Boss Key will appear in the vanilla location.
Anywhere - Ganon's Boss Key can appear anywhere.
LACS - These settings put the boss key on the Light Arrow Cutscene location, from Zelda in Temple of Time as adult, with differing requirements:
- Vanilla: Obtain the Shadow Medallion and Spirit Medallion.
- Stones: Obtain the specified amount of Spiritual Stones.
- Medallions: Obtain the specified amount of medallions.
- Dungeon rewards: Obtain the specified total sum of Spiritual Stones or medallions.
- Dungeons: Complete the specified amount of dungeons. Dungeons are considered complete after stepping into the blue warp after the boss.
- Tokens: Obtain the specified amount of Gold Skulltula Tokens.

options.label: Ganon's Castle Boss Key Stones Required
options.description:
If Ganon's Castle Boss Key is set to Stones, this is how many Spiritual Stones are required to open it.
Once the required amount is reached, the boss key will be granted through the Light Arrow cutscene in the Temple of Time.
If the Greg Modifier is not set to Reward, the max will be 3.

options.label: Ganon's Castle Boss Key Medallions Required
options.description:
If Ganon's Castle Boss Key is set to Medallions, this is how many medallions are required to open it.
Once the required amount is reached, the boss key will be granted through the Light Arrow cutscene in the Temple of Time.
If the Greg Modifier is not set to Reward, the max will be 6.

options.label: Ganon's Castle Boss Key Dungeon Rewards Required
options.description:
If Ganon's Castle Boss Key is set to Dungeon Rewards, this is how many dungeon rewards are required to open it.
Once the required amount is reached, the boss key will be granted through the Light Arrow cutscene in the Temple of Time.
If the Greg Modifier is not set to Reward, the max will be 9.

options.label: Ganon's Castle Boss Key Dungeons Required
options.description:
If Ganon's Castle Boss Key is set to Dungeons, this is how many dungeon completions are required to open it.
Once the required amount is reached, the boss key will be granted through the Light Arrow cutscene in the Temple of Time.
If the Greg Modifier is not set to Reward, the max will be 8.

options.label: Ganon's Castle Boss Key Skull Tokens Required
options.description:
If Ganon's Castle Boss Key is set to Tokens, this is how many Gold Skulltula Tokens are required to open it.
Once the required amount is reached, the boss key will be granted through the Light Arrow cutscene in the Temple of Time.

options.label: Ganon's Castle Boss Key Greg Wildcard
options.description:
If Ganon's Castle Boss Key is enabled, Greg will count toward the LACS goal.
Off - Greg will not count toward the LACS goal requirement.
Reward - Greg will count toward the LACS goal and be considered in the logic.
Wildcard - Greg will count toward the LACS goal but not be considered in the logic.

options.label: Small Key Shuffle
options.description:
Vanilla - Small Keys will appear in their vanilla locations. You start with 3 keys in Spirit Temple MQ because the vanilla key layout is not beatable in logic.
Own Dungeon - Small Keys can only appear in their respective dungeon. If Fire Temple is not a Master Quest dungeon, the door to the Boss Key chest will be unlocked.
Any Dungeon - Small Keys can only appear inside any dungeon.
Overworld - Small Keys can only appear outside of dungeons.
Anywhere - Small Keys can appear anywhere in the world.

options.label: Gerudo Fortress Key Shuffle
options.description:
Vanilla - Thieves' Hideout Keys will appear in their vanilla locations.
Any Dungeon - Thieves' Hideout Keys can only appear inside any dungeon.
Overworld - Thieves' Hideout Keys can only appear outside of dungeons.
Anywhere - Thieves' Hideout Keys can appear anywhere in the world.

options.label: Boss Key Shuffle
options.description:
Vanilla - Boss Keys will appear in their vanilla locations.
Own Dungeon - Boss Keys can only appear in their respective dungeon.
Any Dungeon - Boss Keys can only appear inside any dungeon.
Overworld - Boss Keys can only appear outside of dungeons.
Anywhere - Boss Keys can appear anywhere in the world.

options.label: Key Rings
options.description:
Keyrings will replace all small keys from a particular dungeon with a single keyring that awards all keys for its associated dungeon.

Off - No dungeons will have their keys replaced with keyrings.

Count - A specified amount of randomly selected dungeons will have their keys replaced with keyrings.

Selection - Hand select which dungeons will have their keys replaced with keyrings.

Selecting key ring for dungeons will have no effect if Small Keys are set to Vanilla.

If Gerudo Fortress Carpenters is set to Normal, and Gerudo Fortress Keys is set to anything other than Vanilla, then the maximum amount of Key Rings that can be selected by Count will be 9. Otherwise, the maximum amount of Key Rings will be 8.

options.label: Key Rings Count
options.description: If "Count" is selected for the Key Rings option, this is the count that will be used. If 9 is selected and Gerudo Fortress Keys don't meet the specified requirements, this option will be set to 8.

options.label: Gerudo Fortress Keyring
options.description: Only used if Key Rings option is set to "Selection". Will only work if Gerudo Fortress Keys meet the specified requirements.

options.label: Forest Temple Keyring
options.description: Only used if Key Rings option is set to "Selection"

options.label: Fire Temple Keyring
options.description: Only used if Key Rings option is set to "Selection"

options.label: Water Temple Keyring
options.description: Only used if Key Rings option is set to "Selection"

options.label: Spirit Temple Keyring
options.description: Only used if Key Rings option is set to "Selection"

options.label: Shadow Temple Keyring
options.description: Only used if Key Rings option is set to "Selection"

options.label: Bottom of the Well Keyring
options.description: Only used if Key Rings option is set to "Selection"

options.label: Gerudo Training Ground Keyring
options.description: Only used if Key Rings option is set to "Selection"

options.label: Ganon's Castle Keyring
options.description: Only used if Key Rings option is set to "Selection"

options.label: Big Poe Target Count
options.description: The Poe collector will give a reward for turning in this many Big Poes.

options.label: Skip Child Zelda
options.description: Start with Zelda's Letter and the item Impa would normally give you and skip the sequence up until after meeting Zelda. Disables the ability to shuffle Weird Egg.

options.label: Skip Epona Race
options.description: Epona can be summoned with Epona's Song without needing to race Ingo.

options.label: Complete Mask Quest
options.description: Once the Happy Mask Shop is opened, all masks will be available to be borrowed.

options.label: Skip Scarecrow's Song
options.description:
Start with the ability to summon Pierre the Scarecrow. Pulling out an Ocarina in Pierre's locations will automatically summon him.
With Shuffle Ocarina Buttons enabled, you'll need at least two Ocarina buttons to summon him.

options.label: Link's Pocket
options.description:
Sets the starting item in Link's pocket.
Dungeon Reward - Starts you with a random dungeon reward.
Advancement - Starts you with a random major item.
Anything - Starts you with a random item.
Nothing - Starts you with nothing in Link's pocket.
CAUTION: When "Shuffle Dungeon Rewards" is set to "Off" or "End of Dungeons," this option will be forced to "Dungeon Reward."

options.label: Start with Kokiri Sword
options.description: Start with the Kokiri Sword in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Master Sword
options.description: Start with the Master Sword in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Deku Shield
options.description: Start with a Deku Shield in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Ocarina
options.description: Start with an Ocarina in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Stick ammo
options.description:
Start with some Deku Sticks in your inventory.
This option does nothing when "Shuffle Deku Stick Bag" is enabled.

options.label: Start with Nut ammo
options.description:
Start with some Deku Nuts in your inventory.
This option does nothing when "Shuffle Deku Nut Bag" is enabled.

options.label: Start with Magic Beans
options.description: Start with a pouch of Magic Beans in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Zelda's Lullaby
options.description: Start with Zelda's Lullaby in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Epona's Song
options.description: Start with Epona's Song in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Saria's Song
options.description: Start with Saria's Song in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Sun's Song
options.description: Start with Sun's Song in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Song of Time
options.description: Start with Song of Time in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Song of Storms
options.description: Start with Song of Storms in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Minuet of Forest
options.description: Start with Minuet of Forest in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Bolero of Fire
options.description: Start with Bolero of Fire in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Serenade of Water
options.description: Start with Serenade of Water in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Requiem of Spirit
options.description: Start with Requiem of Spirit in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Nocturne of Shadow
options.description: Start with Nocturne of Shadow in your inventory.

options.label: Start with Prelude of Light
options.description: Start with Prelude of Light in your inventory.

options.label: Full Wallets
options.description: Start with a full wallet. All wallet upgrades come filled with rupees.

options.label: Bombchu Bag
options.description:
None - Bombchus have vanilla behavior, and any Bombchu requirement is filled by Bomb Bag + a renewable source of Bombchus.

Single Bag - Bombchus require their own bag to be found before use. 5 of them are added to the pool (6 if the Carpet Merchant is shuffled). The first Bombchu Bag you find will be a Bag containing 20 chus, and subsequent bags will be replaced with Bombchu Ammo refills. Once found, they can be replenished at shops selling refills, Bombchu Bowling and the carpet merchant. Bombchu Bowling is opened by obtaining the Bombchu Bag.

Progressive Bags - 3 Bombchu Bags are added to the pool, and the first one will unlock Bombchus with a capacity of 20. The second one will upgrade this capacity to 30, and the final one will upgrade this capacity to the usual 50.

Bombchu Bowling is opened by obtaining the first Bombchu bag.

options.label: Bombchu Drops
options.description:
Once you obtain a Bombchu Bag, refills will sometimes replace Bomb drops that would spawn.
If you have Bombchu Bag disabled, you will need a Bomb Bag and existing Bombchus for Bombchus to drop.

options.label: Blue Fire Arrows
options.description: Ice Arrows act like Blue Fire, making them able to melt red ice.

options.label: Sunlight Arrows
options.description: Light Arrows can be used to light up the sun switches instead of using the Mirror Shield.

options.label: Roc's Feather
options.description:
Adds Roc's Feather to the item pool. Roc's Feather is a custom item granting the player a jump on demand. 
The jump can also be used when already in midair. Roc's Feather is not considered by logic.

options.label: Infinite Upgrades
options.description:
Adds upgrades that hold infinite quantities of items (bombs, arrows, etc.).
Progressive - The infinite upgrades are obtained after getting the last normal capacity upgrade.
Condensed Progressive - The infinite upgrades are obtained as the first capacity upgrade (doesn't apply to the infinite wallet or to infinite magic).

options.label: Skeleton Key
options.description: Adds a new item called the Skeleton Key, it unlocks every door locked by a small key.

options.label: Slingshot and Bow Can Break Beehives
options.description: Allows Slingshot and Bow to break beehives when Beehive Shuffle is turned on.

options.label: Starting Age
options.description:
Decide whether to start as child Link or adult Link.
Child Link starts in Link's House in Kokiri Forest.
Adult Link starts in the Temple of Time.
CAUTION: When "Closed Forest" is set to "On" or "Door of Time" is set to closed with either "Shuffle Dungeon Rewards" set to "Off" or "Shuffle Ocarinas" set to "Off,"
this option will be forced to child.

options.label: Shuffle 100 GS Reward
options.description:
Shuffle the item the cursed rich man in the House of Skulltula gives you when you have collected all 100 Gold Skulltula Tokens.
You can still talk to him multiple times to get Huge Rupees.

options.label: Ice Trap Count
options.description: Specify an exact number of Ice Traps to add to the item pool. If the item pool is out of space, no more will be added.

options.label: Ice Trap Filler Replacement Count
options.description: Specify a percentage of filler items to replace with Ice Traps.

options.label: True No Logic
options.description:
Turn off logic completely.
Generation will fail if this is enabled and allow_true_no_logic is not set to true in the host.yaml.

options.label: Shuffle Tycoon Wallet
options.description: Enabling this adds an extra Progressive Wallet to the pool and adds a new 999 capacity tier after Giants Wallet.

options.label: Enable All Tricks and Glitches
options.description: Bypass the individual trick or glitch selections below and enable all of them.

options.label: Item Pool
options.description:
Sets how many major items appear in the item pool.
Balanced - Original item pool.
Plentiful - Extra major items are added to the pool.
Scarce - Some excess items are removed, including health upgrades.
Minimal - Most excess items are removed.

options.label: Medallion Locked Trials
options.description: Doors to trials will be barred until their corresponding medallion is acquired.

options.label: Starting Hearts Count
options.description: Specify the number of starting hearts Link will have. Modifies how many Heart Containers and Heart Pieces are in the pool.

options.label: Shop Affordable Prices
options.description:
After choosing a price range, set it to the affordable amount based on the wallet requirement.
Affordable prices per tier: starter=1, adult=100, giant=201, tycoon=501
Use this to enable wallet tier locking, but making shop items not as expensive as they could be.

options.label: Scrub Affordable Prices
options.description:
After choosing a price range, set it to the affordable amount based on the wallet requirement.
Affordable prices per tier: starter=1, adult=100, giant=201, tycoon=501
Use this to enable wallet tier locking, but making shop items not as expensive as they could be.

options.label: Merchant Affordable Prices
options.description:
After choosing a price range, set it to the affordable amount based on the wallet requirement.
Affordable prices per tier: starter=1, adult=100, giant=201, tycoon=501
Use this to enable wallet tier locking, but making shop items not as expensive as they could be.

options.label: Hint Clarity
options.description:
Sets the clarity of hints.

Obscure - Hints tell you the tier of an item but not what it is.
Hookshot > Important Item

Ambiguous (Experimental) - Hints tell you what the item could be based on its item group.
Light Arrows > Magic Arrows
(Quality of groups depends on game)

Clear - Hints tell you exactly what the item is and opens the hint in the hint tab for free.
Hints will not be automatically opened for Gossip Stones as not all Gossip Stone hints point
to a location directly.
Boomerang > Boomerang

options.label: Gossip Stone Hints
options.description:
Choose whether Gossip Stones should give hints and what is required to read them. Currently,
Gossip Stones can only give out location hints and junk hints. Way of the Hero and Barren hints
are not yet implemented.

None - Gossip Stones do not give out hints.

Need Nothing - Gossip Stones give out hints and you don't need anything to read them.

Need Truth - Gossip Stones give out hints but you need Mask of Truth to read them.

Need Stone - Gossip Stones give out hints but you need Stone of Agony to read them.

options.label: ToT Altar Hint
options.description:
Reading the Temple of Time altar as child will tell you the locations of the Spiritual Stones.
Reading the Temple of Time altar as adult will tell you the locations of the medallions,
as well as the conditions for building the Rainbow Bridge and getting the Boss Key for Ganon's Castle.

options.label: Ganondorf Hint
options.description:
Talking to Ganondorf in his boss room will tell you the location of the Light Arrows and Master Sword.
If this option is enabled and Ganondorf is reachable without these items,
Gossip Stones will never hint them.

options.label: Sheik Light Arrow Hint
options.description:
Talking to Sheik inside Ganon's Castle will tell you the location of the Light Arrows.
If this option is enabled and Sheik is reachable without Light Arrows,
Gossip Stones will never hint the Light Arrows.

options.label: Boss Key Hints
options.description: Navi will tell you where the boss key can be found when prompted at a dungeon's boss door.

options.label: Dampe's Diary Hint
options.description: Reading the diary of Dampé the Gravekeeper as adult will tell you the location of a Progressive Hookshot.

options.label: Greg the Green Rupee Hint
options.description: Talking to the chest game owner after buying a key will tell you the location of Greg the Green Rupee.

options.label: Saria's Hint
options.description: Talking to Saria either in person or by playing Saria's Song will tell you the location of a Progressive Magic Meter.

options.label: Mido's Hint
options.description: Talking to Mido as child will tell you the location of the Kokiri Sword.

options.label: Frog Ocarina Game Hint
options.description: Standing near the pedestal for the frogs in Zora's River will tell you the reward for the frogs' Ocarina game.

options.label: Ocarina of Time Hint
options.description: Sheik in the Temple of Time will tell you the item and song on the Ocarina of Time.

options.label: Biggoron's Hint
options.description: Talking to Biggoron will tell you the item he will give you in exchange for the Claim Check.

options.label: Big Poes Hint
options.description: Talking to the Poe Collector in the Market Guardhouse while adult will tell you what you receive for handing in Big Poes.

options.label: Chickens Hint
options.description: Talking to Anju as child will tell you the item she will give you for delivering her cuccos to the pen.

options.label: Malon Hint
options.description:
Talking to Malon as adult will tell you the item on "Link's Cow",
the cow you win from beating her time on the Lon Lon Obstacle Course.

options.label: Horseback Archery Hint
options.description:
Talking to the Horseback Archery Gerudo in Gerudo Fortress, or the nearby sign,
will tell you what you win for scoring 1000 and 1500 points on Horseback Archery.

options.label: Fishing Pole Hint
options.description: Talking to the fishing pond owner without the fishing pole will tell you its location.

options.label: Scrub Hint Text
options.description: Business scrubs will reveal the identity of what they're selling.

options.label: Merchant Hint Text
options.description:
Merchants will reveal the identity of what they're selling.
(Shops are not affected by this setting)

options.label: 10 GS Hint
options.description: Talking to the Cursed Resident in the Skulltula House who is saved after 10 tokens will tell you the reward.

options.label: 20 GS Hint
options.description: Talking to the Cursed Resident in the Skulltula House who is saved after 20 tokens will tell you the reward.

options.label: 30 GS Hint
options.description: Talking to the Cursed Resident in the Skulltula House who is saved after 30 tokens will tell you the reward.

options.label: 40 GS Hint
options.description: Talking to the Cursed Resident in the Skulltula House who is saved after 40 tokens will tell you the reward.

options.label: 50 GS Hint
options.description: Talking to the Cursed Resident in the Skulltula House who is saved after 50 tokens will tell you the reward.

options.label: 100 GS Hint
options.description: Talking to the Cursed Resident in the Skulltula House who is saved after 100 tokens will tell you the reward.

options.label: Mask Shop Hint
options.description: Reading the mask shop sign will tell you rewards from showing masks at the Deku Theatre.

options.label: Goal
options.description:
The goal to accomplish in order to complete the seed.
- Prime Sentinel : Blow up the giant orb in the Ancient City (4 TTi / Large Explosion Device)
- Prime Smugglers : Pay to leave (4 TTi / 250k Terra Tokens / 5 Solar Quartz)
- Prime Wardens : Gather 10 Keys to leave

options.label: Tavern Themes
options.description: Open the upstairs tavern theme selector and shuffle 9 cosmetic theme unlocks into filler. Jester and Halloween are excluded. Requires all four Lost Eternia Shards DLC parts to play this seed. The original tavern remains available.

options.label: Trap Percentage
options.description: Percentage of ordinary filler rewards replaced by traps. Zero disables traps.

options.label: Enabled Traps
options.description: Choose traps that replace filler. Ready or Not skips a build phase after a completed wave; other traps wait for combat.

options.label: DeathLink Mode
options.description: Choose hero death or crystal destruction when DeathLink is enabled.

options.label: Hero Skin Items
options.description: Hero skins as items. Selected heroes only; DLC ownership required.

options.label: Hero Skins Unlocked
options.description: Hero skins available from the start. Selected heroes only; DLC ownership required.

options.label: Extra Campaign Maps
options.description: Extra free campaign maps for the Crystalline Dimension goal.

options.label: Crystalline Dimension Difficulty
options.description: Required difficulty for the four Shards maps and Crystalline Dimension.

options.label: Crystalline Dimension Unlock
options.description: Choose how Crystalline Dimension is unlocked.

options.label: Shopsanity
options.description: Add 27 purchases alongside the normal tavern shop. Categories open after completing 3, 5, and 7 different campaign maps on any difficulty. A Crystalline Dimension goal adds 9 Platinum purchases after 12 different campaign maps, costing 5/10/20 million mana per column.

options.label: Random Gear Pets
options.description: Allow random gear rewards to include pets, using tavern-shop scaling.

options.label: Progressive Defense Units
options.description: Add six items that each grant 5 extra defense units, up to 30. No Towers Allowed always stays at 0 defense units.

options.label: Check Density
options.description: Choose every wave, milestone waves and victories, or victories only.

options.label: Active Heroes
options.description:
Choose 2-16 heroes. DLC ownership is still required.
apprentice, squire, huntress, monk, adept, countess, ranger, initiate,
barbarian, series_ev, summoner, jester, hermit, gunwitch, warden, guardian.
Include at least one builder. Counterparts may be selected together.

options.label: Skill Shuffle
options.description: Skill shuffle randomizes the ability and defense pool of all enabled heroes. For example a squire can end up with an apprentice tower.

options.label: Skill Shuffle Mode
options.description: Separate: hero abilities and defenses are shuffled separately from each other. Mixed: any ability/defense can be put in either ability/defense slot

options.label: Map Unlock Placement
options.description: Local keeps map items in your DD1 campaign. Global allows them in other players' worlds too.

options.label: Campaign Check Difficulties
options.description: Choose any combination of easy, medium, hard, insane, nightmare, ruthless. Higher clears count for selected lower difficulties.

options.label: Survival Checks
options.description: Add survival checks on enabled campaign maps except Crystalline Dimension.

options.label: Last Survival Check Wave
options.description: Give one check per survival wave from 1 through this wave.

options.label: Challenge Checks
options.description: Add checks for the 12 campaign-map challenges. This is required for the Challenges goal.

options.label: Progressive Difficulty
options.description: Unlock difficulties progressively above starting_difficulty. Include campaign checks at or below your starting difficulty.

options.label: Starting Difficulty
options.description: Starting difficulty with progressive difficulty enabled. Lower difficulties are also unlocked.

options.label: Survival Unlock
options.description: With survival_checks enabled, add three Survival area items, four maps each. Ignored when survival_checks is false. The campaign map must also be unlocked.

options.label: Challenge Unlock
options.description: Challenges have three area items, four maps each, independent of campaign map unlocks.

options.label: Completion Goal
options.description: Choose the completion goal.

options.label: Challenges Required
options.description: Number of different challenge victories required for the challenges goal.

options.label: Maps Required for The Summit
options.description: Campaign victories required to unlock The Summit.

options.label: Experience Multiplier
options.description: Multiply normal experience after the game's bonuses: 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, or 10.

options.label: Level Catch-Up Multiplier
options.description: Heroes below your highest unlocked hero gain experience faster until they catch up. Choose off, 2, 4, 6, 8, or 10.

options.label: Starting Level Count
options.description:
Any AP-unlocked level can be entered. This controls how many are available
at the start of the game. A higher value is easier.

options.label: Required Level Completions
options.description: Satan becomes available after this many level-completion checks.

options.label: Include DLC
options.description: DLC is not supported in this version. Keep this disabled.

options.label: Trials as Checks
options.description:
Add trials as checks. Trials vary in difficulty and can make the seed harder.
disabled: trials off - gem rewards are given two at a time.
enabled: trials on - gems rewards are given individually.

options.label: Focus Scroll
options.description:
Focus Scroll allows you to get orbs from combos to fill your magic meter.
Enabled: Start with Focus Scroll. Disabled: Focus Scroll is added to the item pool.

options.label: Starting Magic
options.description:
Choose which magic medallions you begin with:
neither, light, shadow, or both.

options.label: Early Magic
options.description: Guarantee Light and Shadow Magic appear early in the seed.

options.label: Trap Frequency
options.description:
Add traps - magic drain and poison
Traps replace the "Consumable refill" rewards: none=0%, low=10%, normal=30%, high=50%.

options.label: Skills as Checks
options.description: Add all 31 purchasable skill purchases as checks and shuffle their move unlocks.

options.label: Reveal Skill Rewards
options.description:
Show the AP reward before buying checks.
Requires skills_as_checks: enabled.

options.label: Randomize Minor Enemies (Experimental)
options.description: Randomize minor enemies. Note that this feature is currently unstable and could cause bugs or crashes.

options.label: Show Logic Colors
options.description: World map will show which levels have unlocks in logic or not. This does not account for experience points farming to buy checks. Green = unlocks in logic, red = unlocks are blocked by requirements, blue = all checks are completed in this level

options.label: Campaign Mode
options.description:
How duel-unlock items are placed in the seed.

sequential: each duel's Unlock is locked to the previous duel's Win
            location. Inside each series the chain runs slot 1 -> 2 -> ...
            so the player advances naturally; slot 1 of every series is
            pre-collected.
shuffled:   all 183 unlock items go into the AP pool and the fill
            algorithm scatters them. Slot-1 unlocks are still pre-collected
            so every series tab has at least one playable duel at start.
            (`random` is a reserved key in AP options — using `shuffled`.)

options.label: Goal
options.description:
Win condition for the seed.

any_series_finale: complete the highest-numbered duel of any one of the
                   6 series (YuGiOh #32, GX #32, 5Ds #32, ZEXAL #26,
                   ARC-V #33, or VRAINS #30).
duel_count:        complete N duels in any combination, where N is set by
                   `goal_duel_count`.

options.label: Goal Duel Count
options.description:
Number of duels required to win when goal=duel_count. Capped at 175
(the total named campaign duels in the game).

options.label: Hide Default Cards
options.description:
If on, the client writes 0 to the default-structure-deck-cards static
address at session start so the deck-edit trunk only reflects AP-granted
cards. Otherwise the player keeps the game's starter cards on top of
whatever AP grants. Runtime-only, reverts on game restart.

options.label: Staple Filler Count
options.description:
Number of staple-tagged cards to add to the AP item pool as filler.

Drawn at random (without replacement) from the ~200 staples in
card_list.py. Set to 0 to disable staple filler entirely (DP filler will
pad the remaining slots).

options.label: DP Filler Count
options.description:
Number of Duel Points filler items to add to the pool. Each slot picks
randomly from {1000, 5000, 10000} DP — smaller amounts are pointless given
that even budget shop packs cost a few hundred DP.

options.label: Money Goal
options.description:
How many coupons you need to reach as part of the victory condition
(only applies if Require Money Goal is enabled below).

This snaps to the nearest of the existing money-threshold checks
(1000, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000, 100000, 250000, 500000, or
1000000) -- the location set itself doesn't change, only which one
of those thresholds is required to complete the goal.

options.label: Require Money Goal
options.description: Whether reaching the Money Goal amount is required to win.

options.label: Require All Artifacts
options.description: Whether collecting all 76 artifacts is required to win.

options.label: Require Story Completion
options.description:
Whether finishing the story (either final route: "The Eternal
Shining" or "The Last Step") is required to win.

options.label: Enable Cost of Hope Content
options.description:
Include Cost of Hope DLC content. Currently this adds the two
DLC-exclusive regions (Iron Forest and the CNPP) as region-discovery
locations. Off by default -- only enable this if every player in the
multiworld who could receive one of these checks actually owns the
DLC, since these locations don't exist in the base game.

options.label: Enable Ultimate Edition Items
options.description:
Include the 16 Deluxe/Ultimate Edition and pre-order exclusive
items (PTM Monolith, AR416 Monolith, Riemann, SA-U "Gabion", Hunter,
M860 Monolith, Wanderer Suit, SSP-100M SIRCAA, Mercenary's Light
Suit, Model Competitor, Viper "Monolith", Lullaby, Margach D-12MT,
PSZ-21W Shturm, Veteran, and Tourist Suit) in the item pool. Off by
default -- only enable this if you own the relevant edition, since
these items can't actually be granted without it.

options.label: Enable Traps
options.description:
Include trap items in the pool: Trap - Emission (triggers an
in-game emission when received), Trap - Mutant Ambush (spawns a
mutant near you), and Trap - Lose Money (a coupon penalty). Off by
default -- turn on if you want the added chaos.

options.label: Shuffle Starting Equipment
options.description: Start with a random Blade, Assault, Shot, and Charge

options.label: Exclude Stage 14B's A Rank
options.description: Exclude Stage 14B's A Rank from randomized locations

options.label: Goal
options.description:
- Z1: Complete "Start Journey". Should take a few hours.
(With 2-4x gamespeed).

- Z2: Complete "Continue On".

- Z3: Complete "Start Trek".

- Z4: Complete "Face Judgement" with 50 or -50 reputation.
Should take around a week (with 5-7x gamespeed).

Content from Zones above the goal is not randomised.

options.label: Logic: Vanilla Skill Requirements
options.description:
Respect Vanilla Skill requirements.
e.g. With this on Buy Supplies requires (Combat + Magic) >= 35.
And (maybe more importantly) Chrono/Pyromancy require 150/200 Magic

Progress Bar requirements are ignored.

options.label: Logic: Mana Reduction Actions
options.description:
Makes Actions that reduce Mana Cost a requirement for what they reduce.
It feels so bad to have PM being your block without Hermit
(Also includes Old Shortcut for Talk To Hermit)

options.label: Items: Second Glasses
options.description:

options.label: Items: AP Shop Unlock
options.description:
Requires items to be found to unlock the shop actions below.

With this on, you might not get the shop until after you can
already buy everything, kinda defeating the point.

options.label: Locations: Z1 AP Shop
options.description: Adds 10 buyable items to Z1, ranging from 50 to 200 gold.

(Z2 = 400, Z3 = 600, Z4 = 1000)

options.label: Batch Herbs/Wild Mana 10x
options.description:
Batches Herbs/Wild Mana locations and items 10x.

Herbs/Wild Mana basically give you 300 checks the moment
you can get to them, way more dense than anywhere else in the game.

This cuts down on that, reducing the chance that like 4 important items
are just lying on the forest floor, and also reducing total 'filler'.

options.label: Filler Item: Remove Vanilla 50 Mana Pots
options.description:
Removes the 50 "Z1 - Mana Pot" items from Vanilla from the randomiser.
Makes your ratio of Mana Pots/Starting Gold/Mana nice and even.

options.label: Filler Item: Starting Gold

(instead of one of the filler items above).

options.label: Trap: Death
options.description:
Adds 'Death' traps to the pool, found in your game,
which immediately ends the current loop and triggers a Deathlink.

helping each Lootable to their max in *rough* order of usefulness and zone.

there will be an entry in the log.

The game slows down over time so this helps it feel more even.

Adds +0.1 Exp Multiplier items to the pool, to a total of (value)x.
Multiplicative with the option above.

Skills are easily the most grindy part of the game

UNSUPPORTED: Respect Vanilla Skill and Progress bar
