options.label: Count Beggar Items
options.description: If enabled, items given to the 'Load it up!' guy will count towards your generic Archipelago checks.

options.label: Death Link Severity
options.description:
If death link is enabled, this defines how punishing the death link is for you.
mild: When a death link is triggered, it scrambles your desk with Rotation and Swap traps.
severe: When a death link is triggered, it instantly ends your run and give you a Game Over.

options.label: Tax Trap Amount
options.description: Fixed amount deducted by Tax Trap.

options.label: Trap Weights
options.description:
Set weights for each trap type in the trap pool. 
Supported traps: Tax Trap, Thief Trap, Swap Trap, Rotation Trap, Letter Trap.

options.label: Goals
options.description:
The goals of the seed. Every selected goal must be completed.

Reach Peak: Reach the peak on the ascent level specified by Required Ascent Count

Collect Badges: Collect the number of badges specified by Required Badge Count

24 Karat Badge: Toss the Ancient Idol into The Kiln's lava

Free The Soul: Free the Scoutmaster's soul in [REDACTED]

options.label: Required Ascent Count
options.description:
The ascent level required to complete the Reach Peak goal (0-8)

Higher ascents add more difficulty modifiers and challenges

options.label: Required Badge Count
options.description:
The number of badges required to complete the Complete All Badges goal

There are 54 total badges available in the game

options.label: Progressive Stamina
options.description:
Enable progressive stamina bars

Players start with 25% stamina and unlock 25% more with each upgrade until reaching 100%

options.label: Additional Stamina Bars
options.description:
Enable 4 additional stamina bars beyond the base 100%

Allows players to reach up to 200% total stamina (requires Progressive Stamina to be enabled)

options.label: Item Sanity
options.description:
Controls whether items need to be unlocked before they can appear in loot pools.

When enabled, each item type has a corresponding "Unlock" item in the Archipelago pool.
You must receive that unlock before the item can spawn in-game.
"Acquire" checks also require having the unlock item.

When disabled, all items are available from the start.
"Acquire" checks only require biome access.

This option works independently from Loot Sanity - Item Sanity controls the unlock gating,
while Loot Sanity controls which pools the items get shuffled into.

options.label: Item Spawns
options.description:
Only used when Item Sanity is disabled.

Adds one copy of every item that has an Acquire check to the item pool as a useful item.
Receiving one spawns that item in front of you.

Items that are also sent as filler (berries, snacks, Bing Bong, etc.) are guaranteed one copy
but stay classified as filler. Items that exist as traps (Scorpion, Mandrake, Dynamite)
and Scout's Honor are excluded.

Has no effect when Item Sanity is enabled.

options.label: Loot Sanity
options.description:
Controls which loot pools have their contents shuffled with all available items.

Affected pools will have every AP-tracked item added at equal weight,
meaning any item can drop from any affected source.
Items not yet unlocked (when Item Sanity is on) are excluded.

None: Loot pools are unchanged. Items only appear in their vanilla pools.

Luggage: Luggage (suitcases) across all biomes have their contents shuffled.

Trees and Bushes: Natural sources (berry bushes, mushroom clusters, coconut trees,
willow trees, vines, winterberry trees, nests, cacti, redwoods) have their drops shuffled.

All: Both luggage and natural source pools are shuffled.

The Scout Statue is never affected by this option - see Logical Scout Statue instead.

options.label: Logical Scout Statue
options.description:
When enabled, the Scout Statue will only drop items that
you haven't sent an "Acquire" check for yet.

The available items are filtered by your current biome access (Progressive Mountain count)
and item unlock status (if Item Sanity is enabled).

As you pick up new items and send Acquire checks, the Scout Statue's pool shrinks,
guiding you toward items you still need.

When disabled, the Scout Statue uses the default game loot table.

options.label: Scout Amulet Sanity
options.description:
When enabled, the four Scout amulets (Tenacity, Generosity, Ambition, Initiative) and
Scout's Honor take part in Item Sanity and Loot Sanity like any other item: their Unlock
items join the pool and Loot Sanity may redistribute them.

When disabled they spawn exactly as they do in vanilla, and their Acquire checks only
require reaching the biome they are normally found in.

Their Acquire checks exist either way.

options.label: Multiplayer Only Items
options.description:
Include the multiplayer-only items (Blowgun, Cursed Skull, Scout Effigy, Bugle of Friendship
and Ritual Dagger) in the randomizer. When enabled they can spawn in solo runs too, their
Unlock items join the pool under Item Sanity (or their Item Spawns when Item Sanity is off),
and their Acquire checks exist.

When disabled they behave exactly like vanilla (they only spawn in multiplayer sessions),
no Unlock or Item Spawn items are created for them, and their Acquire checks are removed.
The Last Resort Badge then only requires reaching the Caldera.

The Fanny Pack is not affected by this option since it is part of Progressive Pack.

options.label: Tracker Item Spawning
options.description:
When enabled, clicking an unlocked item in the in-game tracker spawns it in front of you
(with a cooldown). When disabled, the tracker is display-only.

options.label: Disable Multiplayer Badges
options.description:
Exclude multiplayer-only badge checks. These badges are normally earned by cooperating with other players.
These badges include:
    Ultimate Badge
    Clutch Badge
    Participation Badge
    Emergency Preparedness Badge
    First Aid Badge
    Resourcefulness Badge
    Disaster Response Badge
    Applied Esoterica Badge
    Needlepoint Badge
    Happy Camper Badge
    Mentorship Badge
    Last Resort Badge

options.label: Disable Hard Badges
options.description:
Exclude somewhat hard badge checks. These badges include:
    Speed Climber Badge
    Lone Wolf Badge
    Balloon Badge
    Bing Bong Badge
    Hang Gliding Badge
    Competitive Eating Badge
    Rule Zero Badge

options.label: Disable Biome Specific Badges
options.description:
Exclude biome exclusive badge checks. These will not remove the badges involved with completing the biomes.
These badges include:
    Astronomy Badge
    Bundled Up Badge
    Undead Encounter Badge
    Mycoacrobatics Badge
    Web Security Badge
    Cool Cucumber Badge
    Daredevil Badge
    Megaentomology Badge
    Tread Lightly Badge
    Advanced Mycology Badge
    Medieval History Badge
    Exorcist Badge
    Bellringer Badge

options.label: Ring Link
options.description:
When enabled, ring pickups are shared among all players with Ring Link enabled

For PEAK; rings are stamina. Consuming food will send Rings to other players with Ring Link enabled. Poisonous food will send negative rings.

options.label: Hard Ring Link
options.description:
When enabled, ring pickups are shared among all players with Hard Ring Link enabled

Similar to Ring Link, but instead of sending rings when consuming food, rings are sent from certain actions and events.

options.label: Energy Link
options.description:
When enabled, allows sending and receiving energy from a shared server pool

Players can contribute stamina to help others in need

options.label: Trap Link
options.description:
When enabled, traps you receive are also sent to other players with Trap Link enabled

You will also receive any linked traps from other players with Trap Link enabled,
if you have a weight above "none" set for that trap

options.label: Breath Link
options.description: When enabled, if any player in the lobby runs out of stamina, all players with Breath Link enabled get their stamina fully depleted.

options.label: Damage Link
options.description:
When enabled, taking Injury damage sends a Damage Link to other games with Damage Link enabled.

Receiving a Damage Link applies Injury to all players in the lobby.

options.label: Knockback Link
options.description:
When enabled, strong knockback taken by any player is sent to other games with Knockback Link enabled.

Receiving a Knockback Link knocks back all players in the lobby.

options.label: Death Link Behavior
options.description:
Determines what happens when a Death Link is received

Kill Random Player: A random player in your lobby will be killed

Reset to Last Checkpoint: All players will be teleported to the last checkpoint/campfire

options.label: Death Link Send Behavior
options.description:
Determines when Death Links are sent to other players

Any Player Dies: Send Death Link whenever any player in your game dies

All Players Dead: Send Death Link only when all players are dead (game over)

options.label: Trap Fill Percentage
options.description: Replace a percentage of junk items in the item pool with random traps

options.label: Instant Death Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which instantly kills a player

options.label: Items To Bombs Weight

options.label: Pokemon Trivia Trap Weight

options.label: Blackout Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which blacks out the player's screen temporarily

options.label: Spawn Bee Swarm Weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which spawns a swarm of bees

options.label: Berrynana Peel Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which spawns a berrynana peel in front of a player

options.label: Minor Poison Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which applies a weak Poison Affliction to a player

options.label: Poison Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which applies a Poison Affliction to a player

options.label: Deadly Poison Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which applies a strong Poison Affliction to a player

options.label: Tornado Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which spawns a tornado on a player

options.label: Swap Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which swaps the position of all players

options.label: Nap Time Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which applies a Drowsy Affliction to a player

options.label: Hungry Hungry Camper Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which applies a Hunger Affliction to a player

options.label: Balloon Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of receiving a trap which ties a bundle of balloons to a player

options.label: Slip Trap Weight

options.label: Inventory Item Hints Percentage Chance

options.label: Block Sanity
options.description: Implemented without logic.

options.label: Randomize Abilites
options.description:
If ability randomizer should be enabled. (former movement rando)
If enabled will shuffle all abilities in Abilities Included into the item pool
They will need to be unlocked to be used.

options.label: Randomize Level Elements

Whether level elements (also called level gimmicks) should be shuffled into the item pool.

options.label: Randomize Time, BETA (logic sometimes problematic)

Will make your starting time be separated into discreet section and you will start with one.

options.label: Randomize Boss Health

This number is reduced by 1 for each Boss Health item you receive

options.label: Alternative Goal
options.description:
Which goal to have
Bowser      : Beat 8-C
Starcoin    : Have starcoin = requirement
Hintmovie   : Have all hintmovie locations
All_levels  : Beat x amount of levels to goal, uses goal_level_unlock

options.label: Logic Difficulty
options.description:
If hard will make locations that require glitches to be in logic,
recommended to normal.
Easy                 : Logic should mostly account for "vanilla" solutions, trivial platforming.
Normal (Recommended) : Still easy platforming, but some creative solutions will be in logic.
Hard                 : Logic expects you to do very hard skips

options.label: Logic Outside Power-ups
options.description: If on then solutions involving bringing powerups from outside the level will be considered in logic.

options.label: Starting World
options.description: Select the world you want to start with, or keep it at random.

options.label: World 9 Unlock Condition
options.description:
BETA
Select in which way world 9 levels will be unlocked
Linear      : 9-1 req 20 SC, 9-2 req e0 SC, etc.
Gaussian    : The unlocking will be a gaussian distribution with mean = 80 SC and standard deviation = 40 SC
Unlocked    : Not locked

options.label: Hint Movie Shop Price Logic
options.description:
This option changes how logic for hint movies is decided.
free (recommended)            : Hint movies does not cost starcoin items, just needs levels to be unlocked.
ordered                       : Logic assumes you buy the movies in order, doing otherwise messes with logic (and can very rarely make you seed unbeatable).
all                           : Logic assumes you have all star coins before a movie is in logic. This causes them to be very late spheres.
progressive (not implemented) : Groups hintmovies together and requires all in that group to be bought before unlocking next group.

options.label: Hint Hint Movies
options.description: Free hints all hint movies when you reach peace castle.

options.label: Starcoin shop multiplier
options.description: A multiplier for what a star coin is worth when buying from the hint movie store.

options.label: Make World Completion Priority
options.description:
Makes half world completion and world completion priority locations -> they will have a good item.
Causes generation failures ~0.5% if enabled.

options.label: Important Early Items
options.description: Marks some important items as early, resulting in a more fun playthrough.

options.label: Worlds Unlocks
options.description:
Separate : Most worlds requires 2 items to unlock secnond half of (except world9), lessens risk for getting BK:ed
Single : All worlds are unlocked with a single item
Progressive : You unlock world in order of 1 to 9
Unlocked : All worlds start unlocked

options.label: Levels Unlocks
options.description:
How levels are unlocked in game
Vanilla = levels are unlocked like vanilla
All_unlocked = You start with access to all levels in your world

options.label: Remove Worlds
options.description:
If you enter a world here they will be completly removed from the seed,
They wont have a level item and they will not be able to be unlocked
Useful if you want a smaller multi-world

options.label: Amount Support items received from ap-items

Modifiers are temporary buffs / debuffs gained from filler / traps.
The length of all modifiers are multiplied by this percentage.
Modifiers still clears on death.

off : Vanilla

off_respect_plando : Like off except if you have any level_shuffle_plando they will be respected

nolock : Places no restriction on level placement
lock_types : Airships to airships, castles to castles, towers to towers
lock_positions : Towers, Castles and Airships

options.description:
Allows you to plando level shuffle
syntax:

    Coin-1 : 9-7
This will replace 1-1 with 1-2 and Coin-1 with 9-7, effectively removing it from the randomizer
Be mindful, some levels cannot be moved and some require specific conditions.
E.g. 3-4 cannot replace 3-5 due to inability to reach button,
Levels with secret exits must replace each-other,
see a full lists of limitations in the docs.

An option to remove up to 5 levels by plando:ing them to replace coin levels
Will not work for levels with seceret exits
