Glyphsanity: Adds these Glyphs into the check pool. Albus and Barlowe's Glyphs spawn
 in their boss room after defeating them if you miss them during the fight.

options.label: Randomize Dropped Glyphs
options.description:
Randomizes Glyphs that can be dropped by enemies.
Shuffled: Randomizes dropped enemy Glyphs only into other non-required Glyphs.
Glyphsanity: Adds these Glyphs into the check pool.

options.label: Glyph Drop Rate Multiplier
options.description: Multiplier for the drop rate of enemy Glyphs.

options.label: Randomize Castle Doors
options.description: Randomizes where the area transition doors in the Castle lead to.

options.label: Save on Area Exit
options.description: If enabled, exiting to the World Map will fully heal you and automatically save the game.

options.label: Logic Tricks
options.description:
Tricks that can be individually enabled to make logic harder.
You can view the full list of available tricks and documentation on them from
the Game Page document.
validKeys: Monastery Cubes Glyph With Secare Union
Minera Prison Island Final Area With Double Jump
Tymeo Mountains Spike Room With Arma Felix
Mechanical Tower Lowest Gear Room with Double Jump
default: Monastery Cubes Glyph With Secare Union

options.label: Shuffle Enemy Drops
options.description: Randomizes what items enemies drop, and what the drop chances are.

options.label: Weight Shuffled Drops
options.description:
Weights enemy drops so that rare drops are more likely to be good items.
This only applies when enemy drops are Shuffled.

options.label: Randomized Quests
options.description:
Specify which Quests have random items. Active quests that normally do not give items will if they are set here.
Inlcuding Quests which do not normally give you rewards will give you an item.
You can type any individual quest name, as well as the following shortcuts.
Additionally, you can type the name of a Villager to include all of that villager's Quests.

Shortcuts:
Requires Item: Any Quest which requires you to turn in an item.
Defeat Enemies: Any Quest which requires you to defeat specific enemies.
Simple: Any Quest which requires you to do some sort of specific task.
Has Reward: Any Quest which directly gives you a reward for completing it.
No Reward: Quests which only send items to the shop and do not give you an item as a reward.
All: Enables ALL quests

options.label: Unlock All Quests
options.description: If enabled, all Quests will be unlocked by default, and you can complete them out of order.

options.label: Randomize Quest Key Items
options.description:
If enabled, quest-related Key Items will be randomized into the item pool, and the original location is
added as a check. Otherwise, they will be at their vanilla locations.

options.label: Excluded Quests
options.description:
Specify Excluded randomized quests from the above option. Excluded Quests will still be randomized, but will always be your own junk items.
The same shortcuts from the above option apply.

options.label: Excluded No-hit chests
options.description:
Specify bosses that should not include their No-Hit chest in the location pool,
if no-hit chests are enabled.

options.label: Goal
options.description:
The goal for your game.
Throne Room: Get to the Throne Room and defeat Menace there.
Abyss: Open the path to the Mine of Judgment, then defeat Menace in the Abyss.

options.label: Soma Replaces Menace
options.description: Replaces Menace with Soma-Dracula

options.label: Remove Money Gates
options.description: Removes the gates that require you to own a specific amount of money.

options.label: No Drawing Seals
options.description: Removes the requirement to draw Magic Seals to defeat bosses.

options.label: Early Seal 1
options.description: Places Magic Seal 1 early in your own game to prevent getting stuck early.

options.label: Reveal Map
options.description: Start with the entire map visible.

options.label: Starting Weapon
options.description:
The weapon you start the game with.
Random Base: Start with a random base-level weapon
Random Any: Start with any random weapon
You can also choose to start with any specific weapon.

options.label: Reveal Hidden Walls
options.description: Automatically destroys/reveals all breakable walls

options.label: Fix Luck
options.description:
Fixes how the Luck stat is applied.
With the fix applied, each point of luck gives +0.1% to any drop.
Without the fix, each point of luck is +0.04% for souls, 0.25% for items.

options.label: Boost Speed
options.description: Increases Soma's base walking speed by 33%

options.label: One-Screen Mode
options.description: Allows the entire game to be played with only the bottom screen. Press Select to view the map.

options.label: Soul Randomizer
options.description:
Randomizes Enemy souls.
Disabled: Enemy souls are unchanged.
Shuffled: Enemy souls will be shuffled amongst each other. Souls that unlock things are unchanged.
Soulsanity: Enemy soul drops can be anything, even important items or non-souls. You can change the expected soul rarity with Soulsanity level.

options.label: Soulsanity Level
options.description:
The maximum tier of soul rarity that have Locations on them.
Rare souls always expect you to have the Soul Eater Ring.

options.label: Guranteed Souls
options.description:
The specified Souls will be guaranteed to have at least one copy in the item pool. Unspecified souls can still be randomly selected from the soul pool.
You can also use Common, Uncommon, or Rare to add all souls of that rarity.

options.label: Random Starting Warp Room
options.description: Randomizes which Warp Room is unlocked by default.

options.label: Open Drawbridge
options.description: If enabled, the drawbridge in Lost Village will start open instead of closed.

options.label: Shop Randomizer
options.description: Randomizes Hammer's shop items.

options.label: Drop Shuffle
options.description: Randomizes items dropped by enemies

options.label: Experience Percentage
options.description: What percentage of EXP enemies give you. This is a percent of their original EXP amount.

options.label: Soul Drop Percentage
options.description: Percentage applied to an enemy's base chance of dropping their soul.

options.label: Area Music Randomizer
options.description: Randomizes area music.

options.label: Boss Music Randomizer
options.description: Randomizes boss music.

options.label: Soul Wall Randomizer
options.description: Randomizes which souls are needed to break the red Soul Barriers.

options.label: Shuffle Synthesis Souls
options.description: Randomizes which souls are required for Synthesis crafting.

options.label: Free Bat
options.description: Removes Bat Company's MP cost

options.label: Passive Soul Eater Ring
options.description:
If enabled, you will gain the bonus from the Soul Eater Ring without needing to equip it
as long as you have at least one in your inventory.

options.label: Gate Items
options.description:
Defines how the 4 metal switch gates act.
Normal: Normal behavior. Gates can only be opened by pressing the respective button.
Add Keys: The same as normal behavior, but also adds keys to the item pool that can open the gate from the other side.
Buttonsanity: Adds keys to each gate, and the corresponding button will grant a check.

options.label: Hard Mode
options.description:
Puts the game in Hard Mode. Enemies are tougher, sometimes have additional properties, but drop rates are increased.
There are no checks exclusive to Hard Mode.

options.label: Boss Shuffle
options.description: Randomizes boss fights.

options.label: Seal Shuffle
options.description:
Randomizes which seal is required for each boss/door.
Early Seal 1 will guarantee Flying Armor to always use Seal 1.

options.label: Randomize Seal Patterns
options.description: Randomizes the drawn pattern for Magic Seals, as well as their rotation.

options.label: Menace Condition
options.description:
This Condition is required to be met before you can fight Menace.
None: None
Throne Room: Defeat Aguni in the Throne Room (If Goal is set to throne room, this will be set to None.)
Garden: Avoid the bad ending in the Garden of Madness
Bosses: Defeat all available bosses

options.label: Mine Condition
options.description:
This Condition is required to be met before you can enter the Mine of Judgment.
None: None
Throne Room: Defeat Aguni in the Throne Room (If Goal is set to throne room, the mine and the Abyss will be inaccessible.)
Garden: Avoid the bad ending in the Garden of Madness
Bosses: Defeat all available bosses

options.label: Garden Condition
options.description:
This Condition is required to be met before Celia appears in the Garden of Madness.
None: None
Throne Room: Defeat Aguni in the Throne Room (This condition is considered unreachable if Goal is set to throne room)
Bosses: Defeat all available bosses

options.label: Start with Doppelganger
options.description: If enabled, you're start with the Doppelganger Soul already acquired.

options.label: Randomize Doors
options.description: Randomizes where the area transition doors lead to.

options.label: Randomize Seal Details
options.description:
Randomizes how many Nodes exist per magic seal, and how many lines need to be drawn to complete the seal.
This won't do anything unless Randomize Seal Patterns is also enabled.
Simple: Each seal will have + or - 2 nodes and + or - 3 lines compared to the original seal.
Chaos: Each seal can have between 2 and 10 nodes and 1-20 lines.
Chaos Weighted: Similar to Chaos, but the number of nodes is balanced more closely to the number of lines.

options.label: No Logical Grinding
options.description:
If enabled, you won't be expected to grind any souls for progression, and required Souls will be guaranteed
to be in the item pool. This applies to Soul walls, Bone Ark, and Skeleton Ape.
This option does not affect Soulsanity, as Soulsanity does not expect non-check soul drops to be gotten.

options.label: Randomize Weapon Stats
options.description:
Applies a modifer to the stats of each weapon, ranging from a 50% decrease to a 50% increase.
Normal: Weapon stats are unchanged
Consistent: The same modifier will apply to all weapons of the same type, with 5% variance
Chaos: All weapons will roll a random stat modifier.

options.label: Randomize Weapon Properties
options.description:
Randomizes the secondary element of all weapons.
Additionally, there is a small chance for weapons to have an extra special modifier applied.

options.label: Randomize Weapon Stats
options.description:
Randomizes the primary element of all weapons.
Normal: Leaves elements as they normally are.
Consistent: Weapons of the same type will all use the same base element
Chaos: All weapons will have a random base element.

options.label: Goal
options.description:
Larries: Beat the Larries in Chapter 5
Light World: Beat LW Dr. Fetus after collecting the 6 chapter keys
Dark World: Beat DW Dr. Fetus after completing 85 DW levels
Light World Chapter 7: Beat all of Light World Chapter 7
Dark World Chapter 7: Beat all of Dark World Chapter 7
Boss Tokens: Collect all the boss tokens
Bandage: McGuffin hunt to collect all the bandages
Achievements: Obtain X amount of Achievement Tokens

options.label: Boss Requirement
options.description: How many boss keys are required to fight the boss (only affects Chapters 1-5)

options.label: LW Dr. Fetus Requirement
options.description: How many boss keys are required to fight LW Dr. Fetus

options.label: Bandages Amount
options.description:
If your goal is bandages, how many are required to goal
For each chapter enabled there are 11 bandages in LW (8 if its chapter 3) and 9 bandages in DW (12 if its chapter 3)

options.label: Boss Tokens
options.description:
Enable this setting if you want to put boss tokens on all the bosses to require to goal
Disable this setting if you need to collect all the chapter keys to reach your goal (this only applies if your goal is to beat lw/dw chapter 7).
This setting will always be on if goal is boss tokens
Another random chapter with a boss will be added if boss tokens is required but your only chapter is 5

options.label: Boss Token Requirement
options.description: How many boss tokens require to goal

options.label: Bandages
options.description: Enables the bandage collectibles as locations.

options.label: Enable Dark World Levels
options.description:
If the goal is LW Dr. Fetus or LW Chapter 7, enable dark world levels
This setting will always be on if your setting is DW Dr. Fetus or DW Chapter 7

options.label: Chapters
options.description:
Which chapters should be in the pool
Enter any number between 1-7 for the respective chapter to be in the pool
Enter "Random-X" with X being a number between 1-4 random chapter(s)
Enter "Random-X+" with X being a number between 1-6 random chapter(s) with the inclusion of the last 2 chapters
If you enter ["5", "Random-4+"] then chapter 5 and 4 other random chapters will be selected.
If any of the last 3 chapters aren't in the pool, your goal will be boss tokens.
If DW Dr. Fetus is a location, a random number of chapters between 1-5 will be added to assure you can beat at least 85 DW levels.

options.label: Starting Chapter
options.description:
Choose Starting Chapter
If your starting chapter isn't in the list of chapters, a random one from that list will be picked.

options.label: Starting Character
options.description:
Choose Starting Character
If you start in Chapter 6, your character will be Meat Boy
If you start in Chapter 7, your character will be Bandage Girl

options.label: Achievements
options.description: Puts most steam achievements in the pool

options.label: Deathless Achievements
options.description: Puts all deathless achievements in the pool

options.label: Speedrun Achievements
options.description:
Puts all speedrun achievements in the pool
Dark world levels will automatically be enabled if this is turned on.

options.label: Achievement Goals
options.description:
Which achievements should count towards the goal.
If none are present, the normal achievements will be on.
Valid options are "normal", "deathless", "speedrun"
Achievements will be automatically turned on if they are present in this option
This setting does nothing if your goal is NOT achievements.

options.label: Achievement Tokens
options.description:
Tokens needed to reach goal. Max varies by settings:
Normal: 2 base, 2 per chpt 1-6 (12 total), +1 with any chpt 1-5, +1 chpt 7, +2 DW, +1 DW + chpt 6, +1 DW + chpt 7, +3 bandages, +3 bandages + DW
Speedrun: 1 per chpt 1-5 (5 total)
Deathless: 1 per chpt 1-7 (7 total, 14 total with DW)

options.label: Bandage Fill
options.description:
What percentage of the multiworld should the remaining items be bandages.
This setting only works if your goal is bandages

options.label: Death Link Amnesty
options.description: How many deaths should it take to send a DeathLink

options.label: Goal Modes
options.description:
Which game mode victories count as completing the game.
You must reach Canada in ALL of the selected modes to complete your goal.
At least one mode must be selected.

Available modes:
  normal, familiar, rare, short, long, 4jerks, deadlier,
  familiarEX, rareEX, marathon, kepa, 4jerksEX, endless,
  opp, quickdeath, infection, weather, rpg, scepter,
  mutation, infectionEX

Example:
  goal_modes:
    - normal
    - deadlier

options.label: Enabled Modes
options.description:
Which game modes generate per-mode locations (days reached, victory).
Only modes in this list will have their progression tracked as locations.
Goal modes are always enabled regardless of this setting.
More enabled modes = higher milestone caps become accessible.

Available modes:
  normal, familiar, rare, short, long, 4jerks, deadlier,
  familiarEX, rareEX, marathon, kepa, 4jerksEX, endless,
  opp, quickdeath, infection, weather, rpg, scepter,
  mutation, infectionEX

Mode day lengths:
  - 7 days: infectionEX
  - 9 days: short, quickdeath
  - 10 days: infection
  - 12 days: scepter
  - 15 days: normal, familiar, rare, 4jerks, deadlier, familiarEX,
             rareEX, kepa, 4jerksEX, opp, weather, rpg, mutation
  - 25 days: long
  - 30 days: marathon, endless

Example:
  enabled_modes:
    - normal
    - familiar
    - deadlier

options.label: Max Days Per Mode
options.description:
Maximum number of day locations to generate per enabled mode.
Higher values = more locations but longer games.

Note: This is capped by each mode's actual day length:
  - Short/Quick Death: 9 days max
  - Infection: 10 days max
  - Scepter: 12 days max
  - Most modes: 15 days max
  - Long Road: 25 days max
  - Marathon/Endless: 30 days max

options.label: Include Day Start Locations
options.description:
Include per-mode Day Start locations.
Creates a location for starting each day in each enabled mode.

Example: [Normal] Day 1 Start, [Normal] Day 2 Start, etc.

options.label: Include Day Clear Locations
options.description:
Include per-mode Day Clear locations.
Creates a location for completing/surviving each day in each enabled mode.

Example: [Normal] Day 1 Clear, [Normal] Day 2 Clear, etc.

options.label: Include Global Day Start
options.description:
Include global Day Start locations (shared across all modes).
These trigger when you start a new day in ANY mode.

Example: Day 1 Start, Day 2 Start, etc.

Note: Only one check per day number, regardless of mode.

options.label: Include Global Day Clear
options.description:
Include global Day Clear locations (shared across all modes).
These trigger when you complete a day in ANY mode.

Example: Day 1 Clear, Day 2 Clear, etc.

Note: Only one check per day number, regardless of mode.

options.label: Locations Visited Max
options.description:
Maximum locations visited milestone. Set to 0 to disable.
Tracks how many map locations you've explored.

Scaling: Base 20 + 15 per additional enabled mode.
  1 mode  = 20 max    |  5 modes  = 80 max
  10 modes = 155 max  |  21 modes = 320 max

options.label: Locations Visited Interval
options.description: Interval between locations visited milestone locations.

options.label: Kill Milestone Max
options.description:
Maximum kill milestone. Locations are generated at intervals up to this value.
Set to 0 to disable kill milestones.

Intervals: 50-1000 uses 50-kill steps, 1100+ uses 100-kill steps.

Scaling: Base 1000 + 500 per additional enabled mode.
  1 mode  = 1,000 max    |  5 modes  = 3,000 max
  10 modes = 5,500 max   |  21 modes = 11,000 max

options.label: Kill Milestone Interval
options.description:
Interval between kill milestone locations.

Example with max 500:
  every_50  = 10 locations (50, 100, 150... 500)
  every_100 = 5 locations (100, 200, 300, 400, 500)
  every_250 = 2 locations (250, 500)

options.label: Container Milestone Max
options.description:
Maximum container milestone. Set to 0 to disable.

Scaling: Base 80 + 40 per additional enabled mode.
  1 mode  = 80 max     |  5 modes  = 240 max
  10 modes = 440 max   |  21 modes = 880 max

options.label: Container Milestone Interval
options.description:
Interval between container milestone locations.

Example with max 100:
  every_1  = 100 locations
  every_5  = 20 locations
  every_10 = 10 locations
  every_25 = 4 locations

options.label: Toilet Milestone Max
options.description:
Maximum toilet milestone. Set to 0 to disable.

Scaling: Base 10 + 5 per additional enabled mode.
  1 mode  = 10 max    |  5 modes  = 30 max
  10 modes = 55 max   |  21 modes = 110 max

options.label: Toilet Milestone Interval
options.description: Interval between toilet milestone locations.

options.label: Siege Milestone Max
options.description:
Maximum siege survival milestone. Set to 0 to disable.
Sieges are random events where zombies attack your camp at night.

Scaling: Base 5 + 3 per additional enabled mode.
  1 mode  = 5 max     |  5 modes  = 17 max
  10 modes = 32 max   |  21 modes = 65 max

options.label: Siege Milestone Interval
options.description: Interval between siege milestone locations.

options.label: Recruit Milestone Max
options.description:
Maximum recruit milestone. Set to 0 to disable.
Tracks how many characters you've recruited to your party.

Scaling: Base 5 + 3 per additional enabled mode.
  1 mode  = 5 max     |  5 modes  = 17 max
  10 modes = 32 max   |  21 modes = 65 max

options.label: Recruit Milestone Interval
options.description: Interval between recruit milestone locations.

options.label: Weapon Milestone Max
options.description:
Maximum weapon collection milestone. Set to 0 to disable.
Tracks total weapons picked up (cumulative across runs).

Scaling: Base 20 + 10 per additional enabled mode.
  1 mode  = 20 max    |  5 modes  = 60 max
  10 modes = 110 max  |  21 modes = 220 max

options.label: Weapon Milestone Interval
options.description: Interval between weapon milestone locations.

options.label: Include Weapon Categories
options.description:
Include weapon category discovery locations.
These trigger when you find your first weapon of each type.

Categories (13 total):
  Found Handgun, Found Rifle, Found Shotgun, Found Blade,
  Found Explosive, Found Heavy Weapon, Found Blunt Weapon,
  Found Flamethrower, Found Minigun, Found AK-47,
  Found Sledgehammer, Found Fire Axe, Found Bow

options.label: Mode Unlocks in Pool
options.description:
Include game mode unlocks as items in the randomizer pool.

When ON (default):
  - All modes except Normal start LOCKED
  - You must receive mode unlock items to play other modes
  - Adds progression items to the pool

When OFF:
  - All enabled modes are available from the start
  - No mode unlock items in the pool

options.label: Trap Percentage
options.description:
Percentage of filler items that become traps.

Traps include:
  Food Spoiled, Morale Crisis, Ambush, Gas Leak, Weapon Jam,
  Thief, Injury, Car Damage, Argument, Bandits, Bad Omen,
  Bad Weather, Gear Lost, Food Poison, False Hope, Pandora's Box

0 = No traps, 100 = All filler becomes traps

options.label: Starting Area
options.description:
Which area the player starts with access to. 
Without this, you'd be stuck at the hub with nothing to do!
Model Village is not an option since it's the finale area.

options.label: Goal
options.description:
Victory is always when you steal the Golden Bell and bring it home. Goal settings change how it spawns:
only_steal = Simply reach the bell and steal it!
find_bell = The Golden Bell is lost somewhere in the multiworld! Find it before you can steal it.
all_main_tasks = Complete all four area task lists to spawn the Golden Bell.
only_speedrun_tasks = Complete all 'To Do (Quickly!!)' tasks to spawn the Golden Bell.
all_tasks_no_speedrun = Complete all four area task lists as well as the 'To Do (As Well)' task lists to spawn the Golden Bell.
all_tasks = Complete all task lists to spawn the Golden Bell.
four_final_tasks = Complete the final task of each of the four area task lists to spawn the Golden Bell.

options.label: Include NPC Souls
options.description:
When enabled, NPCs won't appear until you receive their soul item.
This adds NPC souls to the item pool and gates NPC-related goals behind them.

options.label: Logically Require NPC Souls
options.description:
This option is only for when NPC Souls are included in the pool. When enabled, generation will think that all NPCs are required in order to complete the goal.
You may be more likely to find them in your seed, which may make the experience more satisfying. NPCs make the final sequence of stealing the bell more difficult and interesting.
WARNING: Only enable this option if you know what you are doing. Many NPCs may not be required in order to complete the goal, and doing so without them will be going out of logic!

options.label: Include Props
options.description:
When enabled, items can't be picked up or dragged until you receive them.
This adds props to the item pool and gates item interactions behind them.
If the find_bell goal is chosen and this option is disabled, the Golden Bell will be the only one added to the pool.

options.label: Include Extra Tasks
options.description:
Include post-game extra challenge tasks as locations.
Must be enabled when choosing either the all_tasks_no_speedrun or all_tasks goal.

options.label: Include Speedrun Tasks
options.description:
Include speedrun challenge tasks (complete areas before noon).
Must be enabled when choosing either the only_speedrun_tasks or all_tasks goal.

options.label: Include Item Pickups
options.description:
Include first-time item pickups as locations (100+ additional checks).
Must be enabled when including prop souls in the pool.

options.label: Include Drag Items
options.description: Include first-time drag item locations (50+ additional checks for heavy/draggable items).

options.label: Include Interactions
options.description: Include interaction locations (ringing bells, spinning windmills, breaking boards, etc.).

options.label: Include Model Church Pecks
Include Milestone Locations
options.description:
Include extra locations for completing all garden tasks, all high street tasks, etc.
- Including extra tasks adds a milestone for completing all To Do (As Well) tasks
- Including speedrun tasks adds a milestone for completing all speedrun tasks

options.label: Include New Tasks
options.description:
Include locations for new tasks created for this archipelago!
Some of these happen naturally throughout gameplay, and some are more involved.
You can view these tasks at any time in-game by pressing F4. New tasks include:
- Break the intro gate
- Drop some mail in the well
- Short out the garden radio
- Lock the groundskeeper IN the garden
- Trap the TV shop owner in the garage
- Break through the boards to the back gardens
- Make the woman fix the topiary
- Pose as a duck statue
- Dress up the bush with both ribbons
- Do some interior redecorating
- Trip the burly man
- Break a pint glass
- Perform at the pub with a harmonica

options.label: Filler Amount: Mega Honk
options.description:
Amount of Mega Honk in the filler pool.
Mega Honk effects - upgraded honking abilities
Level 1: All NPCs react to honk (draws attention) - default behavior enhanced
Level 2: Increased honk detection distance - always heard regardless of distance
Level 3: Scary honk - NPCs drop held items

options.label: Filler Amount: Speedy Feet
options.description: Amount of Speedy Feet in filler pool. Speedy Feet increases your run speed.

options.label: Filler Active: Silent Steps
options.description: Whether or not Silent Steps is in the filler pool. Silent Steps prevents NPCs from hearing your footsteps.

options.label: Filler Amount: A Goose Day
options.description: Amount of A Goose Day in filler pool. A Goose Day causes NPCs to ignore you for 15 seconds.

options.label: Filler Weight: Coins
options.description:
Weight for Coins in the filler pool. Set to 0 to disable this filler.
Please note that if you turn off all traps below, this filler item will be chosen to fill all remaining spots regardless of chosen weight.

options.label: Trap Weight: Tired Goose
options.description: Weight for Tired Goose trap in the filler pool. Set to 0 to disable this trap.

options.label: Trap Weight: Confused Feet
options.description: Weight for Confused Feet trap in the filler pool. Set to 0 to disable this trap.

options.label: Trap Weight: Butterbeak
options.description: Weight for Butterbeak trap in the filler pool. Set to 0 to disable this trap.

options.label: Trap Weight: Suspicious Goose
options.description: Weight for Suspicious Goose trap in the filler pool. Set to 0 to disable this trap.

options.label: Death Link
options.description: When you get caught/shooed, everyone dies. When someone else dies, you drop whatever you're holding and get teleported to the hub.

options.label: Starting Broom
options.description: Select which broom to start with.

options.label: Victory Condition
options.description:
Select the end goal of your game.
[Defeat Briar] Reach the credits screen after defeating the Briar.
[Final Gate] Open the final gate in the top section of the Nexus and interact with the console beyond it. Postgame must be enabled for this, else the goal will revert to Briar.

options.label: Postgame Mode
options.description:
Determines how the Swap upgrade behaves.
Note that even when "Expanded Swap" is available, Swap will not work in almost every room the way it does in the base game. It will be limited to rooms near postgame content, so that you can reach those checks/areas without breaking the rest of the game's logic.
[Disabled] Swap is only used to access the top half of GO, and all postgame areas will be removed from logic.
[Vanilla] Expanded Swap unlocks upon defeating Briar.
[Unlocked] Expanded Swap is automatically available upon receiving the Swap item.
[Progressive] The first Progressive Swap will behave like pre-Briar Swap, and the second is the Expanded Swap.

options.label: Mitra Hint Mode
options.description:
Sets how Mitra's hints work. She gives one free hint and then gives additional hints after defeating bosses.
[None] Mitra does not give any hints.
[Vague] Mitra only tells you the location of a progression item, but not what it is.
[Precise] Mitra tells you the exact location of one of your progression items.
[Precise Hint] Same as Precise, but will be sent out as a hint.

options.label: Small Key Mode
options.description:
Select how the small keys will be handled.
[Unlocked] The key-locked gates in each dungeon will open automatically.
[Small Keys] Small keys act like they do in the original game. Each opens one gate.
[Key Rings] Only one key ring item is required to open every key-locked gate in a dungeon.

options.label: Shuffle Small Keys
options.description:
Select how the small keys or key rings will be randomized. Does nothing when small key mode is set to unlocked.
[Vanilla] The small keys will be placed in the vanilla locations.
[Original Dungeon] The small keys will be shuffled within their own dungeons.
[Own World] The small keys will be shuffled within your own world.
[Any World] The small keys will be shuffled throughout the entire multiworld.
[Different World] The small keys will specifically be shuffled into other players' worlds.

options.label: Shuffle Big Keys
options.description:
Select how the big keys will be randomized.
[Vanilla] The big keys will be placed in the vanilla locations.
[Unlocked] The big key gates will open automatically.
[Own World] The big keys will be shuffled within your own world.
[Any World] The big keys will be shuffled throughout the entire multiworld.
[Different World] The big keys will specifically be shuffled into other players' worlds.

options.label: Base cards in item pool
options.description:
Sets the amount of cards available in the item pool.
If there are not enough locations or card slots available when "Extra cards" is added, this number will automatically get lowered.
This setting will then be used as the actual maximum for card requirements of any big gates in logic.
Special values:
[Vanilla] 37 with postgame disabled, 49 otherwise.
[Auto] Maximum of all in-logic big card gates(postgame gates excluded if postgame is disabled).

options.label: Extra Cards
options.description:
Sets the amount of extra cards in the item pool. Note that this setting combined with "Base cards in item pool"
will never exceed the maximum of 49 cards.

options.label: Split Windmill
options.description:
Select how the Windmill behaves.
[Off] The Windmill behaves as it does in vanilla. Turning it on moves the three statues blocking access to the lategame dungeons.
[On] The Windmill doesn't do anything special, and instead becomes a location. Three items are added to the pool, one for each dungeon statue.

options.label: Include Blue and Happy
options.description:
Select how Blue and Happy activation works
[Off] Blue and Happy behave like in vanilla. You need to complete the gauntlets and open the dams to fight Briar.
[On] The Blue and Happy dams become items that both need to be found to fight Briar. Both gauntlets have random items at the end.

options.label: Fields Secret Paths
options.description: Toggles whether the secret paths towards three of the secret chests in Fields are in logic without Expanded Swap.

options.label: Randomize GO Color Puzzle
options.description:
If enabled, the GO color block puzzle is randomized, and the player needs to beat each of the late game bosses to find the correct solution.
If disabled, the vanilla solution is used, and the dungeons are not logically required to beat the game.

options.label: Shuffle Nexus Gates
options.description:
Determines how nexus gates and warp pads work.
If enabled, nexus gates will become items, and warp pads will become locations.
Nexus gates that are pre-opened are excluded from this.
The "All Except Endgame" option excludes the GO, Blue, and Happy gates / pads.

options.label: Red Grotto Access
options.description:
Select how progression through the Red Grotto dungeon should be handled.
[Progressive] Three Progressive Red Grotto items will be added to the pool, and each will open the next section of the dungeon, in the following order: left, right, top.
[Original Dungeon] Same as above, but the progression items will be restricted to the original dungeon.
[Vanilla] The Red Grotto will open up the same way it does in vanilla. The red tentacles will not be location checks.

options.label: Open Nexus Gates
options.description:
Select which Nexus Gates are open from the start. Street is always open.
[Street Only] Only the Street gate is open.
[Street and Fields] The Street and Fields gates are open.
[Early] The gates for pre-dungeon areas near Fields are also open.
[Random Count] A number of random gates will be open. The number is specified in another option.
[Random Pre-Endgame] Same as above, but the GO, Blue, and Happy gates are excluded.

options.label: Custom Open Nexus Gates
options.description:
Specify specific Nexus Gates to open from the start.
If set, this will override the value of nexus_gates_open.
Note that the Street Nexus Gate will always be open.

options.label: Dustsanity
options.description:
Select if picking up dust counts as a check.
[Off] Dust behaves as in the normal game.
[On] Picking up dust counts as a check the first time it gets picked up by a broom. Dust will appear gold if it has yet to be picked up.

options.label: Rocksanity
options.description:
Select if interacting with rocks counts as a check.
[Off] Rocks behave as in the normal game.
[On] Interacting with rocks sends out a check.

options.label: Shuffle Health Cicadas
options.description:
Select how the health cicadas will be randomized.
[Vanilla] The health cicadas will not be locations.
[Own World] Health cicadas will be locations, and the items will be shuffled within your world.
[Any World] The health cicadas will be shuffled throughout the entire multiworld.
[Different World] The health cicadas will specifically be shuffled into other players' worlds.

options.label: Include Forest Bunny Chest
options.description: Include the chest that forces you to wait almost 2 hours to access it.

options.label: Traps Percentage
options.description: Determines how many filler items will be traps.

options.label: Trap Link
options.description:
If enabled, when you receive a trap, it will send a similar trap out to other players. In a similar vain, other players receiving a trap will send one to you as well.

You will only receive traps with a weight higher than 0.

options.label: Goal
options.description:
Determines the goal of the seed

Biolizard: Finish Cannon's Core and defeat the Biolizard and Finalhazard

Chaos Emerald Hunt: Find the Seven Chaos Emeralds and reach Green Hill Zone

Finalhazard Chaos Emerald Hunt: Find the Seven Chaos Emeralds and reach Green Hill Zone, then defeat Finalhazard

Grand Prix: Win every race in Kart Race Mode (all standard levels are disabled)

Boss Rush: Beat all of the bosses in the Boss Rush, ending with Finalhazard

Cannon's Core Boss Rush: Beat Cannon's Core, then beat all of the bosses in the Boss Rush, ending with Finalhazard

Boss Rush Chaos Emerald Hunt: Find the Seven Chaos Emeralds, then beat all of the bosses in the Boss Rush, ending with Finalhazard

Chaos Chao: Raise a Chaos Chao to win

Minigame Madness: Win a certain amount of each Minigame Trap, then defeat Finalhazard

options.label: Boss Rush Shuffle
options.description:
Determines how bosses in Boss Rush Mode are shuffled

Vanilla: Bosses appear in the Vanilla ordering

Shuffled: The same bosses appear, but in a random order

Chaos: Each boss is randomly chosen separately (one will always be King Boom Boo)

Singularity: One boss is chosen and placed in every slot (one will always be replaced with King Boom Boo)

options.label: Minigame Madness Trap Requirement
options.description:
Determines how many of each Minigame Trap must be won (for Minigame Madness goal)

Receiving this many of a Minigame Trap will allow you to replay that minigame at-will in the Chao World lobby

options.label: Minigame Madness Trap Minimum
options.description:
Determines the minimum number of each Minigame Trap that are created (for Minigame Madness goal)

At least this many of each trap will be created as "Progression Traps", regardless of other trap option selections

options.label: Logic Difficulty
options.description:
What set of Upgrade Requirement logic to use

Standard: The logic assumes the "intended" usage of Upgrades to progress through levels

Hard: Some simple skips or sequence breaks may be required, but no out-of-bounds

Expert: If it is humanly possible, it may be required

options.label: Required Rank
options.description: Determines what minimum Rank is required to send a check for a mission

options.label: Max Emblem Cap
options.description:
Determines the maximum number of emblems that can be in the item pool.

If fewer available locations exist in the pool than this number, the number of available locations will be used instead.

Gate and Cannon's Core costs will be calculated based off of that number.

options.label: Ring Loss
options.description:
How taking damage is handled

Classic: You lose all of your rings when hit

Modern: You lose 20 rings when hit

OHKO: You die immediately when hit (NOTE: Some Hard or Expert Logic tricks may require damage boosts!)

options.label: Mission Shuffle
options.description: Determines whether missions order will be shuffled per level

options.label: Required Cannon's Core Missions
options.description:
Determines how many Cannon's Core missions must be completed (for Biolizard or Cannon's Core goals)

First: Only the first mission must be completed

All Active: All active Cannon's Core missions must be completed

options.label: Emblem Percentage for Cannon's Core
options.description: Allows logic to gate the final mission behind a number of Emblems

options.label: Number of Level Gates
options.description: The number emblem-locked gates which lock sets of levels

options.label: Level Gate Distribution
options.description:
Determines how levels are distributed between level gate regions

Early: Earlier regions will have more levels than later regions

Even: Levels will be evenly distributed between all regions

Late: Later regions will have more levels than earlier regions

options.label: Level Gate Costs
options.description: Determines how many emblems are required to unlock level gates

options.label: Keysanity
options.description:
Determines whether picking up Chao Keys grants checks
(86 Locations)

options.label: Whistlesanity
options.description:
Determines whether whistling at various spots grants checks

None: No Whistle Spots grant checks

Pipes: Whistling at Pipes grants checks (97 Locations)

Hidden: Whistling at Hidden Whistle Spots grants checks (32 Locations)

Both: Whistling at both Pipes and Hidden Whistle Spots grants checks (129 Locations)

options.label: Beetlesanity
options.description:
Determines whether destroying Gold Beetles grants checks
(27 Locations)

options.label: Omosanity
options.description:
Determines whether activating Omochao grants checks
(192 Locations)

options.label: Animalsanity
options.description:
Determines whether unique counts of animals grant checks.
(422 Locations)

ALL animals must be collected in a single run of a mission to get all checks.

options.label: Itemboxsanity
options.description:
Determines whether collecting Item Boxes grants checks
None: No Item Boxes grant checks
Extra Lives: Extra Life Boxes grant checks (94 Locations)
All: All Item Boxes grant checks (502 Locations Total)

options.label: Bigsanity
options.description:
Determines whether helping Big fish grants checks.
(32 Locations)

options.label: Kart Race Checks
options.description:

None: No Kart Races grant checks

Mini: Each Kart Race difficulty must be beaten only once

Full: Every Character must separately beat each Kart Race difficulty

options.label: Black Market Slots
options.description: Determines how many multiworld items are available to purchase from the Black Market

options.label: Black Market Unlock Costs
options.description: Determines how many Chao Coins are required to unlock sets of Black Market items

options.label: Black Market Price Multiplier
options.description:

The base ring costs of items in the Black Market range from 50-100, and are then multiplied by this value

options.label: Chao Race Difficulty

None: No Chao Races have checks

Beginner: Beginner Races

Intermediate: Beginner, Challenge, Hero, and Dark Races

Expert: Beginner, Challenge, Hero, Dark and Jewel Races

options.description: Determines the number of Chao Karate difficulty levels included. (Note: This setting requires purchase of the "Battle" DLC)

options.label: Chao Stadium Checks
options.description:

All: Each individual race and karate fight grants a check

Prize: Only the races which grant Chao Toys grant checks (final race of each Beginner and Jewel cup, 4th, 8th, and 12th Challenge Races, 2nd and 4th Hero and Dark Races, final fight of each Karate difficulty)

options.label: Chao Animal Parts

options.label: Chao Stats
options.description:

options.label: Chao Stats Frequency
options.description:
Determines how many levels in each Chao Stat grant checks (up to the maximum set in the `chao_stats` option)

`1` means every level is included, `2` means every other level is included, `3` means every third, and so on

options.label: Chao Stats - Stamina

options.label: Chao Stats - Luck and Intelligence

options.label: Chao Kindergarten Checks

None: No Kindergarten classes have checks

Basics: One class from each category (Drawing, Dance, Song, and Instrument) is a check (4 Locations)

Full: Every class is a check (23 Locations)

options.label: Big Fishing Difficulty

options.label: SADX Music

Shuffled: Voices are shuffled.

Rude: Voices are shuffled, but some are replaced with rude words.

Chao: All voices are replaced with chao sounds.

Singularity: All voices are replaced with a single random voice.

options.label: Logic Difficulty
options.description:
What level of movement, tricks, and skips the logic will expect you to do

Developer Intended: The logic for a room only requires movement that the developers would expect a first-time player to know in that room

Vanilla Movement: The logic for a room could require any movement or tricks learned anywhere in the vanilla game

Assist Mode: The logic expects you to use invincibility, infinite dashes, and infinite stamina

options.label: Goal Area
options.description:
What Area must be cleared to gain access to the Epilogue and complete the game

Poetry Slam requires receiving all 16 Crystal Heart items and assembling the poem in the correct order to receive Granny's House Keys. Strawberries are still required.

options.label: Lock Goal Area
options.description: Determines whether your Goal Area will be locked until you receive your required Strawberries, or only the Epilogue

options.label: Goal Area Checkpointsanity
options.description: Determines whether the Checkpoints in your Goal Area will be shuffled into the item pool (if Checkpointsanity is active)

options.label: Total Strawberries
options.description: Maximum number of how many Strawberries can exist

options.label: Strawberries Required Percentage
options.description: Percentage of existing Strawberries you must receive to access your Goal Area (if Lock Goal Area is active) and the Epilogue

options.label: Dash Shuffle
options.description:
Whether the ability to dash is shuffled into the item pool, and in what manner

None: Dashing is not shuffled

Unified: A single `Dash` item exists, which gives you all 8 directions of dash

Cardinal Loose: Dash items exist for the four cardinal directions (up, right, down, left) exist, and receiving one allows you to dash in the adjacent diagonal directions as well

Cardinal Restrictive: Dash items exist for the four cardinal directions exist, but you must receive both cardinal directions to be able to dash in the diagonal direction between them

Octal: Separate dash items exist for all 8 dash directions

options.label: Climb Shuffle
options.description:
Whether the ability to climb is shuffled into the item pool, and in what manner

NOTE: Due to extreme difficulty, this option is disabled in `Developer Intended` logic difficulty

None: Climbing is not shuffled

Unified: A single `Climb` item exists, which gives allows you to climb to the left and right

Split: Separate items exist to enable the ability to climb to the left and to the right

options.label: Crouch Shuffle
options.description: Whether the ability to crouch is shuffled into the item pool

options.label: Split Interactables
options.description:
Whether there are separate interactable items per-level

None: There is one item per interactable, which allows its use everywhere

Per Level: There is one item per interactable for each level, which allows its use in any side of that level

Per Side: There is one item per interactable for each side, which allows its use in that side of any level

Per Level And Side: There is one item per interactable for each combination of level and side, which allows its use in that side of that level

Consistent: Each piece of a level name is randomly changed to something new, meaning levels from the same vanilla world will have the same starting word(s)

Sane: Levels from the same vanilla world may have entirely unrelated names, but no levels will have exactly the same name

Full: Level names will be fully randomized, with no guarantee that two levels do not share a name

Singularity: Every level will have the same name

Full: Every level tile is randomly selected, indepent of all other level tiles

Singularity: Every level tile will be the same tile type

options.label: Shuffle Boss Remains
options.description:
Choose whether to shuffle the Boss Remains received after beating a boss at the end of a dungeon.

vanilla: Boss Remains are placed in their vanilla locations.
anything: Any item can be given by any of the Boss Remains, and Boss Remains can be found anywhere in any world.
bosses: Boss Remains are shuffled amongst themselves as the rewards for defeating bosses.

options.label: Warp to Bosses Using Remains
options.description:
Choose whether to retain the vanilla ability to warp the boss of dungeons by having their vanilla remains.
Getting the remains check for a dungeon will open its warp regardless.

options.label: Shuffle Spider House Rewards
options.description: Choose whether to shuffle the Mask of Truth given at the end of the Southern Spider House and the Wallet Upgrade at the end of the Ocean Spider House.

options.label: Required Skulltula Tokens

The number of Gold Skulltula Tokens needed to get the reward from their respective Spider House.
All 30 Tokens from each Spider House are still shuffled into the item pool regardless of the selection.
Valid amounts are within the range 0-30.

options.label: Skullsanity
options.description:
Choose what items gold skulltulas can give.

vanilla: Keep the Spider Houses in generation, but only place Skulltula tokens there.
anything: Any item can be given by any Skulltula, and tokens can be found anywhere in any world.
ignore: Remove the Spider Houses from generation entirely, lowering the hint percentage and removing them from the spoiler log.

options.label: Shopsanity
options.description:
Choose whether shops and their items are shuffled into the pool.
This includes Trading Post, Bomb Shop, Goron Shop, and Zora Shop, along with the Gorman Ranch and Milk Bar purchases.

vanilla: Shop items are not shuffled.
enabled: Every item in shops are shuffled, with alternate shops sharing the same items.
advanced: Every single item in shops are shuffled, including the alternate Night Trading Post and Spring Goron Shop.

options.label: Shuffle Business Scrub Purchases
options.description: Choose whether to shuffle Business Scrub purchases.

options.label: Shop Prices
options.description:
Choose how expensive shop items are.
These only apply to the main shops of the game.
This has no effect if shopsanity is disabled.

vanilla: Shop items have their normal prices.
free: All shop items are free and cost 0 Rupees.
cheap: Shop items vary in price but can all be purchased with the starting wallet.
expensive: Shop items vary in price but may require the Adult's Wallet. No shop items will require the Giant's Wallet.
offensive: Shop items vary in price but may require the Adult's Wallet and sometimes even the Giant's Wallet.

options.label: Shuffle Great Fairy Rewards

options.label: Required Stray Fairies

All 15 Stray Fairies from each dungeon are still shuffled into the item pool regardless of the selection.
