options.label: Randomize Inner Secret Caves
options.description:
Allows the pit in Ice Ring Isle's secret cave and the rear exit out of Cliff Plateau Isles' secret cave to act as
entrances to be randomized.

options.label: Randomize Fairy Fountains
options.description: Allows the pits that lead down into Fairy Fountains to act as entrances to be randomized.

options.label: Mix Entrances
options.description:
Controls how the different types (pools) of randomized entrances should be shuffled.

- **Separate Pools:** Each pool of randomized entrances will shuffle into itself (e.g., dungeons into dungeons).
- **Mix Pools:** All pools of randomized entrances will be combined into one pool to be shuffled.

options.label: Randomize Enemies
options.description:
Randomizes the placement of non-boss enemies.

This option is an *incomplete* option from the base randomizer and **may result in unbeatable seeds! Use at your own
risk!**

options.label: Randomize Starting Island
options.description: Randomizes which island you start the game on.

options.label: Randomize Charts
options.description:
**DEV NOTE:** This option is currently unimplemented and will be ignored.

Randomizes which sector is drawn on each Triforce/Treasure Chart.

options.label: Place Hints on Kreeb
options.description:
Places hints on Kreeb. Kreeb appears at Windfall's windmill and will give you hints on where bows are located. Any 
items from any game that has the word "Bow" can be chosen.
Set this option to 0 if you don't want any hints from Kreeb.

options.label: Place Hints on Old Man Ho Ho
options.description:
Places hints on Old Man Ho Ho. Old Man Ho Ho appears at 10 different islands in the game. Talk to Old Man Ho Ho to
get hints.

options.label: Place Hints on Old Man Ho Ho
options.description:
Hints from Old Man Ho Ho will prioritize triforce pieces. This applies to any game that has an item conaining the
word "Triforce" in it.

options.label: Place Hints on King of Red Lions
options.description: Places hints on the King of Red Lions. Talk to the King of Red Lions to get hints.

options.label: Item Hints
options.description:
The number of item hints that will be placed. Item hints tell you which area contains a particular progress item in
this seed.

If multiple hint placement options are selected, the hint count will be split evenly among the placement options.

options.label: Location Hints
options.description:
The number of location hints that will be placed. Location hints tell you what item is at a specific location in
this seed.

If multiple hint placement options are selected, the hint count will be split evenly among the placement options.

options.label: Barren Hints
options.description:
The number of barren hints that will be placed. Barren hints tell you that an area does not contain any required
items in this seed.

If multiple hint placement options are selected, the hint count will be split evenly among the placement options.

options.label: Path Hints
options.description:
The number of path hints that will be placed. Path hints tell you that an area contains an item that is required to
reach a particular goal in this seed.

If multiple hint placement options are selected, the hint count will be split evenly among the placement options.

options.label: Instant Text Boxes
options.description: Text appears instantly. Also, the B button is changed to instantly skip through text as long as you hold it down.

options.label: Reveal Full Sea Chart
options.description: Start the game with the sea chart fully drawn out.

options.label: Add Shortcut Warps Between Dungeons
options.description:
Adds new warp pots that act as shortcuts connecting dungeons to each other directly. (DRC, FW, TotG, and separately
FF, ET, WT.)

Each pot must be unlocked before it can be used, so you cannot use them to access dungeons
you wouldn't already have access to.

options.label: Skip Boss Rematches
options.description:
Removes the door in Ganon's Tower that only unlocks when you defeat the rematch versions of Gohma, Kalle Demos,
Jalhalla, and Molgera.

options.label: Remove Music
options.description: Mutes all ingame music.

options.label: Classic Mode
options.description: Restores glitches from the SD version into the randomizer, like wind waker dive or dry storage.

options.label: Fix RNG
options.description:
This option attempts to fix some of the RNG elements of the game to be fixed, for now this only fixes
the Helmaroc King's flight pattern.

options.label: Performance
options.description:
This option makes the game lag less on real hardware. For now this only fixes a few list of particles
that produces lag (for example on the Gohma fight)

options.label: Gold Orb Requirement
options.description:
How many gold orbs are required for BlackCastle, and thus, to goal

Must be between 0 and 10.

options.label: Difficulty
options.description:
The difficulty the game will be set to.
0 = Simple
1 = Regular (recommended)
2 = Difficult
3 = Masterful
4 = Insanity (Masterful + one hit kill)

This game can be VERY difficult, only choose a higher difficulty if you know what you're doing!

options.label: Arcade Behaviour
options.description:
Determines the behaviour of the three arcade machines in SkyTown.
OFF - The arcade machines are disabled. 3 hearts are removed from the pool
PURCHASE_ONLY - The arcade machines must be purchased but you don't have to play them to get the check
MUST_WIN - You must purchase the arcade machine AND get the high score to get the check. (Note the JumpBox minigame is quite difficult)

options.label: Easy RainbowDive
options.description: Makes the RainbowDive checks easier by significantly reducing the amount of points required for each prize

options.label: Disable All Heart Barriers
options.description: Removes all heart barriers from the world, making their checks easier by not requiring you to reach them without taking damage

options.label: Ghost Spawn Chance (Percentage)
options.description:
Percentage chance of ghosts spawning, per room. 0 is disabled, 100 means they appear every room.
Note that not all rooms have ghosts enabled in the first place.
Ghosts won't spawn until you find at least 1 gold orb.
In vanilla on Regular, this number would be about 5, for reference.
Must be between 0 and 100.

options.label: Special Boss Music (Percentage)
options.description:
Percentage chance of using the special insanity boss music when fighting a (non-unique) boss.
Purely cosmetic and has no gameplay effect.
Must be between 0 and 100.

options.label: Enable Unintuitive and Unintended Logic
options.description:
Adds several difficult jumps into logic.
This assumes a deep knowledge of the game and ability to perform jumps that are either very precise, unintended, or unintuitive.
None of these require damage boosting, as logic always assumes maximum difficulty

options.label: Enable Return to Previous Save Logic
options.description:
Adds into logic locations that require you to return to previous save after getting them, due to them putting you in a dead end without specific items.
This affects three areas specifically: the two checks after the first Grotto boss (usually requiring 2 jump upgrades to leave), the check after the first boss in StoneCastle (usually requiring DiveBomb to leave), and the second half of FireCage (requiring yellow energy to get to the save)

options.label: Starting 2x Speed (hrs)
options.description: Choose the amount of 2x Speed the game will start with.

options.label: Plasmids
options.description: Choose the amount of Plasmids the game will start with.

options.label: Phage
options.description: Choose the amount of Phage the game will start with.

options.label: Anti Plasmids
options.description: Choose the amount of Anti-Plasmids the game will start with.

options.label: Governors Unlocked
options.description: Choose whether Governors will be enabled in game.

options.label: Religion Unlocked
options.description: Choose whether Religion is availible in game.

options.label: Progenitor Race
options.description: Choose the the progrenitor race for the game. This is only for if you choose Fanaticism.

options.label: Death Link Amnesty
options.description:
How many deaths will it take to activate Death Link?
Please note: Death Link is... dangerous.
Death Link will set your population to 1 and troops to 0, unless death percent says otherwise.

options.label: Death Link Percent
options.description:
What percent of your population will die when Death Link is activated.
IE: At 100%, no people will live. At 10%, 90% of your population will live.
A minimum of 1 person will die, unless you have exactly 1 pop.

options.label: Choose Genus
options.description:
What Genus will you evolve into: Carnivore, Fungi, Demonic, Synthetic, Eldritch
All other Genuses are included in Other.
You can see what the Others option includes on the Setup Page

options.label: Choose Universe
options.description:
What universe will you be in?
IF YOU DO NOT KNOW WHAT EACH UNIVERSE DOES
    DO   NOT    CHANGE    THIS!!!

options.label: Goal
options.description:
What the goal objective for the game will be.
Defeating the end boss Mordred on floor 25 will award victory.
Reach floor awards victory upon reaching a designated floor (Floor Goal).

options.label: Floor Goal
options.description: Specifies the floor to reach for victory when "reach floor" goal is set.

options.label: Difficulty
options.description:
Adjusts logic to make the game easier or harder.

Easy: 3 mana in logic per floor
Medium: 2 mana in logic per floor
Hard: 1 mana in logic per floor

options.label: Double Mana Dots
options.description:
Specifies the amount of Double Mana Dots item to be in the item pool (replaces Mana Dots)
This can be used to make the overall game easier or allow for more traps.

options.label: Consumable Count
options.description: Specifies the amount of Consumable checks to be in the item pool (replaces consumables with AP check based on step)

options.label: Consumable Steps
options.description:
Specifies the amount of normal consumable pickups between consumable checks.
The step amount counts down for each consumable picked up.
Upon reaching 0 the next consumable pickup grants a check instead of the collectable item.

options.label: Traps
options.description:
Specifies the amount of traps to be added to the pool.
(May contain fewer traps than specified if mana dots are required for logic)

options.label: Energy Link
options.description:
EnergyLink allows players to deposit energy extracted from collected bananas into a shared pool across games in the session.

You can exchange energy for Instant DK Barrels. Great for players that find the base game hard.
There's an additional item in the item pool that allows for better energy extraction from bananas.

options.label: Trap Link
options.description: Whether your received traps are linked to other players

options.label: Starting Life Count
options.description: How many lives to start the game with.

options.label: Starting Kong
options.description: Which Kongs will be available at the start

options.label: Big Bananas Required
options.description: How many Big Bananas are required to unlock Gang-Plank Galleon

options.label: Jungle Levels Required
options.description: How many levels in Kongo Jungle need to be cleared to fight Very Gnawty

options.label: Mines Levels Required
options.description: How many levels in Monkey Mines need to be cleared to fight Master Necky

options.label: Valley Levels Required
options.description: How many levels in Vine Valley need to be cleared to fight Queen B.

options.label: Glacier Levels Required
options.description: How many levels in Gorilla Glacier need to be cleared to fight Really Gnawty

options.label: Industries Levels Required
options.description: How many levels in Kremkroc Industries Inc. need to be cleared to fight Dumb Drum

options.label: Caverns Levels Required
options.description: How many levels in Chimp Caverns need to be cleared to fight Master Necky Snr.

options.label: Starting World
options.description: Which world you will start in

options.label: Ability Shuffle
options.description:
Which abilities will be added as items in the item pool
If an ability is not present in the list they will be treated as unlocked from the start

options.label: Animal Buddies Shuffle
options.description:
Which animal buddies will be added as items in the item pool
If an animal buddy is not present in the list they will be treated as unlocked from the start

options.label: Object Shuffle
options.description:
Which kind of objects will be added as items in the item pool
If an object is not present in the list they will be treated as unlocked from the start

options.label: KONG Letters Checks
options.description: Whether collecting all KONG letters in each level will grant a check

options.label: Balloon Checks
options.description:
Whether collecting balloons in levels will grant a check

Doesn't include balloons inside bonuses

options.label: Banana Bunches Checks
options.description:
Whether collecting banana bunches in levels will grant a check

Doesn't include banana bunches inside bonuses

options.label: Animal Token Checks
options.description:
Whether collecting an animal token in levels will grant a check

Doesn't include tokens inside bonuses

options.label: Trap Fill Percentage
options.description: Replace a percentage of junk items in the item pool with random traps

options.label: Jump Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which makes the player jump uncontrollably

options.label: Sticky Floor Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which makes the player unable to walk or roll in the ground

options.label: Stun Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which freezes the player in place for a few seconds

options.label: Stun Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which makes the floor slippery

options.label: Nut Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which spawns a nut on top of the player

options.label: Army Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which spawns an Army on top of the player

options.label: Animal Bonus Trap Weight
options.description: Likelihood of a receiving a trap which sends the player to an Animal Bonus level

options.label: Set Custom Palettes
options.description:
Allows you to create colors for each Kong status. Includes K.Rool effects and the invincibility barrel
This will override the option preset

Each one expects 15 values which are mapped to the Kongs colors
The values can be in SNES RGB (bgr555) with the $ prefix or PC RGB (rgb888) with the # prefix

options.label: Palette Filters
options.description:
Applies a filter that can brighten or darken your selected palette
Doesn't produce results similar to the original ones, but it's good enough

Positive numbers create a brighter color palette (the higher the number, the brighter the palette)
Negative numbers create a darker color palette (the higher (or lower lol) the negative number, the darker the palette)

Treat the values as percentages

options.label: Donkey Active Palette
options.description: Which color to use for Donkey's active color

options.label: Donkey Inactive Palette
options.description: Which color to use for Donkey's inactive color

options.label: Diddy Active Palette
options.description: Which color to use for Diddy's active color

options.label: Diddy Inactive Palette
options.description: Which color to use for Diddy's inactive color

You can exchange energy for Backup DK Barrels. Great for players that find the base game hard.
There's an additional item in the item pool that allows for better energy extraction from bananas.

options.description: How many lives to start the game with.

options.label: Starting Kong
options.description: Which Kongs will be available at the start

options.label: Logic Difficulty
options.description:
Logic difficulty. May become irrelevant if not a lot of items are added to the item pool.
- **Strict**: Ensures everything is reachable as the original devs intended. For beginners or people who want to go out of logic with some tricks.
- **Loose**: Reaching locations may require some level of mastery about the game's mechanics.
- **Expert**: Locations expects players to be extremely good at the game with minimal amount of abilities. Hard to go out of logic.

options.label: Glitched World Access
options.description:
Level warping across worlds via glitches will be in logic
Players are expected to use Backup DK Barrels

options.description:

options.label: Yoshi Egg Count
options.description:
Amount of Golden Yoshi Eggs that can be found anywhere in the multiworld/itempool.

The amount of eggs rolled by this option will be added to the amount of eggs created by the Local Golden Yoshi Eggs option
and both of them will not exceed the 255 egg limit.

options.label: Required Percentage of Golden Yoshi Eggs
options.description:
What Percentage of Yoshi Eggs are required to finish.

This option will sum yoshi_egg_placement and yoshi_egg_count, then it'll calculate the required amount from that egg count.

options.label: Local Yoshi Egg Placement
options.description:
Forces Golden Yoshi Eggs into specific level exits.
This option will create a new location in each level that's valid, that way it doesn't disturb your potential Priority Locations
in said regions. Similar to how Boss Tokens operated before.

The "Every Level" option has priority over the others, creating an at least 96 egg game.

The amount of eggs rolled by this option will be added to the amount of eggs created by the yoshi_egg_count option
and both of them will not exceed the 255 egg limit.

options.description:

Unselected microgames will not be unlocked.

options.description:
Enables additional Hi-Score locations for character games.
These WILL require playing the game again after beating it! May be a nuisance.

options.label: Energy Link
options.description:
Enable EnergyLink support.

EnergyLink in MMX2 works as a big HP and Weapon Energy pool that the players can use to request HP
or Weapon Energy whenever they need to.

You make use of this feature by typing /heal <amount> or /refill <amount> in the client.

options.label: Damage Link
options.description: Enable DamageLink support

options.label: Starting HP
options.description:
How much HP X will have at the start of the game.

Notes: Going over 32 HP may cause visual bugs in either gameplay or the pause menu. The max HP is capped at 64.

options.label: Heart Tank Effectiveness
options.description:
How many units of HP each Heart tank will provide to the user.

Note: Going over 32 HP may cause visual bugs in either gameplay or the pause menu. The max HP is capped at 64.

options.label: Boss Weakness Randomization
options.description:
Every main boss will have its weakness randomized.

vanilla: Bosses retain their original weaknesses
swapped: Bosses will swap around their weaknesses with other bosses
simple: Bosses will have one random weakness
chaotic_single: Bosses will have one random weakness under the chaotic set
chaotic_double: Bosses will have two random weaknesses under the chaotic set
chaotic_triple: Bosses will have three random weakness under the chaotic set

The chaotic set makes every weapon charge level a separate weakness instead of keeping
them together, meaning that a boss can be weak to Charged Spin Wheel but not its
uncharged version.

options.label: Boss Weakness Strictness
options.description:
How strict boss weaknesses will be.

not_strict: How the original game operates
weakness_and_buster: Only allow the weakness and buster to deal damage to the bosses
weakness_and_upgraded_buster: Only allow the weakness and buster charge levels 3 to deal damage to the bosses
only_weakness: Only the weakness will deal damage to the bosses

options.label: Plando Weaknesses
options.description:
Forces bosses to have a specific weakness. Uses the names that appear on the chaotic weakness set.

Format: 
  Boss Name: ["Weakness Name"]

options.label: Boss Randomize HP
options.description:
Wheter to randomize the boss' hp or not. Mid bosses aren't supported (yet).

off: Bosses' HP will not be randomized
weak: Bosses will have [2,32] HP
regular: Bosses will have [16,48] HP
strong: Bosses will have [32,64] HP
chaotic: Bosses will have [2,64] HP

options.label: Plando HP
options.description:
Forces bosses to have a specific HP value. Can't go over 64 or lower than 2.
Sigma Virus and mid-stage bosses aren't supported here (yet).
Serges, Violen, Neo Violen and Agile share the same HP value with Agile's data applying to all three.

Format: 
  Boss Name: HP Value

options.label: Pickup Locations
options.description: Whether collecting freestanding 1ups, HP and Weapon Energy capsules will be considered a location.

options.label: Jammed Buster
options.description:
Jams X's buster making it only able to shoot lemons.
Note: This adds another Arms Upgrade into the item pool.

options.label: Enhancement Chips
options.description:
Which chip items will be included in the game.
Do note that this feature REQUIRES enabling pickup items as locations!

Supported enhancement chips:
* "Quick Charge Chip" [MMX5] Halves charge time for X-Buster and Special Weapon shots
* "Speedster Chip" [MMX5] Increases walking speed by 50%
* "Super Recover Chip" [MMX5] Increases recovery from items by 25%
* "Rapid Five Chip" [MMX5] Increases the amount of buster shots on screen to 5
* "Speed Shot Chip" [MMX5] Increases default buster shot (lemons) horizontal speed by 50%
* "Buster Plus Chip" [MMX5] Increases Buster damage by 1
* "Weapon Plus Chip" [MMX6] Increases Weapon damage by 1
* "D-Converter Chip" [MMX6] Refills the active weapon when taking damage
* "D-Barrier Chip" [MMX6] Doubles the I-frames after getting hit
* "Item Plus Chip" [MMX7] Increases item drop rates by roughly 33%
* "Spike Walker Chip" [MMX8] Halves speed when sliding down a wall

options.description:
Enable EnergyLink support.

EnergyLink in MMX2 works as a big HP and Weapon Energy pool that the players can use to request HP
or Weapon Energy whenever they need to.

You make use of this feature by typing /heal <amount> or /refill <amount> in the client.

options.label: Button Configuration
options.description: Default buttons for every action.

options.label: Starting Life Count
options.description:
How many lives to start the game with. 
Note: This number becomes the new default life count, meaning that it will persist after a game over.

options.label: Starting HP
options.description:
How much HP X will have at the start of the game.
Note: Going over 32 HP may cause visual bugs in either gameplay or the pause menu.
      The max HP is capped at 56.

options.label: Heart Tank Effectiveness
options.description:
How many units of HP each Heart tank will provide to the user.
Note: Going over 32 HP may cause visual bugs in either gameplay or the pause menu.
      The max HP is capped at 56.

options.label: Boss Weakness Randomization
options.description:
Every main boss will have its weakness randomized.
vanilla: Bosses retain their original weaknesses
shuffled: Bosses have their weaknesses shuffled
chaotic_double: Bosses will have two random weaknesses under the chaotic set
chaotic_single: Bosses will have one random weakness under the chaotic set

The chaotic set makes every weapon charge level a separate weakness instead of keeping
them together, meaning that a boss can be weak to Charged Rolling Shield but not its
uncharged version.

options.label: Boss Weakness Strictness
options.description:
How strict boss weaknesses will be.
not_strict: Allow every weapon to deal damage to the bosses
weakness_and_buster: Only allow the weakness and buster to deal damage to the bosses
weakness_and_upgraded_buster: Only allow the weakness and buster charge level 3 to deal damage to the bosses
only_weakness: Only the weakness will deal damage to the bosses

options.label: Button Configuration
options.description:
Forces bosses to have a specific weakness. Uses the names that appear on the chaotic weakness set.

Format: 
  Boss Name: Weakness Name

options.label: Boss Randomize HP
options.description:
Wheter to randomize the boss' hp or not.
off: Bosses' HP will not be randomized
weak: Bosses will have [1,32] HP
regular: Bosses will have [16,48] HP
strong: Bosses will have [32,64] HP
chaotic: Bosses will have [1,64] HP

options.label: Jammed Buster
options.description:
Jams X's buster making it only able to shoot lemons.
Note: This adds another Arms Upgrade into the item pool.

options.label: Better Wall Jump
options.description: Enables performing a dash wall jump by holding down the button instead of pressing it every time.

options.label: Air Dash
options.description: Adds another Legs Upgrade that allows X to perform an Air Dash.

options.label: Long Jumps
options.description: Allows X to perform longer jumps when holding down the Dash button. Only works after getting a Legs Upgrade.

options.label: Hadouken In Pool
options.description:
Adds Hadouken to the item pool.
Hadouken will deal the current HP as damage and half the current HP on strict weakness settings.

options.label: Quick Charge In Pool
options.description:
Adds Quick Charge Chip from Mega Man X5 into the item pool.

Halves charge time for X-Buster and Special Weapon shots.

options.label: Speedster In Pool
options.description:
Adds Speedster Chip from Mega Man X5 into the item pool.

Increases walking speed by 50%

options.label: Super Recover In Pool
options.description:
Adds Super Recover Chip from Mega Man X5 into the item pool.

Increases recovery from items by 25%. Also affects EnergyLink deposit rate. Doesn't affect Sub Tanks.

options.label: Rapid Five In Pool
options.description:
Adds Rapid Five Chip from Mega Man X5 into the item pool.

Increases the amount of buster shots on screen to 5.

options.label: Speed Shot In Pool
options.description:
Adds Speed Shot Chip from Mega Man X5 into the item pool.

Increases X's buster shots (lemons) horizontal speed by 50%.

options.label: Buster Plus In Pool
options.description:
Adds Buster Plus Chip from Mega Man X5 into the item pool.

Increases Buster (lemon) damage by 1.

options.label: Weapon Plus In Pool
options.description:
Adds Weapon Plus Chip from Mega Man X6 into the item pool.

Increases Weapon damage by 1.

Unlocking level 4 requires getting all Fortress levels cleared.

Medals: Consider Maverick medals to get access to the fortress.
Weapons: Consider weapons to get access to the fortress.

Heart Tanks: Consider heart tanks to get access to the fortress.

options.label: Victory Goal
options.description:
Determine the goal for the seed

Smash the T-Rex: Break the T-rex and gain access to Beverly Hills. Should be a faster game suitable for syncs.
Get to the Skate Ranch: Reach the Skate Ranch to win.
Win the Skate Competition: Make it to downtown and Vans Park and win the Tony Hawk AMJAM.

options.label: Tricks 4 Cash
options.description:
Makes the client read any landed combo above 2,000 points, divide it by 2,000, and then give you that much cash in exchange.
A combo worth 20,000 points will give you 10 bucks, for example.
I recommend leaving this on to cut down on grinding and give you ways to earn money besides doing tricks for the homeless man.

options.label: Progressive Wallet
options.description:
Adds progressive wallet items to the pool which initially restrict and then each increase how much money you can hold at a time.
This does affect logic requirements and will often drip feed checks in a way that will make the archipelago multiworld flow more smoothly.
It will however also mean that you may miss out on money at times or be forced to do more trips back and forth to the shops.
This requires testing but may be a required feature in future.

options.label: Shopsanity
options.description:
Makes every buyable item in the game a location check.
If you haven't picked "Win the Skate Competition" or longer as a goal it will be on automatically because the world needs enough locations to give you all the stat items.

options.label: Include Skateboard in Item Pool?
options.description:
Adds the skateboard to the item pool, meaning if you don't have it you can't use your skateboard.
Without the skateboard you can only do a few of the missions, mainly spraypainting.
Turn this on at your own risk, because it may BK you very early and its a required item for most of the game.

options.label: Enable Deathlink
options.description:
Includes Deathlink, but also chooses how many bails it takes to trigger a sent deathlink.
Keep in mind how fast these may rack up before your choice. It is possible to change this number later in client with "/deathlinksetting5" for example, or just turn it off or on with "/deathlink".
At present it only sets you to bail or exit green-side balance meters for manuals, grinds, and lips.
Perhaps later I'll find a way to make you bail no matter what you're doing, but we'll see.

options.label: Local First Part
options.description:
Force collecting the Main Engine to give a ship part.
This can be useful to prevent getting stuck immediately at the start of the game.

options.label: Local Last Part
options.description:
Force collecting the Secret Safe to give a ship part.
Since you complete Pikmin 1 by collecting the last ship part, it could give a required item for another player.
This option prevents this, so other players won't ever need to wait for Pikmin to finish.

options.label: Enable Pikmin Collection Locations
options.description:
Enable locations based on the number of Pikmin following Captain Olimar.

A Pikmin location is checked when the number of Pikmin of that color
currently in Olimar's squad (the Pikmin following him) reaches a threshold.
Pikmin left in the Onion, working, idle or scattered do not count.
Example: with a Red interval of 5, "Red Pikmin: 10" is checked as soon as
10 Red Pikmin follow Olimar at the same time.
The squad is limited to 100 Pikmin (all colors combined).
Total Max Locations : 300

options.label: Red Pikmin Locations
options.description:
Enable Red Pikmin locations: checked by the number of Red Pikmin
following Captain Olimar (no ship part requirement).
Total Max Locations : 100

options.label: Red Pikmin Interval
options.description:
Step between Red Pikmin thresholds (number of Red Pikmin following Olimar).
Example: 12 creates "Red Pikmin: 12", "Red Pikmin: 24", "Red Pikmin: 36"...

options.label: Yellow Pikmin Locations
options.description:
Enable Yellow Pikmin locations: checked by the number of Yellow Pikmin
following Captain Olimar (requires 1 ship part).
Total Max Locations : 100

options.label: Yellow Pikmin Interval
options.description:
Step between Yellow Pikmin thresholds (number of Yellow Pikmin following Olimar).
Example: 5 creates "Yellow Pikmin: 5", "Yellow Pikmin: 10", "Yellow Pikmin: 15"...

options.label: Blue Pikmin Locations
options.description:
Enable Blue Pikmin locations: checked by the number of Blue Pikmin
following Captain Olimar (requires 5 ship parts).
Total Max Locations : 100

options.label: Blue Pikmin Interval
options.description:
Step between Blue Pikmin thresholds (number of Blue Pikmin following Olimar).
Example: 5 creates "Blue Pikmin: 5", "Blue Pikmin: 10", "Blue Pikmin: 15"...
