Available From The Start: allows you to use the ship from the beginning of the game. Black Crystal is no longer in the pool as it is not required.

options.label: Start with Ship Wings
options.description: When enabled, the ship starts with the Wings of Anemos.

options.label: Anemos Inner Sanctum Access
options.description:
Determine accesss to Anemos Inner Sanctun
Vanilla: requires all 72 Djinn to be able to enter Anemos Inner Sanctum
Randomized: will select a value between 16 to 28 Djinn to be able to access Anemos Inner Sanctum
Open: allows you to enter Anemos Inner Sanctum without any Djinn

options.label: Character Shuffle
options.description:
Where can you find the other characters?
Vanilla: makes it like the vanilla experience.
Vanilla Shuffled: puts the characters in each others locations.
Anywhere: puts the characters in the multiworld itempool,
note that Jenna's character location is forced to be a character due to game limiations with psynergy learning.

options.label: Second Starting Character
options.description:
Which character will join Felix on Idejima?
This will always be Jenna when Character Shuffle is set to Vanilla, otherwise it will be whichever character this is set to.

options.label: Scale Characters
options.description: Whether to scale character levels by spheres.  Increases generation time.

options.label: Max Scaled Level
options.description: The maximum level a scaled character should have.  Only valid if scale_characters is true.

options.label: Character Stats Shuffle
options.description:
Determine the stats for characters
Vanilla: leaves the stats as per the vanilla game.
Shuffle Character Stats: will shuffle stats between characters.
Adjust Character Stats: will randomize stats for each character within a margin of vanilla.

options.label: Character Element Shuffle
options.description:
Determine how character elements are shuffled
Vanilla: leaves character elements as per the vanilla game
Shuffle Character Elements: will shuffle them between characters
Randomize Character Elements: will randomize each characters element

options.label: No utility Psynergy from classes
options.description: Prevents utility Psynergy (Growth, Frost, etc.) from being learned by classes.

options.label: Randomize class stat boosts
options.description: When enabled the base stats for classes are randomized

options.label: Character Element Shuffle
options.description:
Determine what Psynergy a class will learn
Vanilla: leaves the Psynergy on their vanilla classes
Randomize Psynergy by Classline: Learned Psynergy is shuffled by classlines (e.g. Squire will have Brute Psynergy)
Randomize by Psynergy Group: Learned Psynergy is shuffled by Psynergy groups (e.g. if a class learns Spire, it will also learn Clay Spire)
Randomize by Psynergy Group Prefer Element: As by group, but with a preference to the same Element
Randomize by Psynergy Element: Learned Psynergy is freely shuffled with another Psynergy of the same element
Fully Randomize it will randomize it completely without grouping or preference

choices.label: Randomize By Psynergy Group Prefer Element

options.label: Character Element Shuffle
options.description:
Determine when Psynergy is learned
Vanilla: leaves the learning of Psynergy on the vanilla levels.
Adjust Learning Levels: will randomize learning levels within a margin from vanilla.
Randomize Learning Levels: will randomize learning levels completely.

options.label: Adjust Psynergy Power
options.description: When enabled the power of Psynergy is randomized within a margin of vanilla.

options.label: Adjust Psynergy PP Cost
options.description: When enabled the PP cost of Psynergy is randomized within a margin of vanilla.

options.label: Randomize Psynergy AoE
options.description: When enabled the AoE of Psynergy is randomized

options.label: Adjust Enemy Psynergy Power
options.description: When enabled the power of Enemy Psynergy is randomized within a margin of vanilla.

options.label: Randomize Enemy Psynergy AoE
options.description: When enabled the AoE of Enemy Psynergy is randomized.

options.label: Enemy Elemental Resistance Shuffle
options.description:
Determine how Enemy Elemental Resistance is shuffled
Vanilla: leaves the elemental resistance as per the vanilla game.
Shuffle Elemental Resistance: will shuffle them between enemies.
Randomize Elemental Resistance: will randomize the resistances for each enemy.

options.label: Start with Healing Psynergy
options.description: Start the game with at least one healing Psynergy (Cure, Ply, Wish or Aura)

options.label: Start with Revive Psynergy
options.description: When enabled, start the game with Revive Psynergy

options.label: Shuffle Djinn
options.description:
How Djinn should be placed in your own world. The client has extra commands to help find which Djinni locations have (not) been checked.
Note currently Djinn can only be placed in djinn locations in their own world due to game limitations.
Vanilla keeps them in their vanilla locations.
Vanilla Shuffled by Element, Djinni are placed in vanilla Djinni locations that share their element.
Vanilla Shuffled are placed in any vanilla Djinni location regardless of element.

options.label: Djinn Logic
options.description:
How much do Djinn affect logic for being able to defeat bosses?
Assuming this is set to 100 (Normal) beating Briggs expects 6 djinn, Poseidon 24 djinn and Doom Dragon 56 djinn.
Dullahan goes up to 72 (All Djinn in the game). Setting this to 50 (Hard) will halve all of these numbers and 0 will remove the requirement completely.

options.label: Shuffle Djinn stat boosts
options.description: When enabled the stats a djinn grant are shuffled amongst each other.

options.label: Adjust Djinn attack power
options.description: When enabled the attack power of djinn are randomized within a margin of vanilla.

options.label: Randomize Djinn Area of Effect
options.description: When enabled the Area of Effect of djinn used in battle is randomized.

options.label: Scale Djinn battle difficulty
options.description: Adjust Djinn battle difficulty based on number of owned Djinn.

options.label: Randomize Summon costs
options.description: When enabled the costs for Summons is randomized.

options.label: Adjust Summon Power
options.description: when enabled the power of Summons is randomized within a margin of vanilla.

options.label: Shuffle Equipment Compatability
options.description:
When enabled the compatability for each equipment piece is randomized. 
Compatibility defines what each character can equip.

options.label: Adjust Equipment Prices
options.description: When enabled the price for each equipment piece is randomized within a margin of vanilla.

options.label: Adjust Equipment Stats
options.description: When enabled the stats for each equipment piece is randomized within a margin of vanilla.

options.label: Shuffle weapon attack
options.description: When enabled, the attack stat from weapons is shuffled amongst each other

options.label: Shuffle Weapon Effects
options.description: When enabled the effects for weapons are shuffled amongst each other.

options.label: Shuffle armour defense
options.description: When enabled, the defense from equipment is shuffled amongst each other

options.label: Shuffle Armour Effects
options.description: When enabled the bonus effects for armour are shuffled amongst each other.

options.label: Randomize Curses
options.description: When enabled the curses for equipment are randomized.

options.label: Remove all Curses
options.description: When enabled, curses are removed.

options.label: Show items outside chest
options.description:
Chests and Tablets are replaced with their contents on the floor.
This allows for scouting items. Note certain locations are still not visible,
for example items in pots or barrels.

options.label: Avoid costs no PP
options.description: When enabled, the Avoid Psynergy will cost no PP

options.label: Retreat costs no PP
options.description: When enabled, the Retreat Psynergy will cost no PP

options.label: Scale Exp
options.description: Scale how much Exp is earned by the party.

options.label: Scale Coins
options.description: Scale how much Coins are earned by the party.

options.label: Starting levels
options.description:
Determine the starting levels for characters joining the party.
Note this only increases levels of characters that are lower level than the party

options.label: Sanctum revive cost
options.description:
Determine how expensive the Sanctuary is to revive characters
Vanilla: leaves the cost per the vanilla game (20x level)
Reduced: will alter the cost to be cheaper than vanilla (2x level)
Fixed: will alter the cost to the same price throughout (100 coins)

options.label: Toggleable Avoid and always works
options.description: When enabled, Avoid always succeeds and will disable encounters. Using it again will enable encounters

options.label: Enable Hard Mode
options.description: When enabled, all enemies will have 50% more health, 25% more attack and defense

options.label: Reduce Encounter Rate
options.description: When enabled, the encounter rate will be halved

options.label: Easier Bosses
options.description: When enabled, boss fights will be easier by altering their scripts / stats

options.label: Named Puzzles
options.description:
Determines how the named puzzles will generate. These include the puzzles for Gambomba Statue, Gaia Rock and Trial Road
Vanilla: uses the name that is given to Felix
Fixed: will force the puzzles to use the name 'Felix'
Randomized: will force the puzzles to be a random name

options.label: Manual Retreat Glitch
options.description:
When enabled, Hold select to trigger the Retreat glitch. Logic does not require or expect use of glitches to beat your seed,
this purely gives more control to activating the glitch over draining your PP to than use it anyway.

options.label: Music Shuffle
options.description: When enabled, music is shuffled amongst each other.

options.label: Teleport Everywhere
options.description: When enabled, allows Teleport to target small villages and dungeons

options.label: Auto Run
options.description: Swaps the behavior of holding B when moving (default is now run instead of walk)

options.label: Coop
options.description:
Enables cooping a seed by making local items the same as remote items, enabling
your friends to receive items you pick up.  Also helpful if trying to play a world from multiple devices.
You will still need to pickup djinn the other person picks up.
off - vanilla
progression - Only progression items are treated as remote items
prog_useful - Progression and useful items are treated as remote items
all - All items are treated as remote items

options.label: Disable Shopkeeper Gametickets
options.description:
Disable Shopkeepers offering Game Tickets, in Vanilla this is the main way to get game tickets. 
In the randomizer they and/or their rewards may show up as part of the item pool (see common_consumable_filler_weight and lucky_equipment_filler_weight options).
Note disabling this setting will make shop interactions take longer each time a game ticket is offered.

options.label: Trap Chance
options.description:
The chance for filler items in the pool to be replaced by a trap. This can vary from about 70 to 130 traps depending on your settings. Have fun!
Note that this does not replace every filler item as some options force add filler items to the pool.

options.label: Mimic Trap Weight
options.description:
The weight for a trap to be a Mimic. As not all vanilla locations can be mimics.
Mimics will drop their vanilla contents which tend to be more useful consumables but can also be things like Game Tickets or Lucky Medals.
Note: Enabling this will force a number of filler items to the pool to ensure generation success due to locations not supporting mimics.

options.label: Scale Mimics
options.description: Whether the strength of mimics should be scaled based on the sphere they are in.  Increases generation time

options.label: Forge Material Filler Weight
options.description:
The weight for a filler item to be a forge material. These will be forged into any of their regular results.
Note that forging results are RNG based in the game and the randomizer does not alter this behaviour.
Examples of materials are Tear Stone, Sylph Feather, Golem Core, Dark Matter and Orihalcon.

options.label: Forge Materials are Filler
options.description: Whether Forge Materials should be marked as filler instead of useful

options.label: Rusty Material Filler Weight
options.description:
The weight for a filler item to be a rusty weapon. These weapons will forge into their counterparts as per usual.
E.g. you can find a Rusty Sword which when forged turns into the Soul Brand or a Rusty Staff for a Glower Staff.

options.label: Stat Boost Filler Weight
options.description:
The weight for a filler item to be a stat boost item.
These are Cookie, Hard Nut, Apple, Mint, Power Bread and Lucky Pepper.

options.label: Uncommon Consumable Filler Weight
options.description:
The weight for a filler item to be an uncommon consumable.
Examples of these are Psy Crystal, Mist Potion, Potion and Water of Life.

options.label: Forged Equipment Filler Weight
options.description:
The weight for a filler item to be the end result of forging equipment through materials or rusty weapons.
Examples are Excalibur, Viking Axe, Goblin's Rod, Luna Shield, Astral Circlet and Dragon Boots.

options.label: Lucky Equipment Filler Weight
options.description:
The weight for a filler item to be a lucky item reward from the fountain in Lemuria or Lucky Wheels in Contigo.
Examples of these are Hestia Blade, Mighty Axe, Aegis Shield, Crown of Glory, Quick Boots, Silk Shirt and War Ring.

options.label: Artifacts are Filler
options.description:
Whether "Rare" Equipment should be considered filler instead of useful.  Rings, Shirts, and Boots are
not reclassified by this option.

options.label: Shop Equipment Filler Weight
options.description:
The weight for a filler item to be equipment from the shop.
These include the normal things you can buy amongst a few of the artefacts. Think along the lines of Long Sword, Silver Helm, Chain Mail to a Frost Wand.

options.label: Coin Filler Weight
options.description:
The weight for a filler item to be coins.
The coin amounts are the vanilla coin items you can find. These vary from 3 coins to 911 coins. Majority is around or below 300.

options.label: Common Consumable Filler Weight
options.description:
The weight for a filler item to be a common consumable.
Examples of these are Herbs, Vials, Antidotes, Elixirs, Smoke Bombs, Lucky Medals and Game Tickets

options.label: Character
options.description:
Enter the list of characters to play as.  Valid characters are:
'Ironclad'
'Silent'
'Defect'
'Watcher'
'Hermit'
'SlimeBoss'
'Guardian'
'Hexaghost'
'Champ'
'Gremlins'
'Automaton'
'Snecko'
'Collector'
'AwakenedOne'

options.label: Pick Number of Characters
options.description:
Randomly select from the configured characters this many characters to generate for.
0 disables.
For example, if "character" is configured to be:
    character:
        - Ironclad
        - Silent
        - Defect
And pick_num_characters is set to 2, then one possible outcome is
to have a run with Ironclad and Defect, but not the Silent.

options.label: Number of Characters to Goal
options.description: How many characters you need to complete a run with before you goal. 0 means all characters

options.label: Lock Characters
options.description:
Whether in a multi character run "Unlock [Char]" items should be shuffled in.
locked_fixed means the unlocked_character option is used to determine which character to start with
locked_random means which character you start with is randomized
unlocked means you start with all characters available

options.label: Unlocked Character
options.description:
Which character to start unlocked, if lock_characters is set to locked_fixed.
Can also enter a character name for modded characters.

options.label: Advanced Characters
options.description:
Whether to use the advanced characters feature. The normal options for character, ascension, etc. are ignored.
See the "advanced_characters" option.

options.label: Advanced Characters
options.description:
The configuration for advanced characters.  Each character's options can be configured
independently of each other.  No validation is done on the character name, so use carefully.
Format is:
    <char name>:
        ascension: <number>
        downfall: 0 or 1
        final_act: 0 or 1
        ascension_down: <number>

If using a non-downfall modded character:
Enter the internal ID of the character to use.

 if you don't know the exact ID to enter with the mod installed go to
`Mods -> Archipelago Multi-world -> config` to view a list of installed modded character IDs.

the downfall characters will only work if you have downfall installed.
If the chosen character mod is not installed, checks will be sent when another character
sends them.  If none of the chosen character mods are installed, you will be playing
a very boring Ironclad run.

options.label: Final Act
options.description: Whether you will need to collect the 3 keys and beat the final act to complete the game.

options.label: Downfall
options.description:
When Downfall is Installed this will switch the played mode to Downfall (aka evil mode aka villain mode;
you kill Neow in the run)

options.label: Ascension
options.description: What Ascension do you wish to play with.

options.label: Ascension Down
options.description:
The number of ascension downs to add to the item pool, per character. Only valid when
`use_advanced_characters` is false (see `advanced_characters`), and when `include_floor_checks` is true.
Will be ignored if invalid.

Logic does NOT account for this.

options.label: Include Floor Checks
options.description: Whether to include reaching new floors as a location.  Adds small amounts of gold as items.

options.label: Death Link %
options.description: Percentage of health to lose when a death link is received.

options.label: Trap Chance
options.description:
Chance that a filler item is replaced with a trap.  Requires `include_floor_checks`
for any traps to be added.

options.label: Campfire Sanity
options.description:
Whether to shuffle being able to rest and smith at each campsite per act.  Also adds
new locations at campsites per act.

options.label: Gold Sanity
options.description: Whether to enable shuffling gold rewards into the multiworld. Adds 27 locations per character

options.label: Potion Sanity
options.description: Whether to enable shuffling potion drops into the multiworld; adds 9 locations per character.

options.label: Key Sanity
options.description:
Whether the keys needed to enter the final act should be shuffled into the multiworld;
adds 3 locations per character

options.label: Shop Sanity
options.description: Whether to shuffle shop slots into the pool.  Also adds new locations at the shop per slot shuffled.

options.label: Shop Card Slots
options.description: When shop_sanity is enabled, the number of colored card slots to shuffle.

options.label: Shop Neutral Card Slots
options.description: When shop_sanity is enabled, the number of neutral card slots to shuffle.

options.label: Shop Relic Slots
options.description: WHen shop_sanity is enabled, the number of relic slots to shuffle.

options.label: Shop Potion Slots
options.description: When shop_sanity is enabled, the number of potion slots to shuffle

options.label: Shop Remove Slots
options.description:
When shop_sanity is enabled, whether to shuffle the ability to remove cards at the shop.
Progressive based on Act; i.e. you'll gain the ability to remove cards per Act, starting from Act 1.
Act 4 will be treated as Act 3.

options.label: Shop Sanity Costs
options.description:
How expensive the AP shop items should be. Tiered means costs map to typical costs rarity for the slot.
Progression = Rare, Useful = Uncommon, Filler = Common
Logic does not take this option into account.
Fixed=15 gold each
Super_Discount_Tiered=20% of tiered costs
Discount_Tiered=50% of tiered costs
Tiered=Vanilla price for slot

options.label: Seeded Run
options.description: Whether each character should have a fixed seed to climb the spire with or not.

options.label: Chatty MC
options.description: Whether the MC should talk about AP events.

options.label: Win Condition
options.description:
Choose the win condition.
Warning: Emperor win condition may be bugged right now.
Baseline: 175 locations, 175 items

options.label: Collect Red Fairies Amount
options.description:
How many red fairies you need to goal.
Only relevant if your goal is collecting red fairies.

options.label: Fairysanity
options.description:
Choose whether Red Fairies are added to the pool.
+100 locations, +100 items.

options.label: Shopsanity
options.description: Choose whether cards in the shop becomes AP items.

options.label: Combosanity
options.description:
Choose whether to add combos as locations.
+40 locations.

options.label: Enemysanity
options.description:
Choose whether to make enemy kills into locations. Light means one check per "species" of enemy.
While standard enemysanity is one check per instance of an enemy.
Plus means that enemies in the Proving Grounds will be included, otherwise they are excluded.
Be warned that some spawn triggers in this game are very unintuitive, hidden, and
once a level is beaten it will have new enemy spawn triggers. Please report any issue you encounter.
Light: ~113 locations
Light Plus: ~203 locations
Enemysanity: ~552 locations
Enemysanity Plus: ~955 locations

options.label: Open World
options.description: Choose whether all levels are unlocked from the start.

options.label: Level Unlocks as Items
options.description:
Whether to add level unlocks to the pool.
Instead of unlocking a level after beating a level, you must find the level unlocks as AP items
Takes precedence over Level randomization.
Experimental; there may be serious bugs, so play at your own risk, and report any issues.

options.label: Exclude Sacred Battle Checks
options.description: By enabling, prevents the checks in the sacred battle arenas from being progressive.(There are still checks)

options.label: Progressive Leveling
options.description:
Choose whether to have character levels as a progressive item. You will no longer be able to level up normally.
+19 items

options.label: Progressive Leveling
options.description:
Choose whether to have character levels as a progressive item. You will no longer be able to level up normally.
+34 items

options.label: Randomize Starting Deck
options.description:
Choose whether to randomize your starting deck.
Off = Vanilla, no randomization of the starting deck.
Weighted Random = Randomized, with a much higher chance to get cards with low magic costs. (No key cards)
Fully Random = Randomized; every card is equally likely to appear in your starting deck. (No key cards)

options.label: Randomize Shop Contents
options.description:
Choose whether to randomize what cards appear in the shops.
Off = Vanilla, no randomization of the shops' contents.
Weighted Random = Randomized. Early shops are more likely to have low magic cost cards, later shops are more likely to have higher cost cards. (No key cards)
Fully Random = Randomized; every card is equally likely to appear in the shop. (No key cards)

options.label: Randomize Bonus Draws
options.description:
Choose whether to randomize the contents of the bonus draws at the end of each level.
Off = Vanilla, no randomization of the bonus draw.
Weighted Random = Randomized. Early bonus are more likely to have low magic cost cards, later bonus draw are more likely to have higher cost cards. (No key cards)
Fully Random = Randomized; every card is equally likely to appear in the bonus draws. (No key cards).

options.label: Level Randomization
options.description:
Randomize which levels unlock when you would normally unlock a level.
Note: Alenjah Castle still always leads to all the towers in order, and
the sacred battle arena still leads to sacred battle arena 2. Proving Grounds
is still unlocked only after beating the game. Nobleman's Residence is always
the starting level.

options.label: Randomize Enemies
options.description:
Choose to randomize every non-unique enemy in the game. Every instance of enemy X will become enemy Y.
Still very experimental, so play at your own risk. If the game crashes, lags, or becomes corrupted; please report
with logs.

options.label: Level Music Randomization
options.description: Randomize the music that plays during levels

options.label: Character Model
options.description:
Change your character model.
Note: Models other than Tara do not have injured animations, and therefor are mechanically better.

options.label: Randomize Magic Costs
options.description:
Choose to randomize the magic stone cost of every card to between the set minimal
and maximum values. Shuffle swaps the vanilla costs randomly, maintaining the same distribution.
 Warning: This can trivialize the game

options.label: Randomize Magic Stone Costs Min
options.description: The minimum magic cost a card can be if Randomize magic Costs is enabled.

options.label: Randomize Magic Stone Costs Max
options.description: The maximum magic cost a card can be if Randomize magic Costs is enabled.

options.label: Magic Stone Costs Multiplier
Randomize Card Prices
options.description:
Choose to randomize the buy/sell costs of every card to between the set minimal
and maximum values. Shuffle swaps the vanilla costs randomly, maintaining the same distribution.
Cards always sell for approximately 2/3 of their price.

options.label: Randomize Card Prices Min
options.description: The minimum price a card can have if Randomize Card Prices is enabled.

options.label: Randomize Card Prices Max
options.description: The maximum price a card can have if Randomize Card Prices is enabled.

options.label: Card Prices Multiplier
Randomize Magic Costs
options.description:
Choose to randomize the Copy XP cost of every card to between the set minimal
and maximum values. Shuffle swaps the vanilla costs randomly, maintaining the same distribution.

options.label: Randomize Copy Xp Costs Min
options.description: The minimum Copy XP cost a card can have if Randomize magic Costs is enabled.

options.label: Randomize Copy Xp Costs Max
options.description: The maximum Copy XP cost a card can have if Randomize magic Costs is enabled.

options.label: Copy Xp Cost Multiplier
Randomize Magic Costs
options.description:
Choose to randomize the upgrade XP cost of every card to between the set minimal
and maximum values. Shuffle swaps the vanilla costs randomly, maintaining the same distribution.

options.label: Randomize Upgrade Xp Costs Min
options.description: The minimum upgrade XP cost a card can have if Randomize magic Costs is enabled.

options.label: Randomize Upgrade Xp Costs Max
options.description: The maximum upgrade XP cost a card can have if Randomize magic Costs is enabled.

options.label: Upgrade Xp Cost Multiplier
Number of Starting Maps
options.description: Number of maps to start unlocked, the rest will require AP items to access

options.label: "Shadows of Evil" map enabled
options.description: Enables Map: "Shadows of Evil"

options.label: "The Giant" map enabled
options.description: Enables Map: "The Giant".

options.label: "Zetsubou No Shima" map enabled
options.description: Enables Map: "Zetsubou No Shima".

options.label: "Der Eisendrache" map enabled
options.description: Enables Map: "Der Eisendrache".

options.label: "Gorod Krovi" map enabled
options.description: Enabled Map: "Gorod Krovi"

options.label: "Revelations" map enabled
options.description: Enabled Map: "Revelations"

options.label: (Chronicles) "Nacht der Untoten" map enabled
options.description: Enabled Map: "Nacht der Untoten"

options.label: (Chronicles) "Kino der Toten" map enabled
options.description: Enabled Map: "Kino der Toten"

options.label: (Chronicles) "Moon" map enabled
options.description: Enabled Map: "Moon"

options.label: (Chronicles) "Origins" map enabled
options.description: Enabled Map: "Origins"

options.label: (Unstable) "Wanted" map enabled
options.description: Enabled Map: "Wanted"

options.label: Start Hint Maps
options.description: Start hints the maps you have in the pool.

options.label: Special Rounds Enabled
options.description: Enables Special Rounds (Dogs, Monkeys, ect.).

options.label: Max Round Location
options.description: Maximum of rounds per map to be included as an AP location / check.

options.label: Round Location Frequency
options.description:
Frequency of rounds to award an AP location / check for.
e.g. Setting this to 3 and Max Round Location to 15 means you'll get a check on rounds 3, 6, 9, 12 and 15

options.label: Kill Checks
options.description: Add kill counts per map as checks

options.label: Headshot Checks
