options.label: Starting Items
options.description:
Start with these items. Each entry should be of this format: {item: "item_name", amount: #}
`item` can include components, and should be in an identical format to a `/give` command with
`"` escaped for json reasons.

`amount` is optional and will default to 1 if omitted.

example:
```
starting_items: [
    { "item": "minecraft:stick[minecraft:custom_name="{'text':'pointy stick'}"]" },
    { "item": "minecraft:arrow[minecraft:rarity=epic]", amount: 64 }
]
```

options.label: Console Mode
options.description:
ONLY ENABLE THIS IF YOU WANT TO PLAY ON CONSOLE.
This will disable all Multiplayer features, and cause the game to be patched in a way that is compatible with console play.
The game may lose some functionality compared to the PC version when this is enabled, and is intended for users who want to play the mod on console solo.

options.label: Multiplayer
options.description:
Toggle multiplayer features on or off.
Turning this off means you will not see any other players in-game.

options.label: Remote Items
options.description:
Toggle Remote Items on or off.
Turning this on means all items including ones in your own world will be sent to you from the server.
All local items will be AP items.

options.label: Goal
options.description:
This determines the goal of the game.
shadow_queen: Defeat the Shadow Queen.
crystal_stars: Collect a specified amount of Crystal Stars.
bonetail: Defeat Bonetail.
recipes: Cook a specified amount of Zess T.'s recipes (requires Cooksanity).

options.label: Goal Crystal Stars
options.description:
This determines how many crystal stars are required to enter the Throne Room in the Palace of Shadow.
This also determines how many stars are required to goal with the crystal_stars goal selected.

options.label: Goal Recipes
options.description: This determines how many recipes must be cooked to goal with the recipes goal selected.

options.label: Palace Crystal Stars
options.description: This determines how many Crystal Stars are required to enter the Palace of Shadow.

options.label: Required Stars Selection
options.description:
Toggles the Required Stars setting.
This will force the stars selected in Required Stars to be needed to enter the Palace of Shadow.
Leaving this off will cause the stars needed to be chosen randomly.

options.label: Required Stars
options.description:
Select which stars are required to enter the Palace of Shadow.
If you do not toggle this option the stars will be chosen randomly.
If this has more stars in it than goal stars required, it will use the ones that come first in the list.
If this has fewer stars in it than goal stars required, it will fill the rest in randomly.

options.label: Star Shuffle
options.description:
Crystal Stars will be added as items to the item pool.
vanilla: Crystal Stars will remain in their original locations.
stars_only: Crystal Stars will be shuffled into other crystal star locations.
all: Crystal Stars will be shuffled into any location.

options.label: Tattlesanity
options.description:
Creates a location for every enemy being tattled.
All key items can possibly be placed in these locations.

options.label: Star Piecesanity
options.description:
Determines if Star Piece locations will be randomized.
vanilla: Star Piece locations will remain in their original locations.
nonpanel_only: Only Star Pieces that are not in panels will be randomized.
all: All Star Pieces will be randomized.

options.label: Cooksanity
options.description:
Zess T.'s 57 recipes become locations: cooking a recipe from the unlocked-ingredient menu awards its check.
Her vanilla inventory cooking stays available.
Disabling this removes the recipe locations and Zess T. cooks fully vanilla.

options.label: Shopsanity
options.description:
Shop items will be randomized.
This only includes regular shops.

options.label: Shop Purchase Limit
options.description:
This determines which items in the shop will be replenished infinitely when purchasing.
infinite: All non-progression items in shops can be purchased infinitely.
consumables_only: Only consumable items can be purchased infinitely.
badges_only: Only badges can be purchased infinitely.
limited: No items can be purchased infinitely.

options.label: Shinesanity
options.description: Shine Sprites will be randomized.

options.label: Keysanity
options.description:
Chapter specific keys will be added to the item pool.
Disabling this will place the keys in their own chapters dungeon.

options.label: Troublesanity
options.description:
The trouble center will have their items randomized.
Disabling this will keep the trouble center items in their original locations.

options.label: Dazzle Rewards
options.description:
This determines what type of items are given as rewards by Dazzle.
vanilla: The rewards are the same as the original game.
filler: The rewards will be non-progression items.
all: The rewards can be any item.

options.label: Pit Items
options.description:
This determines what type of items are in the Pit of 100 Trials.
vanilla: The locations contain the same items as the original game, and the locations themselves will not be created.
filler: The locations will be marked as excluded.
all: The locations can contain any item.

options.label: Limit Chapter Logic
options.description:
Progression items will only appear in required chapters, and in common areas. You will not need to
check the chapters that are out of logic whatsoever. You can still visit them for local items (badges, consumables, etc) if you want or need to.
To view what chapters are expected of you, you're able to check what stars are illuminated on the Thousand-Year Door.

options.label: Limit Chapter 8
options.description:
All chapter 8 keys items will be placed in vanilla locations.
All other locations will have local non-progression items.

options.label: Blue Pipe Warp
options.description:
Toggle whether the blue pipes in Rogueport Sewers are usable.
Disabling this will remove the blue switches and the pipes will become inaccessible.

options.label: Palace Skip
options.description: Entering the Thousand-Year door will take you straight to Grodus.

options.label: Skip Cutscenes
options.description:
Skips some of the longer cutscenes in the game,
such as the Shadow Queen cutscene, Fahr Outpost Cannon etc.

options.label: Skip Epilogue
options.description:
After the final boss, warp straight to the credits instead of
playing the Rogueport epilogue.

options.label: Disable Intermissions
options.description:
After obtaining a crystal star, mario will stay in the boss' room,
and the sequence will be updated past the intermission.

options.label: Fast Travel
options.description:
Enable this to gain the ability to warp to any area you have visited from the map
screen in the main menu. Press A on the destination to open the warp confirmation dialog.

options.label: In-Game Tracker
options.description:
Adds a logic tracker to the journal map.
All map nodes are colored by check availability.
Pressing X on a node opens a list of that area's locations and their accessibility.

options.label: Flip Panel Hints
options.description:
Colors hidden flip panels on the floor by accessibility.
This is recommended for beginners who want to learn where flip panels are located.

options.label: Mirror Mode
options.description:
Mirrors the game horizontally.
Everything in the overworld and in-battle will be mirrored completely.

options.label: Always Succeed Conditions
options.description:
Enable this to make it so the battle condition in fights in the Glitz Pit
will always be fulfilled, regardless of their actual fulfillment.

options.label: Open West Side
options.description: Rogueport Westside is open from the start.

options.label: Grubba Bribe Direction
options.description:
Sets how bribing grubba behaves in-game.
Set if you want grubba to require coins for moving up or down the rankings respectively.
up_rank_only: Grubba accepts coins to move up the rankings. (20 -> 1). Moving down is free.
down_rank_only: Grubba accepts coins bribes to move down the rankings. (1 -> 20). Moving up is free.
both_directions: Grubba accepts coins for moving both up and down the rankings.

options.label: Grubba Bribe Cost
options.description:
Sets the cost to bribe Grubba to move up the rankings.
Grubba can be found in his office after your first battle in the glitz pit.

options.label: Enemy Randomizer
options.description:
Toggles the randomization of enemies in battles.
vanilla: Enemies will be the same as the original game.
within_chapter: Enemy encounters will be shuffled with other encounters that appear in the same chapter.
random: Enemy encounters will be shuffled with any other encounter in the game.

options.label: Enemy Formations
options.description:
Determines how many formations each fight can use when Enemy Randomizer is enabled.
Multiple: Randomize every formation separately.
Singular: Enemy encounters will be reduced to 1 singular, randomized formation.

options.label: Enemy Randomizer Grouping
options.description:
This determines how enemies are grouped when randomizing.
Enemy randomizer must be set to either within_chapter or random for this option to have an effect.
vanilla_groups: Enemies will be grouped by encounter, and shuffled as a group.
custom_groups: Enemies will be shuffled individually, and grouped into new encounters based on their new enemy count.

options.label: Enemy Stat Scaling
options.description:
With Enemy Randomizer on, randomized enemies replicate the vanilla HP, Defense and Attack
of the enemy that originally occupied that fight.
Encounters left unrandomized are instead scaled to the chapter they appear in.

options.label: Boss Randomizer
options.description:
Shuffles bosses amongst each other.
vanilla: Bosses will be the same as the original game.
chapter_bosses: Only end-of-chapter bosses will be shuffled amongst each other.
mini_bosses: Only mini-bosses will be shuffled amongst each other.
full: All bosses and mini-bosses will be shuffled together.

options.label: Boss Stat Scaling
options.description:
Scales randomized bosses to replicate the exact HP and level of the boss that originally occupied that fight.
This is independent of Enemy Stat Scaling and only affects bosses; when disabled, bosses are never scaled.

options.label: Boss Scaling Nerfs
options.description:
With this enabled, some bosses will be nerfed with Boss Stat Scaling enabled for balancing.
Currently: Cortez's HP scales to a third of the replaced boss's HP, so his three phases
add up to the fight's intended total.
Has no effect unless Boss Stat Scaling is enabled.

options.label: Faster Moon Speed
options.description: Mario's walking speed on the moon will be increased to be the same as his normal walking speed.

options.label: Permanent Peekaboo
options.description: The Peekaboo badge is always active, even when not equipped.

options.label: Full Run Bar
options.description: The run bar in battle always starts at 100 percent.

options.label: 0 BP First Attack
options.description: The First Attack badge costs 0 BP, just like the remake.

options.label: Badge BP Cost
options.description:
Change the BP cost of all badges.
This will not affect badges with unique costs such as First Attack, Power Bounce, etc.
vanilla: All badges will have their normal BP cost.
shuffled: All badges will have their BP cost shuffled among each other.
random_costs: All badges will have a random BP cost between 0 and 6.

options.label: Badge FP Cost
options.description:
Change the FP cost of all badges.
This will not affect badges with unique costs such as Refresh, etc.
vanilla: All badges will have their normal FP cost.
shuffled: All badges will have their FP cost shuffled among each other.
random_costs: All badges will have a random FP cost between 0 and 6.

options.label: Partner FP Cost
options.description:
Change the FP cost of all partners.
This will not affect partners with unique costs such as Vivian, etc.
vanilla: All partner abilities will have their normal FP cost.
shuffled: All partner abilities will have their FP cost shuffled among each other.
random_costs: All partner abilities will have a random FP cost between 0 and 6.

options.label: Music Settings
options.description:
Choose in-game music settings.
normal: Music will not change.
silent: No music will play at all.
randomized: Music will be randomized.

options.label: Block Visibility
options.description:
Choose how visible item blocks are.
normal: All blocks will keep their vanilla visibility.
all_visible: All blocks will be visible.

options.label: Experience Multiplier
options.description: Multiplies the experience you gain from battles by percentage.

options.label: Starting HP
options.description: How much health you start with.

options.label: Starting FP
options.description: How much flower points you start with.

options.label: Starting BP
options.description: How many badge points you start with.

options.label: Starting Coins
options.description: How many coins you start with.

options.label: Starting Level
options.description: What level you start at.

options.label: Starting Partner
options.description:
Choose the partner that you start with.
This settings will not be applied if partner shuffle is set to Vanilla.

options.label: Yoshi Color
options.description: Select the color of your Yoshi partner.

options.label: Goal
options.description:
The win condition for the game.
Complete X Missions: complete the required number of missions at any rank.
Complete X A-Ranks: earn A-rank on the required number of missions.

options.label: Goal Range
options.description: The number of missions or A-ranks required to complete the goal.

options.label: Starting Level
options.description: The level you start with access to. All other levels must be unlocked.

options.label: Enabled Ranks
options.description: Which rank tiers count as locations. Disabling a rank removes those checks from the pool.

options.label: Level Unlock Method
options.description:
How non-starting levels are unlocked.
Unlock Item: each level requires a specific unlock item from the item pool.
X Missions: each level unlocks after completing a set number of missions in the previous level.

options.label: Level Unlock Range
options.description:
When using the X Missions unlock method, the number of missions that must be completed
in a level before the next level in the chain becomes accessible.

options.label: Level Shuffle
options.description:
Randomize the order in which levels appear in the unlock chain.
When disabled, the unlock order is Sawmill -> Cul-De-Sac -> Construction -> Downtown.
Only has an effect if the Level Unlock Method is set to X Missions.

options.label: King Speed Multiplier
options.description: Multiplier applied to the King's movement speed.

options.label: Civilian Speed Multiplier
options.description: Multiplier applied to civilian movement speed.

options.label: Included Areas
options.description:
Select which areas will have their locations included in the randomization pool.
Each selected area's stages and checks will be accessible in your world.
Unselected areas will not be included in the location pool.
Mountain is always available and cannot be excluded.

options.label: Chests and Barrels
options.description:
Choose how you want Chests and Barrels to be randomized.
None: Neither Chests nor Barrels will be added as locations.
All Chests: Chests will be added as locations, Barrels will not.
All Barrels: Barrels will be added as locations, Chests will not.
All Both: Both Chests and Barrels will be added as locations.

options.label: Obelisks
options.description:
Obelisks will be added to the random pool as items.
Activating all the obelisks in an area will unlock access to the next.
Disabling this will lock obelisks in their original locations.

options.label: Mirror Shards
options.description:
Mirror Shards will be added to the random pool as items.
Collecting all four mirror shards will unlock access to the Desecrated Temple.
Disabling this will lock mirror shards in their original locations.

options.label: Portals
options.description:
Level portals will be added to the random pool as items.
Getting a portal item will unlock access to that level.
Levels will no longer unlock in succession when clearing the previous level.

options.label: Goal
options.description:
Choose your objective required to goal.
Defeat Skorne: Collect all 13 stones to unlock and defeat Skorne in the Underworld.
Defeat X Bosses: Defeat X number of bosses to goal.

options.label: Boss Goal Count
options.description:
Choose how many bosses you must defeat to goal if 'Defeat X Bosses' is selected as your goal.
This includes both Temple and Underworld Skorne.

options.label: Max Difficulty Value
options.description:
Select the difficulty value you want to be the maximum.
This will affect the amount of checks in each level as well as enemy strength and number of spawners.

options.label: Instant Max Difficulty
options.description:
All stages will load with their max difficulty on the first run through.
By default, stages increase in difficulty by 1 at a set interval that changes per zone.
The starting level for each zone increases gradually as you would progress in vanilla.

options.label: Infinite Keys
options.description: You will be given more keys than you could ever use.

options.label: Permanent Speed Boots
options.description: You will be given speed boots with a permanent duration.

options.label: Included Traps
options.description:
Choose what traps will be put in the item pool.
Valid Keys: Death, Poison Fruit, Crossbow Shooter, Bomb Thrower, Bomb Runner, Golem

options.label: Trap Frequency
options.description:
Choose the frequency of traps added into the item pool
This range is a percentage of all items in the pool that will be traps.

options.label: Local Filler Frequency
options.description:
Choose the frequency of filler items that will be placed locally in your world.
This range is a percentage of how many filler items will be locally placed before generation occurs.

options.label: Unlock Character One
options.description:
Unlock a secret character for Player 1 from the start.
None: No secret characters will be unlocked.
Chosen Character: The selected character will be available from a new save.

options.label: Unlock Character Two
options.description:
Unlock a secret character for Player 2 from the start.
None: No secret characters will be unlocked.
Chosen Character: The selected character will be available from a new save.

options.label: Unlock Character Three
options.description:
Unlock a secret character for Player 3 from the start.
None: No secret characters will be unlocked.
Chosen Character: The selected character will be available from a new save.

options.label: Unlock Character Four
options.description:
Unlock a secret character for Player 4 from the start.
None: No secret characters will be unlocked.
Chosen Character: The selected character will be available from a new save.

options.label: Victory Condition
options.description: Choose victory condition. Defeat the Rival at the end of Gym Leader Castle, clear Poké and Prime Master Ball Cups, or both.

options.label: Badge Requirement
options.description: Choose how many badges are required to enter the Gym Leader Castle. The default is 8, which is the vanilla requirement.

options.label: Starting Key Count
options.description: Choose how many Gym Keys you start with. The default is 3.

options.label: Progressive Gym Leader Castle
options.description:
Toggle on to unlock gyms progressively instead of randomly.
The gym keys will be replaced with Progressive Gym Keys. Each key received unlocks the next gym.
This option is off by default.

options.label: BST Randomness
options.description:
Controls the level of randomness for Pokemon BST. Stat distribution per Pokemon will follow a randomly selected distribution curve.
The higher the selection, the more extreme a curve you may see used. 
Stat changes are universal. Rental Pokemon and enemy trainer team Pokemon use the same BSTs.
Vanilla - No change
Low - 3 distribution types
Medium - 4 distribution types
High - 5 distribution types

options.label: Rental Randomness
options.description: Toggle on to randomize rental Pokemon. This option is off by default.

options.label: Rental List Shuffle
options.description:
Controls whether the rental pokemon list is randomized or not.
Instead of going in dex order, the rental tables will be shuffled.

Vanilla - No change
Sorted - Sorted by adjusted BST, which is calculated using the base BST and a Pokemon's moveset
Random - Fully randomized, with no regard to BST or moveset

options.label: Trainer Randomness
options.description: Toggle on to randomize enemy trainer teams. This option is off by default.

options.label: Trainersanity
options.description: Toggle on to make all Trainers into checks. This option is off by default.

options.label: Randomize Books
options.description: Randomize Books (Filler Item).

options.label: Randomize Notes
options.description: Randomize Notes (Filler Item).

options.label: Randomize Shop Items
options.description:
Randomize Shop Items. If set to True, the logic expects the item order is the amount of coins to obtain.
eg. first item requires 1 coin, second item requires 2 coins, etc.
If set to false, the shop will not be randomized and coins are filler.

options.label: Open Disciple Tower Door without Ring of Undead
options.description: Opens the Door from Disciple Tower to the rest of Shadowgate

options.label: Tag Link
options.description: When other multiworld games tag/swap characters, you will auto swap with them and vise versa.

options.label: Logic Type
options.description:
Choose your logic difficulty and difficulty of tricks you are expected to perform to reach certain areas.
Please be aware that if you plan on randomizing worlds with BK Moves in the pool, you cannot use "intended" logic.

options.label: Victory Condition
options.description:
Choose the victory condition.
HAG1: Unlock the HAG1 fight and defeat Gruntilda.
Minigame Hunt: Clear the 14 minigames and the final Canary Mary race in Cloud Cuckcoo Land to collect Mumbo Tokens.
Boss Hunt: Defeat the 8 world bosses and collect their Mumbo Tokens.
Jinjo Family Rescue: Rescue Jinjo Families to collect their prized Mumbo Tokens.
Wonderwing Challenge: Collect all 32 Mumbo Tokens across all boss fights, mini games, and every Jinjo family to gain access to HAG1 and Defeat Grunty. The Ultimate Banjo Tooie experience!!
Token Hunt: Mumbo's Tokens are scattered around the world. Help him find them!
Boss Hunt + Hag1: Combines Boss Hunt with HAG-1. HAG-1 won't open until the required amount of bosses are defeated.

options.label: Open HAG 1
options.description: HAG 1 boss fight is opened when Cauldron Keep is opened, requiring fewer Jiggies to win.

options.label: Minigame Hunt Length
options.description:
How many Mumbo Tokens are needed to clear the Minigame Hunt.
Choose a value between 1 and 15.

options.label: Boss Hunt Length
options.description:
How many Mumbo Tokens are needed to clear the Boss Hunt.
Choose a value between 1 and 8.

options.label: Jinjo Family Rescue Length
options.description:
How many Jinjo families' Mumbo Tokens are needed to clear the Jinjo family rescue.
Choose a value between 1 and 9.

options.label: Token Hunt: Mumbo Tokens in Pool
options.description:
How many Mumbo Tokens are in the pool.
If Randomize Signpost are enabled, you are allowed up to 50.
If Nestanity is enabled, you are allowed up to 100.
If neither are enabled, you are allowed up to 15.
Choose a value between 1 and 100.

options.label: Token Hunt Length
options.description:
How many Mumbo Tokens you need to find to beat your game.
Choose a value less than or equal to the Mumbo Tokens that you have specified in the pool.

options.label: World Requirements
options.description:
Choose how quickly the worlds open.
quick: Worlds open at 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28, 36, and 44 Jiggys
normal: Worlds open at 1, 4, 8, 14, 20, 28, 36, 45, and 55 Jiggys
long: Worlds open at 1, 8, 16, 25, 34, 43, 52, 60, and 70 Jiggys
custom: You pick when worlds open

options.label: Randomize Banjo-Tooie Movelist
options.description: Jamjars' & Roysten's Movelist are randomized.

options.label: Jamjars' Silo Costs
options.description: Change how many notes it takes to use Jamjars' move silos. Requires the Banjo-Tooie move list to be randomized.

options.label: Randomize Banjo-Kazooie Movelist
options.description:
Banjo-Kazooie's Movelist are randomized.
Mcjiggy Special - You start with Talon Trot and Tall Jump.

options.label: Egg Behaviour
options.description:
Change the way Eggs work. Randomize Moves and Randomize BK Moves are required.
Start with Blue Eggs: You start with Blue Eggs, and you must find the other 4.
Random Starting Egg: You start with one type of egg, and you must find the other 4.
Progressive Eggs: You start with blue eggs, and you find items to unlock the others in the vanilla order.
Simple Random Start Egg: You start with one type of egg that is not Clockwork Kazooie Eggs, and you must find the other 4.

options.label: Progressive Beak Buster
options.description: Beak Buster to Bill Drill. Randomize Moves and Randomize BK Moves are required.

options.label: Progressive Shoes
options.description: Stilt Stride to Turbo Trainers to Springy Step Shoes to Claw Clamber Boots. Randomize Moves and Randomize BK Moves are required.

options.label: Progressive Water Training
options.description:
Basic: Dive to Double Air to Faster Swimming.
Advanced: Dive to Sub Aqua Aiming to Talon Torpedo to Double Air to Faster Swimming.
Randomize Moves and Randomize BK Moves are required.

options.label: Progressive Flight
options.description: Flight Pad to Beak Bomb to Airborne Egg Aim. Randomize Moves and Randomize BK Moves are required.

options.label: Progressive Egg Aim
options.description:
Basic: Third Person Egg Shooting to Egg Aim.
Advanced: Third Person Egg Shooting to Amaze-O-Gaze to Egg Aim to Breegull Blaster.
Randomize Moves and Randomize BK Moves are required.

options.label: Progressive Bash Attack
options.description: Ground Rat-a-tat Rap to Breegull Bash. Randomize Stop N Swap and Randomize BK Moves are required

options.label: Randomize Note Nests
options.description: Note Nests are randomized.

options.label: Randomize Treble Clefs
options.description: Treble Clefs are randomized.

options.label: Additional Treble Clefs
options.description:
Convert four 5 note nests into Treble Clefs (20 notes), and adds 3 per additional Treble Clef.
Randomize Notes is required.

options.label: Number of Bass Clefs
options.description:
Convert two 5 note nests into Bass Clefs (10 notes), and adds 1 filler per Bass Clef.
Randomize Notes is required.

options.label: Randomize Jinjos
options.description: Jinjos have fled to other worlds. Other players need to return them home.

options.label: Randomize Doubloons
options.description: Jolly Roger's Doubloons are randomized.

options.label: Randomize Cheato Pages
options.description: Cheato pages are randomized.

options.label: Randomize Cheato Rewards
options.description: Cheato Rewards are added to the pool.

options.label: Randomize Honeycombs
options.description: Honeycombs are randomized.

options.label: Randomize Honey B Rewards
options.description: Health Upgrades are added to the pool.

options.label: Randomize Big Top Tickets
options.description: Big Top Tickets are randomized.

options.label: Randomize Green Relics
options.description: Targitzan's Green Relics are randomized.

options.label: Targitzan Slightly Sacred Chamber Green Relic Requirement
options.description: Green relics required to enter Targitzan's Slightly Sacred Chamber.

options.label: Targitzan Boss Green Relic Requirement
options.description:
Green relics required to enter Targitzan's Boss Chamber.
Make sure this value is GREATER than Targitzan's Slightly Sacred Chamber Requirement

options.label: Randomize Beans
options.description: CCL Beans are randomized.

options.label: Randomize Mumbo and Humba Magic
options.description:
Mumbo and Humba Magic are in the pool and automatically unlocked when received.
When disabled, collecting a Glowbo will give you either a Mumbo or Humba Magic.

options.label: Randomize Stop n Swap
options.description: Mystery Eggs, their rewards, and the Ice Key are scattered across the MultiWorld.

options.label: Randomize Baby T-Rex Roar
options.description: Baby T-Rex's Roar is lost across the MultiWorld. Other players need to help him learn to ROAR!

options.label: Nestsanity
options.description: Eggs and feather nests give checks when you collect them for the first time. They behave as regular egg nests after they have been collected.

options.label: Randomize Signposts
options.description: Signposts give items when read.

options.label: Randomize Train Station Switches
options.description: Train Stations are randomized.

options.label: Randomize Chuffy
options.description:
Chuffy is randomized.
Once received, you can call Chuffy at any unlocked station before defeating Old King Coal.

options.label: Randomize Warp Pads
options.description: Warp Pads give checks when tagging them. They can only be used once you receive the         corresponding item to use a warp pad.

options.label: Randomize Silos
options.description: Overworld silos give checks when tagging them. They can only be used once you receive the corresponding item to use a silo.

options.label: Open Silos
options.description:
Choose how many overworld silos are pre-opened.
If you have Randomized Worlds, pre-opened silos are guaranteed to lead to the first world.
If you enabled Randomized Worlds with BK Moves randomized, you must have at least 2 silos opened.

options.label: Skip Puzzles
options.description: Open world entrances without having to go to Jiggywiggy.

options.label: Randomize World Order
options.description: Worlds will open in a randomized order. Randomized Moves and Skip Puzzles required.

options.label: Randomize World Entrances
options.description: The main entrance of each world will warp you to a random world.

options.label: Randomize Bosses
options.description: The entrance of each boss will warp you to a random boss.

options.label: Open Backdoors
options.description:
Opens many one-way switches on game start, allowing for more backdoor access to levels.
The following gates are preopened: MT -> TDL, MT -> HFP, GGM -> WW, WW -> TDL.
For MT -> TDL, only the gate accessed from TDL's side is opened. For GGM -> WW, the boulders are still intact.
The bridge from HFP's entrance is pre-moved to allow secondary access to Cliff Top.
George is pre-dropped to make HFP -> JRL more accessible.

options.label: Open GI Frontdoor
options.description: Opens Grunty's Industries frontdoor without requiring to get in first.

options.label: Signpost Hints
options.description: Choose how many signpost give a hint when read.

options.label: Signpost Move Hints
options.description:
Choose how many signposts, out of the signposts that contain a hint, will hint for one of your moves.
The rest of the hints will hint slow locations.
Silos and BT moves will not be hinted if randomize_bt_moves is not enabled.

options.label: Add Signpost Hints to Archipelago Hints
options.description:
Choose if a signpost hint is added to the Archipelago hints upon reading the hint.
Never: signpost hints are never added
Progression: hints are added only if the hinted location has a progression item.
Always: hints are always added.
This option only has an effect if signpost hints are enabled and the hint clarity is set to "clear".

options.label: Hint Clarity
options.description:
Choose how clear hints are.
Cryptic: hints will only tell you how good the item is.
Clear: hints will tell you what the item is, and to who it belongs.

options.label: Extra Cheats
options.description:
Extra cheats will be added to the "CHEATS" sub-menu:
NESTKING  - Infinite eggs/feathers.
HONEYKING - Infinite health/air.
SUPERBANJO - Gotta go fast!
SUPERBADDY - They gotta go fast!

options.label: Easy Canary Mary
options.description: Makes Canary Mary Races much easier.

options.label: Speed Up Minigames
options.description: Start 3-round minigames at Round 3.

options.label: Tower of Tragedy Quiz
options.description: Choose whether to play the full quiz, start at round 3, or skip it.

options.label: Skip Klungo
options.description: Make it so you can skip Klungo 1 and 2.

options.label: Automatic Cheat Activation
options.description: When Feathers and Eggs cheats are found, only enable them automatically when received.

options.label: King Jingaling Jiggy
options.description: King Jingaling will always have a Jiggy for you.

options.label: Replace Extra Jiggies
options.description:
Jiggies over the maximum needed to beat the seed (plus a generous buffer) are replaced by fillers/traps.
If turned off, you are guranteed exactly 90 jiggies.
You can control how likely extra jiggies appear in the pool via extra_jiggies_weight.

options.label: Replace Extra Notes with filler
options.description:
Notes over the maximum needed to beat the seed (plus a generous buffer) are replaced by fillers/traps.
If turned off, you are guranteed exactly 900 notes in total.
You can control how likely extra notes show up as fillers by extra_notes_weight.

options.label: Extra Jiggies Weight
options.description:
The weight of Jiggies in the filler pool. Requires replace_extra_jiggies.
You are guarenteed enough jigges to open all levels. These are extra.

options.label: Extra 5 Notes Weight
options.description:
The weight of 5 pack notes in the filler pool. Requires randomize_notes and replace_extra_notes.
You are guarenteed enough notes to open all jamjars silos. These are extra.

options.label: Extra Doubloons Weight
options.description:
The weight of extra doubloons in the filler pool. Requires randomize_doubloons.
You are guarenteed the original 30 doubloons. These are extra.

options.label: Egg Nests Weight
options.description: The weight of Egg nests in the filler pool. The weight is doubled if nestsanity is on.

options.label: Feather Nests Weight
options.description: The weight of Egg nests in the filler pool. The weight is doubled if nestsanity is on.

options.label: Big-O-Pants Weight
options.description: The weight of Big-O-Pants (nothing) in the filler pool.

options.label: Golden Eggs Weight
options.description:
The weight of Golden Eggs in the filler pool.
You are forced to use Golden Eggs for a minute upon receiving the trap.
Requires Max Traps to be nonzero to have an effect

options.label: Trip Trap Weight
options.description:
The weight of Trip Traps in the filler pool.
You trip upon receiving the trap.
Requires Max Traps to be nonzero to have an effect

options.label: Slip Trap Weight
options.description:
The weight of Slip Traps in the filler pool.
You slip upon receiving the trap.
Requires Max Traps to be nonzero to have an effect

options.label: Transform Trap Weight
options.description:
The weight of Transform Traps in the filler pool.
A transformation animation upon receiving the trap.
Requires Max Traps to be nonzero to have an effect

options.label: Squish Trap Weight
options.description:
The weight of Squish Traps in the filler pool.
Stomponadon attempts to squish you upon receiving the trap.
Requires Max Traps to be nonzero to have an effect

options.label: Tip Trap Weight
options.description:
The weight of Tip Traps in the filler pool.
You receive a random textbox upon receiving the trap.
Requires Max Traps to be nonzero to have an effect

options.label: Max Traps
options.description:
The maximum possible amount of traps that replace fillers in the pool.
Notice that the real number of traps is limited by the number of fillers in the pool, which varies depending on your settings.

options.label: Dialog Character
options.description: Change the character that announces your obtained moves, worlds, etc.

options.label: Enable hidden escape checks
options.description: Include the 15 hidden arena escapes and the Title Screen hidden escape.

options.label: Require episode keys
options.description: Require Archipelago items before Episodes 2 and 3 can be started.

options.label: Shuffle arenas between episodes
options.description: Shuffle all 15 arenas between episode groups; Episode 1 always has five playable arenas.

options.label: Arena percentage checks
options.description: Checks per arena, evenly spaced through 100%. Higher values add checks and room for Time Echoes.

options.label: Required Time Echoes
options.description: Shop credits guaranteed as progression. Raise checks if the selected number will not fit.

options.label: Shop power-up item mode
options.description: Off keeps every shop power-up normal. Categories uses six shared items; per weapon uses one item for each real weapon power-up.

options.label: Goal
options.description: Completion target, based on best destruction percent rather than checks.

options.label: Enable DeathLink
options.description: Send a DeathLink after finishing an arena below the selected percent; received links disable firing for one minute.

options.label: DeathLink percent
options.description: Completed arenas below this destruction percent send a DeathLink.

options.label: DeathLink firing-lock duration
options.description: Seconds that firing is disabled after receiving a DeathLink.

options.label: Starting Tetromino Count
options.description:
Number of random tetrominoes to start with.
This can help prevent softlocks and make the early game more forgiving.

options.label: Reusable Tetrominoes
options.description:
When enabled, tetrominoes are returned to the player after being placed in
a gate, tool panel, or tower door, making each piece reusable.

This dramatically reduces the number of tetrominoes required to reach climb
the tower (from 90 down to ~37).

options.label: Randomise Purple Sigils
options.description: When enabled, the 24 Purple Sigils hidden throughout the worlds are randomised

options.label: Randomise Stars
options.description: When enabled, the 30 Stars hidden throughout the worlds are randomised.

options.label: Randomise Bonus Puzzles
options.description:
When enabled, the 9 Bonus White tetrominoes are randomised.

If stars are also randomised, logic will require all 30 stars to be collected before 
the bonus puzzles can be completed due to the potential of unlocking them in any order,
unless an order is specified in bonus_level_order below.

options.label: Shuffle Mechanics
options.description:
When enabled, Golden tetrominoes are removed from the item pool and the
five mechanic tools (Connector, Hexahedron, Fans, Playback, Platform)
are shuffled into the item pool.

This option is still in development and is not fully functional. 
It is recommended to leave this option disabled for now.

options.label: Shuffle Messenger Gates
options.description:
When enabled, Green tetrominoes are removed from the item pool and the
four world gates (World A1 Gate, World A Gate, World B Gate, World C
Gate) are shuffled into the item pool.

When received, the tetrominoes required to open the gate will be granted to the player

options.label: Bonus Level Order
options.description:
Logic normally requires all 30 stars to access the 3 bonus levels, to avoid potential softlocks.
This option allows for specifying the access order for the 3 bonus levels. If an order is specified,
you will still need the appropriate world access and puzzle mechanics unlocked to complete them.

For example, selecting "BAC" would put world B's bonus level into logic at 10 stars, A's at 20, and C's at 30.
"unchanged" keeps the above behavior, requiring all 30 stars for bonus level access.

options.label: Messenger Island Order
options.description:
Logic normally requires all 24 purple sigils to access the 3 messenger islands, to avoid potential softlocks.
This option allows for specifying the access order for the 3 messenger islands. If an order is specified,
you will still need the appropriate world access to access them.

Note this option currently has minimal value, because the only messenger island check currently is the star in
messenger island A. Thus, setting an order only affects how late into the seed that star may enter logic.
This option will gain value if messenger items are added as Archipelago items in the future.

For example, selecting "CAB" would put messenger island A's star into logic at 16 purple sigils.
"unchanged" keeps the above behavior, requiring all 24 purple sigils for messenger island access.

options.label: Player Faction
options.description:
Choose your faction. If you pick multiple the client will tell you which one you need to play.
All options after Drycha require you to have the enabled mod installed and enabled at the bottom of this yaml.
The default option is The Daemon Prince. Make sure to disable it.

choices.label: Mixu Mousillon Lady Of The Black Grail
Mixu Legendary Lords Chilfroy D Artois
Mixu Legendary Lords Sir John Tyreweld
Mixu Legendary Lords Adalhard De Lyonesse
Mixu Legendary Lords Cassyon De Parravon
Mixu Legendary Lords Valmir Von Raukov
Mixu Legendary Lords Alberich Haupt Anderssen
Mixu Legendary Lords Edvard Van Der Kraal
Mixu Legendary Lords Belannaer The Wise
Mixu Legendary Lords Egrimm Van Horstmann
Mixu Legendary Lords Wychwethyl The Wild
Cataph Southern Realms Borgio The Besieger
Cataph Southern Realms Gnashag The Black Prince
Pegaz Crustacean Nation Lobstrogh The Betrayer
Pegaz Crustacean Nation Grand Master Corallion

options.label: Game Mode
options.description:
Select which game mode you want to use.
Conquest: No restrictions, checks are based on total settlements conquered.
Spheres:  You can only interact with factions near your start position,
         all unique settlements are checks.
         [MAKE SURE YOU HAVE READ THE README TO PREVENT SOFTLOCKING]

options.label: Faction Shuffle
options.description: If you want to shuffle the settlements for each faction

options.label: Randomize AI Personalities
options.description: Randomize AI Personalities [Does this work? It's hard to tell, the AI go crazy when shuffled anyway].

options.label: Starting Settlements
options.description:
REQUIRES FACTION SHUFFLE TO BE ENABLED
Set how many settlements the player will start with.

options.label: Checks Per Settlement
options.description:
Set how many checks are triggered per settlement captured.
Depending on YAML settings and the chosen faction, you will likely have around 150-250 non-filler items.
Make sure to change this value based on how many locations you want your game to have.
If world generation fails, then try increasing this option.

options.label: BuildingTechSanity
options.description:
If you want every building and tech to be a location.
[EXPERIMENTAL, WILL ENABLE BUILDING AND TECH SHUFFLE]

options.label: RitualSanity
options.description:
If you want every faction mechanic to be a location.
[EXPERIMENTAL, WILL ENABLE RITUAL SHUFFLE AND SANITY, Will force settlements to a minimum of 30]

options.label: BattleSanity
options.description:
If you want every 5 battles won up to be locations up to 100 battles
[EXPERIMENTAL]

options.label: DespoilerSanity
options.description:
If you want every 2 settlements sacked and razed to be locations up to 20 settlements
[EXPERIMENTAL]

options.label: Radius Upgrades (SPHERES)
options.description:
SPHERE MODE ONLY
How many diplomatic radius upgrades are required to access all checks.
You can only interact with factions that are within this radius of your starting capital.
Depending on starting location, 15-25 will likely include the entire world.
This value will automatically be reduced by the apworld to ensure there are no empty spheres.

options.label: Tech Shuffle
options.description: Whether technologies should be included in the item pool.

options.label: Progressive Technologies
options.description: If technologies should be progressive. Requires Tech Shuffle to be on.

options.label: Building Shuffle
options.description: Whether buildings should be included in the item pool.

options.label: Progressive Buildings
options.description: If buildings should be progressive. Requires Building Shuffle to be on.

options.label: Unit Shuffle
options.description: Whether units should be included in the item pool.

options.label: Progressive Units
options.description: If units should be progressive. Requires Unit Shuffle to be on.

options.label: Ritual Shuffle
options.description:
Whether faction mechanics should be included in the item pool.
Not all mechanics are shuffled as some cannot be locked.

options.label: Filler Weight
options.description:
Weight of filler items to trap items.
For example: filler: 70
Would mean: 70% filler, 30% traps

options.label: Death Link
options.description: Enable or Disable death linking.

options.label: Death Link Effect
options.description:
Valid options for death link effect. Include as many or as few as you like in the list. Valid Options:
"10% Treasury", "25% Treasury", "50% Treasury", "Wound Hero", "Wound Lord", "Rebellion", "Raze Random Settlement", "Disable Replenishment (2 turns)"
E.g. ["10% Treasury", "Wound Lord"]

options.label: Starting Tier
options.description:
Start with buildings and units of this tier already unlocked.
Warning: Setting this to 0 will result in you having no buildings or units unlocked at the start.
DO NOT SET THIS TO RANDOM, IT'S PURPOSE IS FOR MAKING THE GAME EASIER BY GIVING YOU ITEMS AT THE START

options.label: Force Early Upgrades
options.description:
Percentage of your early items that are forced to be useful/progression.
0 doesn't force unlocks at all. 100 means that all of your early items will be unlocks.
High values are not recommended. SOFT LOGIC, Not recommended for large syncs/asyncs.

options.label: Hard Logic
options.description:
Enforce hard logic so checks cannot be sent without the required logic items even if the player hits the in-game location.
Recommended for large syncs/asyncs to prevent soft logic issues.

options.label: Fast Research
options.description: Instantly completes any research that you are sent from the multiworld, but disables techs from being locations if sanity is enabled

options.label: Reveal Hints
options.description: In-game missions reveal which items can be found in the locations and hint them to the multiworld

options.label: Supported Mods
options.description:
List of mods with built-in support. Please add them to this list if you have them installed and enabled. Valid Options:
"decomposed expanded roster", "mixu mousillon", "mixu legendary lords", "ovn citadel of dusk", "medusa0 surtha ek", "cataph southern realms", "pegaz the crustacean nation"
E.g. ["decomposed expanded roster", "mixu legendary lords"]

options.label: Filler Blacklist
options.description:
Filler Blacklist (if you blacklist them all, then nothing will happen). Valid Options:
"Get-Rich-Slow Scroll", "Get-Rich-Quick Scroll", "Handful of Order", "The GroBro 3000", "Give me that", "Make Love, Not War"

options.label: Trap Blacklist
options.description:
Trap Blacklist (if you blacklist them all, then nothing will happen). Valid Options:
"Handful of Unrest", "Unionize This", "Where is our Map?", "Schizophrenia", "Make Love, Not War", "Torches and Pitchforks", "Let's trade", "You too, Brutus?", "We're Going on a Trip", "En Garde!"

worlds.game: The Legend of Zelda - Oracle of Ages

options.label: Goal
options.description:
The goal to accomplish in order to complete the seed.
- Beat Veran: beat the usual final boss
- Beat Ganon: teleport to the Room of Rites after beating Onox or Veran, then beat Ganon (same as linked game)
- Retrieve Maku Seed - You will have to retrieve the maku seed from the maku tree in order cut straight into the credits scene (similar to a triforce hunt in ALTTPR)

options.label: Logic Difficulty
options.description:
The difficulty of the logic used to generate the seed.
- Casual: expects you to know what you would know when playing the game for the first time
- Medium: expects you to know well the alternatives on how to do basic things, but won't expect any trick
- Hard: expects you to know difficult tricks such as bomb jumps
- Hell: expects you to use tricks and glitches that span over more than a few inputs

options.label: Death Link
options.description: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.label: Open Advance Shop
options.description:
In the vanilla game, there is a house (northwest of Horon Village in Seasons, and south of the maku tree entrance in Lynna Village for Ages) hosting the secret "Advance Shop" that can only
be accessed if the game is being played on a Game Boy Advance console.
If enabled, this option makes this shop always open, adding 3 shop locations to the game (and some rupees to the
item pool to compensate for the extra purchases that might be required)

options.label: Deterministic Gasha Locations
options.description:
When set to a non-zero value, planting a Gasha tree on a unique soil gives a deterministic item which is taken
into account by logic. Once an item has been obtained this way, the soil disappears forever to avoid any chance
of softlocking by wasting several Gasha Seeds on the same soil.
The value of this option is the number of items that can be obtained that way, the maximum value expecting you
to plant a tree on each one of the 16 Gasha spots in the game.

options.label: Secret Locations
options.description: When enabled, add the linked game secrets to the list of locations

options.label: Linked Hero's Cave
options.description:
Adds linked hero's cave to a list of locations for you to complete. This option also allows you to mark which location the linked hero's cave will be in.
- Maku Tree Entrance Right Side: A cave will be placed to the right side of the maku tree entrance

options.label: Miniboss Locations
options.description: When enabled, all minibosses will have a check that you will need to get each time they are defeated.

options.label: Required Essences
options.description:
The amount of essences that need to be obtained in order to get the seed from the Maku Tree and be able
to fight the final boss (depends on Goal Settings)

options.label: Shuffle Essences
options.description:
If enabled, essences will be shuffled anywhere in the multiworld instead of being guaranteed to be found
at the end their respective dungeons.

options.label: Animal Companion
options.description:
Determines which animal companion you can summon using the Flute, as well as the layout of the Natzu region.
- Ricky: the kangaroo with boxing skills
- Dimitri: the swimming dinosaur who can eat anything
- Moosh: the flying blue bear (in seasons, he has a passion for Spring Bananas)

options.label: Shuffle Dungeons
options.description:
If enabled, each dungeon entrance will lead to a random dungeon picked at generation time.
Otherwise, all dungeon entrances lead to their dungeon as intended.

options.label: Default Seed Type
options.description:
Determines which of the 5 seed types will be the "default seed type", which is given:
- when obtaining Seed Satchel
- when obtaining Slingshot or Seed Shooter
- by Horon (or Lynna) Seed Tree

options.label: Duplicate Seed Trees
options.description:
The game contains 8 seed trees, but only 5 types of seeds. This means that some types of seeds can appear on
multiple trees. This setting lets you choose seed trees that will be guaranteed to not hold a unique type of
seed. You can choose up to 3.
Regardless of what you choose, each seed type will appear on at most 2 trees.
Valid choices are:
- Lynna City
- Ambi's Palace
- Deku Forest
- Symmetry City
- Crescent Island
- Rolling Ridge West
- Rolling Ridge East
- Zora Village

options.label: Warp to Start Location
options.description:
This option changes the spot you warp in when you press select or start, A, and B buttons to warp back to the forest of time.
Please note that depending on the option you select, logic will be affected.

options.label: Lynna Gardener
options.description:
When enabled, a friendly gardener will have trimmed the bushes outside of Lynna City and cleared the path
so you don't have to! This will expand the sphere 0 checks to include everything past the bushes that you
normally would need nothing for.
It is recommended to have this enabled for multiworlds.

options.label: Master Keys
options.description:
- Disabled: All dungeon keys must be obtained individually, just like in vanilla
- All Small Keys: Small Keys are replaced by a single Master Key for each dungeon which is capable of opening
  every small keydoor for that dungeon
- All Dungeon Keys: the Master Key for each dungeon is also capable of opening the boss keydoor,
  removing Boss Keys from the item pool
Master Keys placement is determined following the "Keysanity (Small Keys)" option.

options.label: Keysanity (Small Keys)
options.description: If enabled, dungeon Small Keys can be found anywhere instead of being confined in their dungeon of origin.

options.label: Keysanity (Boss Keys)
options.description: If enabled, dungeon Boss Keys can be found anywhere instead of being confined in their dungeon of origin.

options.label: Maps & Compasses Outside Dungeon
options.description: If enabled, Dungeon Maps and Compasses can be found anywhere instead of being confined in their dungeon of origin.

options.label: Required Slates
options.description: The amount of slate that need to be obtained in order to get to the boss of the eighth dungeons.

options.label: Slates Outside Dungeon 8
options.description: If enabled, Slates can be found anywhere instead of being confined in Dungeon 8.

options.label: Vasu Ring Checks Requirement
options.description:
When enabled, vasu will congradulate you based off of the number of rupees (for Rupee Ring check), and number of enemies defeated (for Slayer's Ring check). 

Disable Entirely: Determines whatever or not vasu will give out mutiple checks when the friendship ring check is finished.
Rupee Requirement for Rupee Ring Check: Determines the amount of rupees that you need to collect in order for vasu to give you a check. (from 1 to 9999)
Amount of Enemies Defeated for Slayer Ring Check: Determines the amount of enemies that you need to defeat in order for vasu to give you a check. (from 1 to 1000)

options.label: Gasha Nut Requirement
options.description:
This option lets you configure how many kills are required to make a gasha tree grow.
Using a gasha ring halves this number.

options.label: Required Rings
options.description:
Forces a specified set of rings to appear somewhere in the seed.
Adding too many rings to this list can cause generation failures.
List of ring names can be found here: https://zeldawiki.wiki/wiki/Magic_Ring

options.label: Excluded Rings
options.description:
Forces a specified set of rings to not appear in the seed.
List of ring names can be found here: https://zeldawiki.wiki/wiki/Magic_Ring

options.label: Prices Factor (%)
options.description:
A factor (expressed as percentage) that will be applied to all prices inside all shops in the game.
- Setting it at 10% will make all items almost free
- Setting it at 500% will make all items horrendously expensive, use at your own risk!

options.label: Combat Difficulty
options.description:
Modifies the damage taken during combat to make this aspect of the game easier or harder depending on the
type of experience you want to have

options.label: Potion always available
options.description:
When enabled, the potion will always be available in the selected shop and will refill.
WARNING : THIS POTION DOESN'T CURE KING ZORA, you still need to find a specific (blue) potion to cure him
- disabled : The potion is not available by default, and if it's still in a shop, you can only buy it once
- lynna_shop : A check will be removed in Lynna City's shop and potions will always be sold here
- syrup_hut : A check will be removed in Syrup Hut and potions will always be sold here

options.label: Goal
options.description:
Defines the goal to accomplish in order to complete the randomizer.

- Release Virus.
- Release Virus with all 9 infinity upgrades unlocked.

options.label: Crypto Mine
options.description:
Adds the 36 levels of the CryptoMine into the pool.
When you level up the crypto mine, instead of speeding up the crypto mine it will instead give you a randomized item from the pool.

options.label: Milestones
options.description: Adds the Milestones Rewards and Locations to the item pool.

options.label: Boss Drops
options.description:
Randomize Boss Drops.

- None - No boss drops will be randomized.
- Necessary Only - All boss drops are randomized but only 18 cores and 8 filler items.
- All 26 - All 26 levels of boss drops will be randomized.

options.label: Progressive Items
options.description: Replaces a large portion of items in the pool with progressive versions for the respective upgrade.

options.label: Final Boss Access
options.description:
Sets the goal for reaching the final boss and unlocking the Selection Sphere.

Find Crew: Find the required number of castaways (1-28, tied to moving objects).
Seiren Escape: Find three specific items: Seiren Area Map, Ship Blueprints, and Mistilteinn.
Release the Psyches: Defeat the specified number of Wardens of Evolution (4 will exist and will be chosen randomly). 
    Interact with the starting checkpoint crystal to see which bosses exist and what bosses are required to access them.
Untouchable: Reach the bottom of Former Sanctuary Crypt and defeat Melaiduma. Forces Former Sanctuary Crypt on.

options.label: Goal Count to Open Octus (Find Crew)
options.description: For Find Crew mode: Sets the number of castaways required to open Octus Overlook Entrance.

options.label: Goal Count to Open Octus (Release the Psyches)
options.description:
For Release the Psyches mode: Sets the number of Wardens of Evolution required to defeat
to open Octus Overlook Entrance.

options.label: Goal Count to Access Final Boss (Find Crew)
options.description: For Find Crew mode: Sets the number of castaways required to access the final boss.

options.label: Goal Count to Access Final Boss (Release the Psyches)
options.description:
For Release the Psyches mode: Sets the number of Wardens of Evolution required to defeat
to access the final boss.

options.label: Discovery-Sanity
options.description:
Puts the landmarks in the item pool. Finding a landmark unlocks the ability to warp to it on the map.
This drastically changes logic and movement around the world. This also creates way more ways to espace
the starting area and access the North Side early. It is recommended on for AP as it makes BK pretty unlikely 
outside of very early game scenarios.

options.label: Dungeon Entrance Shuffle
options.description:
Shuffles the entrances to dungeon maps. The entrance to one dungeon may lead to another.
East Coast Cave is treated as the entrance for Pirate Ship Eleftheria with this setting on.

options.label: Boss Level Shuffle
options.description:
Shuffles the levels of bosses.
With this setting off, bosses are found at their intended level.
Balanced: Boss levels are shuffled but distributed in a way to avoid extreme outliers and to keep early game bosses at relatively lower levels.
Chaotic: Boss levels are completely shuffled with no restrictions. This can lead to extreme outliers and early game bosses being late game levels.

options.label: Shuffle Damage Types
options.description:
Shuffles the damage types of characters.
Shuffles damage types like strike, slash, and pierce among the characters.
The distribution will remain the same with two characters having each damage type, but which character has which type will be random.
This will also carry over to the elements types associated with each damage type in the randomizer:
Slash: Water
Pierce: Light
Strike: Earth

options.label: Jewel Trade Items
options.description:
Sets which Prismatic Jewel trades at Dina's shop can become progression items.
Dina must join the village to access these trades.
There are 10 total trades distributed across different jewel costs.

options.label: Fish Trades
options.description:
Sets the number of unique fish required for Shoebill's rewards.
Shoebill joining the village is not required. The fishing rod is required to make these checks.
There are 6 total rewards, now at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 unique fish respectively.

options.label: Food Trades
options.description:
Sets the number of unique cooked recipes required for Mishy Mishy's rewards.
There are 6 total rewards, now at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 unique recipes respectively.
Access to Gendarme's Midpoint is required to make these checks.

options.label: Map Completion
options.description:
Sets the map completion percentage required for Euron/Captain Barbaros rewards.
Euron must join the village to make these checks.
The Eagle Eye Orb is considered required for percentages of 60% or greater.
Logically progression can never land at 100%.

options.label: Discoveries
options.description:
Sets whether to require half (12) or all (24) discoveries for the rewards.
Austin must join the village to make these checks.
Both rewards are on by default with the 'all' setting.

options.label: Dogi Intercept Rewards
options.description:
Enables Dogi's 5 rewards for completing specific intercept stages (2, 3, 5, 7, and 9).
Intercepts are now unlocked via Progressive Raid Lists found in the world. 
Dogi is unlocked from the first one found.

options.label: Master Kong Rewards
options.description:
Sets whether Master Kong rewards can contain progression items.
Master Kong involves a fairly lengthy chain that spans the game.

options.label: Silvia Progression
options.description:
Sets whether Silvia can block progression.
This only refers to the optional boss fight.

options.label: Mephorash Progression
options.description:
Sets whether Mephorash can block progression.
Mephorash is the highest level optional fight in the game outside Former Sanctuary Crypt
and the Silent Tower is a high requirement location. Silent Tower can still have progression,
just not the item from Mephorash or the chest behind him.

options.label: Former Sanctuary Crypt
options.description:
Sets whether Former Sanctuary Crypt exists as a location.
If turned off, the dungeon is closed.
Also controls if it's entrances is used for dungeon entrance shuffle and if Melaiduma 
can be a boss in Release the Psyches mode.
All essence keystones are placed within the dungeon unless Essence Key Sanity is on.

options.label: Experience Multiplier
options.description:
Divides character's min and max Exp values allowing for quicker leveling.
A multiplier of 8 provides well-balanced pacing for quick seeds.
A couple things to remember. Ys 8 has a pretty aggressive fall off 
for experience if you outlevel enemies and Nightmare and Inferno cut experience gain in half.
Level exp growth in Ys is also exponential. So it's a game that generally favors higher multipliers.

options.label: Additional Intercept Rewards
options.description:
Causes intercepts to give out up to four additional rewards after returning
to Castaway Village post-intercept. These are meant to help with resource gathering,
leveling, etc.

options.label: Fast Intercepts
options.description:
Shortens Raids and Hunts. 
Raids have their waves halved rounded down starting from the final wave. 
So a 5 wave raid becomes 2 waves and the makeup of the waves would be the same as wave 4 and 5.
Hunts spawn the boss during the first wave.

options.label: Battle Logic
options.description:
Attempts to smooth combat pacing by guaranteeing the player always has access
to some amount of strength for each boss. No battle logic is applied to non-forced 
encounters, with the small exceptions of Octus and Former Sanctuary Crypt having some 
battle logic applied to entering them.
Highly recommended to be left on, especially for Inferno difficulty.

options.label: Progressive Super Items
options.description:
Both the Mistilteinn and Spirit Ring are in the pool.
Players find Broken Mistilteinn or Broken Spirit Ring instead.
Speaking with Kathleen after maxing the forge will fix the broken weapon.
If "Fun Items" are on then there are broken versions of Laxia, Sahad, Hummel, and Ricotta's accessories.
These are turned into Euron at max forge instead of Kathleen, since he's the accessory guy.

options.label: Fun Items
options.description:
Adds fun, powerful items to the item pool.
The items are one new arm equipment anyone can equip,
and four unique accessories that can only be equipped by Laxia, Sahad, Hummel, and Ricotta respectively.
These are considered for combat logic, they are meant to be powerful 
and also give Laxia, Sahad, Hummel, and Ricotta items with parity to Mistilteinn and Spirit Ring.

options.label: Octus Paths Opened
options.description:
All bridges in Octus start lowered. Bosses and mini-bosses are still present
but do not need to be defeated to access everywhere in the dungeon.
Mini-bosses remain an excellent EXP farm.

options.label: Extra Shop Ranks
options.description:
Adds Progressive Shop Ranks to the item pool (0-10 additional stones).
There are 7 Progressive Shop Ranks by default, so 3 additional puts it at a round 10.
Makes hitting max level more likely without being excessive.

options.label: Recipes Come With Ingredients
options.description:
Grants the player essentially infinite ingredients necessary to cook a dish
upon obtaining their respective Recipe Book. There's not currently havey logic 
around ingredient access so it's recommended to use this for things like Mishy.
The pacing of the rando also generally works better without having to farm ingredients
and things like the attack/defense recipes are used in battle logic as they're very powerful.

options.label: North Side Open
options.description:
The playthrough will start with the Crystal Checkpoint to Temple Approach unlocked.
Completing Mt Gendarme is no longer mandatory to access the North Side.
You may need to explore the North Side while underleveled.

options.label: Infinity Mode
options.description:
Activates Infinity Mode, a New Game+ that drastically scales up enemy levels.
The lowest level enemies are in the mid-60s and the highest level is 120.
It is recommended you upgrade your starting loadout drastically with this on.

options.label: Scale Exp Items
options.description:
Scales experience reward items (Hermit's Elixir, Bitter Remedy, Sweet Remedy) to attempt
to make them less rewarding due to experience multiplier options and to smooth out pacing.

options.label: Final Boss
options.description:
Sets which boss(es) will be the final ones.
If set to both, Theos and Origin fights happen consecutively.

options.label: Theos Start Phase
options.description:
Sets which phase the Theos fight will start in.
1: Tentacle phase
2: Circular platform with crystals
3: Head form

options.label: Origin Care Package
options.description:
Origin is a long fight and higher level than Theos.
Since the Abyss is skipped in randomizer, this provides balance.
Lite: A few ripe items and recipes
Generous: Stacks of ripe items and recipes

options.label: Origin Start Phase
options.description:
Sets which phase the Origin fight starts in.
1: Mobbing phase
2: Main boss

options.label: Essence Key Sanity
options.description:
If Former Sanctuary Crypt is on, Essence Key Stones can be placed anywhere
in the game instead of just within the dungeon itself. If set to on, forces Former Sanctuary Crypt on.

options.label: Death Link
options.description: If enabled, players will share death. When one player dies, the other player(s) will also die.

options.label: Helper Text
options.description:
If enabled, this will display additional descriptive text about items.
This is meant to help with new player onboarding.
For remote items it will show the information in the client.

options.label: Starting keys
options.description: Specifies which zone keys are given for free

options.label: No local key placement
options.description: Restrict local placement rules to force this world's keys to be placed in other worlds.

options.label: Buff to disable GOAL blocks
options.description: Enable the buff item that disables Special stage GOAL blocks.

options.label: Buff to disable R blocks
options.description: Enable the buff item that disables Special stage R blocks.

options.label: Hard Mode: No persistent rings
options.description: Hard Mode: The ROM's ring count will remain zero and Sonic still only drops 6 rings.  Doesn't interact with Ring Goal or Available Rings.

options.label: Ring Goal for your Victory
options.description: Changes the number of rings that need to be found for you to clear.  Isn't affected by Hard Mode, is overriden by Available Rings.

options.label: Number of rings sent to the pool
options.description: Dr Eggman attacked, how many rings fell into the pool for you to recover?  Will cap Ring Goal.

options.label: Boring filler items
options.description: Enable to take the fun out of the junk filler items

options.label: How many Invincibility power-ups?
options.description: Trigger Invincibility power-up

options.label: How many Shield power-ups?
options.description: Trigger Shield power-up

options.label: How many Speed Shoes power-ups?
options.description: Trigger Speed Shoes power-up

options.label: Mark Speed Shoes as trap
options.description: Do you consider Speed Shoes a trap?

options.label: Send DeathLink
options.description: Enable this to send DeathLink

options.label: Receive DeathLink
options.description: Enable this to receive DeathLink

options.label: Boss Goal for your Victory
options.description: Changes the number of bosses that need to be beaten for you to clear.  Not order specific.

options.label: Emerald Goal for your Victory
options.description: Changes the number of emeralds that need to be collected for you to clear.  Not order specific.

options.label: Special Stages for your Victory
options.description: Changes the number of Special Stages that need to be beaten for you to clear.  Order specific.

options.label: Final Zone unlocks when?
options.description:
Control when Final Zone can unlock, wait until all other victory conditions are met?

- **Anytime:** You can do Final Zone as soon as you have the key.
- **Last But Optional:** If your victory conditions can be achieved without beating Final Zone you skip it.
- **Always Last:** Final Zone unlocks once you have every other victory condition, beat it to win.

Note that this may change how certain mechanics behave:

- "Always Last" essentially forces the boss goal to be at least 1, "Last But Optional" will not.
- Both "Always Last" and "Last But Optional" will add the Final Zone key to your starting inventory.
- "Always Last" and "Last But Optional" are identical with 6 bosses.
- An example of less than 6: "Always Last" with 3 bosses will require any 2 of the Act 3 bosses then FZ, "Last But Optional" requires any 2 of the Act 3 bosses then either FZ or a third Act 3 boss.

options.label: Starting Vehicle Type
options.description: Which vehicle type you start with.

options.label: Starting Cargo Type
options.description:
Which cargo type you start with.
Cannot start with Goods or Steel as they are dependent on other cargo types.

options.label: Starting Cash Bonus
options.description:
Give a starting cash bonus equal to one full starting loan amount.
Off: No bonus.
On:  Add one loan worth of cash at session start.

options.label: Lock Bridges
options.description:
Lock bridge construction behind the 'Bridges' AP item.
When on, players cannot build any bridge until 'Bridges' is received.

options.label: Lock Tunnels
options.description:
Lock tunnel construction behind the 'Tunnels' AP item.
When on, players cannot build any tunnel until 'Tunnels' is received.

options.label: Lock Canals
options.description:
Lock canal/aqueduct construction behind the 'Canals' AP item. NOT RECOMMENDED WITH SHIP STARTING VEHICLE TYPE.
When on, players cannot build canals or water bridges until 'Canals' is received.

options.label: Lock Terraforming
options.description:
Lock terraforming (raise/lower land) behind the 'Terraforming' AP item. NOT RECOMMENDED FOR NEW PLAYERS.
When on, players cannot terraform land until 'Terraforming' is received.

options.label: Cargo-Vehicle Mission Count
options.description:
How many 'Transport <Cargo> by <Vehicle>' missions to generate.
0  = none.  37 = all valid cargo/vehicle combinations.
Any value in between randomly selects that many from the 37 possibilities.
Each mission requires the cargo item AND the matching vehicle type to be in logic.

options.label: Global Tiered Mission Count
options.description:
Number of progressive transport tiers generated for each cargo type.
Tier 1 requires 1 000 units, tier 2 requires 5 000, tier 3 requires 10 000, tier 4 requires 50 000, etc.
Per-cargo options override this global setting.

options.label: Passengers Tiered Mission Count
options.description: Tiered mission count for Passengers. Overrides global if > 0.

options.label: Mail Tiered Mission Count
options.description: Tiered mission count for Mail. Overrides global if > 0.

options.label: Valuables Tiered Mission Count

options.label: Coal Tiered Mission Count
options.description: Tiered mission count for Coal. Overrides global if > 0.

options.label: Oil Tiered Mission Count
options.description: Tiered mission count for Oil. Overrides global if > 0.

options.description: Tiered mission count for Grain. Overrides global if > 0.

options.label: Wood Tiered Mission Count

options.label: Iron Ore Tiered Mission Count

options.label: Steel Tiered Mission Count

options.label: Goods Tiered Mission Count

options.label: Utilities Required Tier
options.description:
Tiered cargo missions at or above this tier require all locked utilities
(Bridges, Tunnels, Canals, Terraforming) to be unlocked in logic.
Only has effect when at least one infrastructure lock option is enabled.
Default: 2 (i.e. tier-2 missions and above need all utility items).

options.label: Enable Shop
options.description: Whether the AP shop is enabled for this slot.

options.label: Shop Slots
options.description: Total number of AP shop locations to generate.

options.label: Shop Tiers
options.description:
How many visibility tiers the AP shop is split into.
Tier 1 is visible from the start; each Progressive Shop Upgrade reveals one more tier.

options.label: Shop Cost Minimum
options.description: Minimum cost for random shop item pricing.

options.label: Shop Cost Maximum
options.description:
Maximum cost for random shop item pricing.
Should be >= Shop Cost Minimum. Default 1,000,000.

options.label: Reveal Shop Items
options.description:
Whether the AP shop list reveals actual item rewards.
Off: shop entries stay blind (Shop 1, Shop 2, ...).
On:  shop entries show the real item each location unlocks.

options.label: Trap Frequency
options.description:
Percentage of filler slots that are replaced with a trap item.
0 = no traps. 50 = half of all filler slots become traps. 100 = all fillers are traps.

options.label: Recession Duration (Months)
options.description: How many in-game months a Recession lasts before cargo payments return to normal.

options.label: Recession Multiplier (%)
options.description:
Payment multiplier percentage during a Recession.
70 = cargo payments are cut to 70% of normal.

options.label: Industry Strike Duration (Months)
options.description: How many in-game months an Industry Strike lasts before production resumes.

options.label: Breakdown Crisis Duration (Months)
options.description: How many in-game months a Breakdown Crisis lasts before breakdowns return to normal.

options.label: High Demand Duration (Months)
options.description: How many in-game months a High Demand Period lasts.

options.label: High Demand Multiplier (%)
options.description:
Payment multiplier percentage during a High Demand Period.
150 = all cargo payments are 50% higher than normal.

options.label: Start Year
options.description: The starting year for the game world. Default is 1960.

options.label: Map Width
options.description: Width of the generated map.

options.label: Map Height
options.description: Height of the generated map.

options.label: Land Generator
options.description: Which terrain generator to use.

options.label: Terrain Type
options.description: Base terrain shape in map generation.

options.label: Variety Distribution
options.description: Landscape variety distribution.

options.label: Smoothness
options.description: Roughness/smoothness preset for terrain generator.

options.label: Rivers
options.description: Amount of rivers generated.

options.label: Town Names
options.description: Town name style.

options.label: Number of Towns
options.description: Initial number of towns.

options.label: Sea Level
options.description: Sea/lake amount preset.

options.label: Industry Density
options.description: Number of industries generated at game start.

options.label: Champions
options.description: Which champions are possibly included in the item pool?

options.label: Starting Champions
options.description: Number of champions in your starting inventory

options.label: Champion Subset Count
options.description:
Number of champions to randomly select for the item pool of those listed provided.
Higher then the total number of champions will just use all champions listed.

options.label: Enabled Checks
options.description:
Which check types are active for each champion?
All check types are enabled by default: "Dragon", "Herald", "Baron", "Tower", "Inhibitor", 
"Game Win", "Assists", "Kills", "Creep Score", "Vision Score"
To recreate the old ARAM mode, use: "Tower", "Inhibitor", "Game Win", "Assists", "Kills"

options.label: Support Special Treatment
options.description:
When enabled, support-role champions will not receive Kill and Creep Score checks,
and Vision Score checks will only apply to support champions.
(This was enabled by default on version <=0.2.0)
Disable this to give all champions identical checks.

options.label: Win Completes Champion
options.description:
If enabled, winning a game with a champion (Enemy Nexus Destroyed check) will
automatically complete all remaining checks for that champion.

options.label: Required Creep Score
options.description: Required CS to complete CS checks

options.label: Required Vison Score
options.description: Required VS to complete VS checks

options.label: Required Kills
options.description: Required Kills to complete Kill checks

options.label: Required Assists
options.description: Required Assists to complete Assist checks

options.label: Total LP Count
options.description: Total LP items to place in the world.

options.label: Required LP Percentage
options.description: What percentage of total LP available do you need to collect to win?

Ensures a weapon is placed early in your world. "Good weapons" ensures that the weapon is either the Polar Star, Blade, or Machine Gun. "Annoying" adds weapons that can break blocks but can be aggravating to use - the Nemesis, Bubbler, and Missile Launcher.

Note that the Bubbler needs to be Level 3 in order to break blocks, which may force early game grinding to progress.

options.label: Deathlink

options.label: Useful Items

Percentage of items in the pool that are 'useful'.

Vanilla: Characters learn techs as normal.
Shuffle: Characters learn random techs chosen from the normal pool.

options.label: Meseta Multiplier
options.description: Multiplier applied to meseta earned from battle.

options.label: XP Multiplier
options.description: Multiplier applied to experience earned from battle.

options.label: Lac Dagger fix
